results.note: One whole three-lobed toothed leaf in red, yellow and green autumn colour, standing out against hemlock and leaf litter. Autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn and usual_look false; the twig join is not shown.
Crowded, overlapping autumn leaves lit from behind, many tilted and spotted. Lobes and teeth need close study, so shape and margin are search, with angle and light (backlight) as causes.
A ground carpet of fallen red maple leaves mixed with brown leaves of other trees. The subjects are fallen, dead leaves, small and crowded in the frame, so shape and margin are search.
Several red and green autumn leaves on a sapling, crowded together; the central leaves show the three-lobed outline in full. Crowding sets alone false and the small teeth need close study.
One fallen red leaf lying in brown leaf litter beside a mushroom, with dark spots and a curled lobe. It is a fallen, dead leaf on the ground, so dead_leaf.
A spray of green summer leaves on red stalks, overlapping and tilted, with some pale undersides showing. Crowding and tilt make the outline and teeth of one leaf a search.
A scene of a sapling with red and orange autumn leaves among tall grass and other trees. The leaves blend into a mass and the margin cannot be read at this size.
A cluster of autumn leaves on red stalks meeting the twig, the top leaf whole with clear lobes and teeth. Surrounding red leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false.
One whole green mature leaf hanging from a red stalk against a soft background, lobes, teeth and veins easy to read. The stalk's join to the twig is only partly in frame.
Close view of one red and green autumn leaf filling the frame, with clear teeth and veins. The frame edge and other leaves cut off the side and basal lobes, so whole is false.

A mass of yellow autumn leaves seen from below against the sky, with a whole red-leaved tree in the background; the leaves overlap and blend into a mass, so no single outline or edge reads cleanly. Autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn; the upward view is the angle cause.
A whole mossy trunk shown from a distance in a spring woodland; the bark is small in the frame and partly covered with moss, so its texture, pattern and colour need close study.
The base of a multi-stemmed trunk with grey ridged and furrowed bark that reads well. Sunlight glares through from behind between the stems, which is the light cause.
Close view of grey scaly, ridged bark with the plate pattern sharp in the centre; the edges are soft from shallow focus but the ridges still read. No trunk edge or scale object, so too_close.
A straight trunk filling the frame with both edges visible, showing grey bark in long narrow ridges and plates; clear and evenly lit.
A trunk with both edges in frame showing smooth grey bark breaking into brown scaly strips; the pattern and colour read clearly. A small twig crosses the upper left but does not hide the bark.

The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, with a birdhouse on the trunk competing for attention and a strong sun flare washing out the right side. The bark ridges are hard to read at this angle and light.
Sharp close view of grey bark with long vertical ridges breaking into scaly plates and some lichen. No trunk edge or scale object, so too_close.

A slender trunk with smooth grey, lichen-spotted young bark in a busy autumn woodland scene; the bark is seen from a distance and the colourful background competes. Young smooth bark sets growth_stage young and usual_look false.
Old bark of a large trunk breaking into long shaggy, curling grey plates, with a hand at the left edge for scale and the trunk edge at the right. Small file but sharp.

Many red samara clusters on bare twigs, seen from below against a pine and sky. The samaras are small and crowded in the frame, so kind, shape, hang and wing need a search; alone false because of the many clusters and the busy pine background; angle for the upward view.
A close cluster of pinkish paired samaras hanging on long red stalks from a twig, with young leaves soft in the background. The samaras and how they hang are clear.

The lower trunk and its base on a lawn, shaggy vertical strips below and smoother grey bark above. The texture is seen from a distance, so texture needs a search; the strip pattern and colour read clearly.

Sunlit green samaras with pink-tinged wings against a dark background; full shape but still green, so unripe and not the usual look. The stalks show but not where they join the twig, so hang is search.
A full-frame close-up of scaly, plated bark with dark furrows; no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close. Warm low side light tints the colour and deepens the shadows.
Reddish-green samaras hanging on long red stalks from a twig, against blue sky and soft branches. Full shape but not yet ripe; backlight from the sky shifts the colour.

A branch with many pale samaras among green leaves, seen from below against the sky. The samaras are small and mixed with leaves, so shape, hang and wing need a search and alone is false; the upward view and backlight from the sky are causes.
A full-frame close-up of grey-brown scaly bark with narrow ridges and plates; texture and pattern are clear. No trunk edge or scale object, so too_close.
Clusters of pinkish samaras hanging on long red stalks from a twig, with a young leaf and soft green background. Fruit kind, shape, wing and hang are clear.

Tiny developing samaras with small red wings on upright green stalks, just after flowering, against a soft background. The fruits have not reached full shape, so young, and kind, shape, wing and hang need close study.

One hanging mature leaf, whole outline and lobes readable against a dark background; pale side with raised veins suggests the underside. Harsh spot light or flash against black washes the green to a pale grey-green, so light is a cause.
Clusters of red paired samaras hanging from a bare twig in spring, background soft. Samaras are full shape but fresh red and not yet ripe, so growth_stage unripe and usual_look false.

Several green leaves on a branch in a park scene; the left leaf shows a whole lobed outline, but other leaves and a busy background compete, so alone is false. The sparse margin teeth are small in the frame (search), and the stalk joins need close study; small brown spots do not change the outline.

Drooping clusters of orange-red samaras on long stalks from pale branches, shot with flash against a black background. Individual samara outlines are small and overlapping (shape search); flash alters the colour, so light is a cause.
Classic single mature green leaf on a black background with the full five-lobed outline, sinuses, and sparse-toothed margin plainly readable. No difficulty causes.

Long-stalked red clusters hanging from a twig just after flowering, with tiny developing samara wings at the tips; the fruit has not reached full shape (young), so kind and wing need close study. Shot from below against a bright overcast sky, which backlights and darkens the subject (angle, light).

A pile of fallen red-and-yellow leaves; the central leaf is overlapped by others, so its outline and margin take study (search) and whole is false, alone false. Autumn colour gives growth_stage autumn and usual_look false; dark fungal spots do not change the outline.

Red paired samaras hanging on stalks from a twig with opening buds, against a plain blue sky; kind, shape, wing, and attachment are readable. Viewed from below (angle); full shape but fresh red, so unripe and usual_look false.
A single flat mature green leaf on wood-chip mulch with the full lobed outline and margin clearly readable. The textured background does not compete with the leaf.
A crown of orange autumn foliage against blue sky; no single leaf outline can be read and the leaves blend into a mass, so part is other and leaf_mass applies.
Straight trunk with both edges in frame showing grey bark breaking into long shaggy vertical plates and strips; buildings in the background do not compete with it.
One whole green five-lobed leaf on a plain white background, upper side, with lobes, pointed tips, sparse-toothed margin and palmate veins all readable. No twig, so arrangement is not shown.
A whole sapling in a garden bed with hostas and shrubs; its small leaves blend into a mass, so the lobe outline needs a search and the margin cannot be read.
A hanging leaf seen from the underside with its full five-lobed outline and sparse-toothed margin readable; a second leaf beside it and a busy foliage background compete, so alone is false.
Trunk with both edges in frame showing scaly vertical ridges and plates; heavy grey-green lichen patches hide the true bark colour, so colour needs close study.
A large forked old trunk shot from a distance with the camera looking up into the autumn crown, so the bark pattern needs a search; dappled sun and shadow change the bark colour.
Full-frame bark texture of curling vertical plates with no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close; a warm reddish cast changes the bark colour from the usual grey.

A whole sapling among garden plants and under a conifer; its leaves blend into a mass, so the lobe outline needs a search and the margin cannot be read. Patchy sun and backlight change the leaf colour.
An orange autumn crown seen from below; the leaves blend into a mass, so lobe outlines need a search and margins cannot be read.
Fallen yellow, orange and brown autumn leaves in a pile on the ground; the central yellow leaf shows a readable lobed outline, but the subjects are dead fallen leaves and the pile crowds them.

A twig with a hanging cluster of paired samaras below several leaves, shot with flash on a black background. The seeds are still green, so the fruit is unripe. The leaves compete with the fruit, and the flash changes the colour.
A mature trunk at a fork, shot slightly upward in hard sun against a blue sky. Moss and the angle make the scaly plate pattern take some study, and the bright sun washes out the colour.
A mature trunk in front of a brick building, showing grey-brown bark with long vertical plates and furrows. The pattern is easy to read.
An old trunk shot from its base, looking up into the crown with broken limbs and a burl. The camera looks up into the crown, so this is a reject, and the bark pattern foreshortens with height.
A single ripe, dry, paired samara with its stalk on a plain purple background with a 1 cm scale bar. It is detached, so the photo does not show how it hangs.
A mature trunk against a soft background, showing dark grey bark with long plates that curl away at the edges. The pattern is easy to read.
A close-up of grey bark with lichen and irregular vertical ridges, with no trunk edge or scale object. The frame shows texture only, so the plate pattern takes some study.
A close-up of grey bark with long vertical plates that curl at their edges. There is no trunk edge or scale object, so the frame shows texture only, but the plates are easy to read.
A mature trunk in front of a brick building, showing dark bark with vertical plates and furrows. The pattern is easy to read.
A gnarled old trunk with moss and low limbs in grass, shot from a distance. The bark texture and plates are small in the frame, so they take some study, and dappled sun changes the colour.

One fallen half-samara lying on snow and germinating, with the radicle out of the swollen seed; the wing and the samara kind read clearly against the plain background. A germinating seed is not the typical form (atypical), it has fallen (after_seed_fall), and the photo does not show how it hangs.
Paired samaras hanging on long stalks from the twig, against a soft background. The seeds are still green, so the fruit is full-shape but unripe and not the usual look.

White oak leaves seen from below against a bright sky, with the central leaf whole and its rounded lobes readable. The view from below (angle) and the backlight (light) darken the leaves, and the leaves are crowded (alone false).
A whorl of mature white oak leaves at the twig tip, upper side, with whole lobed outlines and the petioles meeting the twig. Other leaves fill the background, so alone is false.

A white oak leaf, upper side, with insect holes and galls along the margin near the tip (damaged). The frame top cuts off the leaf tip (whole false), and the neighbouring leaves are in focus beside it (alone false).

A dense cluster of samaras hanging from a cut twig, shot with flash on a black background. The samaras overlap so their shape takes study (search), the leaves compete (alone false), the flash changes the colour (light), and the green seeds show unripe fruit.

A white oak branch spray with many leaves and two small acorns, seen from below against the sky. The leaves are crowded and small in the frame (shape and margin at search, alone false), and the backlight and upward view darken them (light, angle).
A low branch of wet white oak leaves over leaf litter, upper side. The lobed outlines read, but the leaves are crowded and small in the frame, so the margin needs study (search) and alone is false.
A cluster of dry brown paired samaras hanging on their stalks, with bare branches soft behind. Warm low sun tints the wings (light).
The pale underside of one white oak leaf against a dark background, with the rounded lobes, the margin and the veins clear. The bottom of the frame cuts off the leaf base (whole false).
The camera looks up the forked trunk into the backlit crown, so the bark is foreshortened, in shade, and competes with the foliage. The ridges are only readable with close study.
Green, full-size acorns with warty caps sit on the twig among lobed leaves. The acorns are unripe and the surrounding leaves compete for attention.
A wide trunk with both edges in frame shows the light grey, scaly plates and shallow fissures clearly.
A trunk filling the frame, with its edges visible, shows the pale grey blocky scales and vertical pattern clearly in even light.

One green, unripe acorn sits behind a large lobed leaf that hides the lower part of the cup and the stalk. The leaf dominates the frame, so the acorn outline needs close study and the hang is not shown.
A sunlit branch holds many overlapping deeply lobed leaves; the lobes are visible but crowded, so one leaf outline takes searching. Bright sun washes out the leaf colour in places.
A forest trunk with both edges in frame shows small grey blocky plates clearly; the background forest is busy but the trunk dominates.
A large trunk shows the scaly ridges and plates, but strong dappled sun and shadow change the bark colour across the frame.
A trunk with both edges in frame shows the light grey, loose scaly plates clearly in even light.
Two ripe, detached tan acorns on a plain blue background, one with its warty cap, with a 1 cm scale bar. The fruit is off the twig, so the hang is not shown.
Dead brown leaves lying on the forest floor; the centre leaf is overlapped by others, so whole and alone are false. Low warm sun and deep shadows change the colour, and the subject is a dead leaf.
A cluster of three green acorns with warty caps sitting on the twig among lobed leaves. The acorns are full shape but green, so unripe and not the usual look.
A cluster of green acorns with warty caps on the twig, framed by leaves. Full shape but green, so unripe; one acorn is partly hidden behind the others.
A whole small tree or crown in red autumn colour among conifers; the leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf can be read.

A branch tip of red autumn leaves against a dark conifer; leaves are small in the frame, crowded and overlapping, and slightly soft, so shape and margin need close study. Autumn colour means not the usual look.

A cluster of green lobed leaves with bristle tips at a shoot tip, seen from above over the forest floor; the central leaves are whole and readable but several leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false.

Several acorns with warty caps, green turning pink, against a dark flash-lit background. Flash changes the colour, and the acorns are full shape but not yet ripe brown; how they attach to the twig is only partly visible.

One large lobed leaf with bristle-tipped lobes seen from below its underside, backlit by sky and sun. The left base lobes run to the frame edge, so whole is false; the view from below and the backlight make it harder.
One green acorn in a warty cap on a short stalk from the twig, among leaves. Full shape but green, so unripe and not the usual look.

A whorl of yellow-orange autumn leaves with shallow bristle-tipped lobes at a shoot tip, in strong direct sun that bleaches the colour. Several leaves overlap in the cluster, so alone is false; autumn colour means not the usual look.

Trunk shot from the base looking straight up into the green crown. The lower trunk shows the striped ridges well, but the camera looks up into the crown, so bark_up_or_dark applies and the view from below adds angle.

A cluster of green lobed leaves on a low shoot over the forest floor; the centre leaf shows its whole outline. The leaves overlap and crowd each other, the bristle tips are small, and dappled sun with hard shadows changes the colour.
Hanging branch with many dark green, sharply lobed leaves against a soft background. The leaves overlap and several are tilted, and the bristle-tipped margins are small, so margin needs close study.

Newly opened pale spring leaves hanging from a twig, with a few small catkins that do not replace the leaves. The leaves are young and not at full shape, they are strongly backlit, and they hang tilted.

A small shoot of shallow, rounded-lobed leaves lying flat against a mossy trunk, which looks like an epicormic sprout from the trunk. The shallow lobing is not the typical mature red oak leaf, so this is a sucker leaf reject.
A branch of green, bristle-tipped lobed leaves, with the centre leaves whole and the twig with its petioles visible. Many leaves fill the frame and compete with the centre ones, so alone is false.
The camera looks straight up the trunk into the crown against a bright sky. The bark is dark and backlit, so the striped ridges need close study, and the upward view is a bark_up_or_dark reject.

Young yellow-green spring leaves with many hanging catkins, strongly backlit. The leaves are young, crowded, and tilted, so their outline and margin need study; the catkins are prominent but the leaves are still the subject.
A section of crown in red autumn colour; the small leaves blend into a mass among the branches, so no single leaf can be read. Patchy sun and backlight add glare.

A wide, old trunk with clear, long interlacing ridges and furrows, with both edges and autumn trees in the background. The small dark tag on the trunk cannot be read at this size, so it is not a name label reject.
Close frame of furrowed bark with long vertical ridges and lichen; no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close. Warm low sun tints the bark gold, which changes the colour.

Newly unfolding leaves above a stipule-wrapped bud against blue sky; the leaves are young, folded and tilted, so the outline is only partly readable. Backlit from the sky, which changes the leaf colour.
One ripe brown acorn hanging from its twig, sharp, against a soft green background; cap scales and nut outline are plain.
Five detached ripe acorns with caps on a plain white background; shape and cap are clear, but nothing shows how they hang.
Seed-plate photo on a plain blue background: one capped acorn in side view plus two loose nuts, with a 1 cm scale bar. The capped acorn shows kind, shape and cap clearly.

Flowering branch with many tulip-shaped leaves crowded around yellow-orange flowers; the leaf outline is readable on some leaves but small and competing with the flowers, so alone is false and shape is search.
Crowded, overlapping leaves around a green flower bud; a few leaves show the notched tulip outline but most are tilted, overlapped or cut by the frame, so shape is search and whole is false.
Seed-plate photo on black: a capped acorn in side view, a loose nut, a cap from above and a nut from below. The capped acorn shows kind, shape and cap clearly.
Green, full-size acorns with scaly caps sitting on twigs among lobed leaves; they are unripe, and the twigs and leaves compete with them in the frame, so alone is false.
Mature grey trunk with both edges in frame, showing shallow vertical ridges and furrows clearly in even light.
A view up into the crown of yellowing autumn leaves; the leaves blend into a mass and no single outline stands out. Angle from below; autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn.
A wide view of the crown in flower; leaves blend into a mass and the flowers draw the eye. Single leaf outlines are hard to pick out.
A mature trunk with both edges in frame shows the interlacing furrows clearly. Lichen patches partly mask the bark colour; the street background is soft and does not compete.
One whole green leaf on a dark plain background with the notched apex and lobes clear. A few small spots do not change the outline.
One whole green four-lobed leaf with the truncate notched apex, against fallen autumn leaves. Pale surface with raised veins suggests the underside.
A leafy branch with several whole lobed leaves and a flower bud at the centre; the leaves crowd each other, so alone is false. The truncate leaf shape reads on the central leaves.
A flowering twig where the two open flowers are the focus; the leaves are tilted and partly in shade around them. Flowers take the place of the leaf feature.
A view up into a branch tip against blue sky in warm low sun; small leaves blend into a mass. Angle from below and warm light change the look.
A close frame of mature bark showing interlacing ridges and furrows clearly. No trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so too_close is true.

A low sprout at ground level among other plants, seen from above, with irregular deeply lobed leaves unlike the typical four-lobed mature leaf. This looks like a sucker or sprout leaf form, which stays a reject.
Straight trunk with both edges in frame. The interlacing furrows and narrow ridges read clearly against a dark, plain background.
Close-up of furrowed bark with interlacing ridges and no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close. Heavy yellow lichen hides the true bark colour.
The camera looks up the trunk into a green crown, so the bark is foreshortened and the branches compete with it. Dappled sun and shade fall across the lower trunk.
Trunk with both edges in frame and shallow interlacing furrows that show whitish in the grooves. The background is dark and plain.
Two children stand in front of a very large trunk. They hide the lower bark and draw the eye from it. The ridged bark above them is readable only with study, and it sits in forest shade.
Sunlit trunk with both edges visible and clear interlacing ridges and furrows. A road and a fence are behind it but do not compete.
Wide trunk with both edges in frame and deep interlacing furrows with pale grooves, against sky and foliage.

Close-up of old bark with no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close. The ridges run diagonally with crinkled knobby plates between them, unlike the typical vertical interlacing furrows, so this marks it atypical.
A large trunk in a forest, seen from a distance with yellow fallen leaves around it. The bark is in deep shade and dark, so the furrows are readable only with study.
Several trunks seen from a distance in a leafless winter scene, with a dark trunk and a vine-covered trunk beside the main one. Branch shadows fall across the bark, and the fine furrows need study.
One dry brown cone of samaras sits upright on its twig against a soft green background. The outer samaras are spreading, and the whole cone and its stalk show clearly.

A top view of a cone that has shed its upper samaras, against snow. The basal samaras spread into a star around the bare axis, so the photo looks like a flower. The angle hides the cone outline and the way it sits on the twig, so kind and shape need close study.
A green, unripe cone of full shape stands upright on its twig, with leaves soft in the background. While the cone is green and closed, its samaras are hard to see, so kind is at search.
A ripe brown cone of samaras is lit by flash against a black background, which changes the colour. Only a stub of the stalk shows, with no twig, so hang is no.
Two small open cones stand upright on a twig against busy autumn foliage. The cones are small in the frame, so kind and shape need close study, and the colourful background competes with them.
Frosted cones of samaras stand upright on winter twigs against a soft blue background. The central cone is sharp and whole. The other cones are out of focus and do not compete with it.

A fallen, weathered and bleached cone lies on leaf litter in a top-down view. The pale, weathered form is not the typical look of the fruit, and the litter and clover compete with it. Because it lies on the ground, hang is no.
A ripe brown cone with spreading samaras stands upright on its stalk, with yellowing leaves soft around it. The cone is the clear main subject.
One dry cone of samaras stands upright on a bare winter twig against soft blue sky and branches. Its outline and samaras are clear.
A view up into an autumn crown, with many small cones and a few yellow leaves against the sky. No single fruit or leaf is the subject, so the part is other. The photo looks up from below.

One spent tuliptree cone of samaras standing upright on its twig against snow; the persistent outer samaras form the tulip outline. Fruit is after seed fall, so usual_look is false; the wings of the remaining samaras need close study.

Bare winter crown seen from below against blue sky; the spent fruit cones are tiny scattered points among the branches, so the main subject is the crown, not the fruit. View from below is an angle cause.

A new shoot with several overlapping leaves, many red and not yet full grown, seen from below against a bright sky. The top leaf outline is readable but the small teeth need close study; the leaves crowd each other and are backlit and tilted.

One mature sycamore leaf with shallow lobes and coarse teeth hangs from its twig against a dark background, the stalk joining the twig in view. The leaf is backlit, which turns it a bright lime green.
A sapling or thicket of sycamore with many small leaves blending into a green mass; no single leaf outline or margin can be read at this size.
A mature sycamore leaf with toothed lobes, speckled with small dark spots, in soft shade. Other leaves overlap its lower left lobe and crowd the frame, so whole and alone are false.

Two sycamore leaves held by a hand in front of the mottled trunk; the front leaf outline is whole, the hand only holds its edge. The shallow teeth are small at this size, and the second leaf and the bright bark compete with the subject.
One large mature sycamore leaf with clear lobes and coarse teeth against soft grass; a second leaf fills the left fifth of the frame and competes with it.

A sunlit sycamore shoot with several green mature leaves, the top-left leaf whole with clear lobes and teeth and stalks joining the stem. Several overlapping leaves crowd the frame; autumn colour shows only in the background.
A mature sycamore leaf seen from below, tilted and backlit so it glows yellow-green, with darker leaves overlapping above. The lobes read, but the teeth need close study.

One whole lobed sycamore leaf against a black night background, shot with flash, with a few brown spots that do not change the outline. The flash light sets light; the petiole runs to the twig at the top but the join is small, so arrangement is search.
A scene of the base of a multi-stemmed tree with a hollow, mottled white and brown trunks among green undergrowth. The main subject is the whole lower tree, so part is other.
One whole pale green lobed leaf against a soft gravel background, with the petiole running out of frame toward the twig. Outline and toothed margin are easy to read; arrangement needs a search.
A view up into a bare winter crown with mottled limbs against blue sky. The main subject is the crown, so part is other; the upward view is an angle.

A leafy shoot laid on grey deck boards, showing several whole lobed leaves and their alternate attachment on the twig. Leaves overlap and crowd each other, so alone is false; the bottom leaves are cut by the frame but the upper ones are whole.

The lower trunk and root flare of a street tree beside a curb with parked cars, showing dark scaly bark above and pale flaking patches at the base. Taken from a distance with a busy street scene, so texture and pattern are search and alone is false.
A trunk with peeling plates exposing pale cream inner bark, with smooth whitish limbs crossing the top of the frame. The warm, film-like light shifts the colours somewhat, so light is listed.

A full-size lobed leaf in the centre with its petiole joining a twig that carries a young flower or fruit head and new shoots, a sign of spring. Several overlapping leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false; a few small holes do not change the outline.

The camera looks up the upper trunk into white mottled limbs against blue sky, with bare twigs crossing in front. Looking up into the crown makes this a bark_up_or_dark reject; the mottled patch pattern itself is readable.
A close, sharp view of smooth bark with a camouflage mosaic of olive, white and reddish flaking patches. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close is true.
A green, full-size seed ball on its stalk against a leaf; the ball is not ripe, so unripe and not the usual look. Only the stalk shows, not the twig, so hang is search.
The base of an old trunk with a root flare, seen from a distance; texture and pattern are search. A curb, a road and a red car compete in the frame.
The camera looks up into a bare crown of white branches against the sky, so it is a bark_up_or_dark reject. The view from below is the angle cause.
A brown, ripe seed ball lying on a log among dead leaves, with a small fragment beside it. It is off the twig, so hang is no.
A tall trunk with flaking plates over pale inner bark in a winter wood; the peeling pattern reads clearly. The other trunks behind it are soft and do not compete.
Many small seed balls hang from bare twigs against the sky, seen from below at a distance. The balls are small in the frame, so the features are search, and the view from below is the angle cause.

A trunk seen looking up, with white upper bark and mottled, scaly lower bark; the contrast reads clearly but the texture is small. Branches, leaves and wires crowd the frame, and the upward view is the angle cause.
A brown, ripe seed ball hangs on its stalk against a soft background of winter branches and sky. The twig is out of frame, so hang is search.
A close view of mottled, patchy bark with a knot. The patchwork reads clearly, but there is no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close is true.
A smooth trunk with mottled grey, green and cream patches and its edges in view. Leaves in front of the trunk and around it compete, so alone is false.

One dry seed ball hanging from its stalk against a soft sky, breaking apart with the hairy seeds splaying out, so it is atypical and past seed fall. It still reads as a seed ball, and the outline and hang are clear.
Many ripe brown seed balls hang singly on long stalks from bare twigs against a plain blue sky. The view is from below, which is an angle cause. The balls are fairly small but read clearly.

A green mature lobed leaf held in a hand, upper side, with a few disease spots that do not change the outline. The frame cuts off the top lobe tip and the right lobe, so whole is false, and other leaves crowd the background, so alone is false.

A small young spiky fruit ball hangs on its stalk below a twig with an unfolding young leaf, against a soft green background. It is young and not at full shape (it may be close to the flower-head stage), but it still reads as a seed ball.
One full-size green seed ball hangs on its stalk in front of a soft background of yellowing autumn leaves. The fruit is not ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false.

A fallen, broken seed ball lies on a log. Its hairy seeds have spread out flat around the core, so the form is atypical and the kind and outline take study to read. It is off the twig, so the hang is not shown.
Five ripe brown seed balls hang singly on long stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. The kind, outline, and hang are all clear.
A large yellow-green seed ball hangs on its green stalk from bare twigs, with brown balls soft in the background. It is full size but not ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false.
One full-size green seed ball hangs on a long stalk from a bare twig against a plain, soft grey background. It is not yet ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false.

A scene of a path lined with planetrees in full summer leaf. It shows whole trees and crowns, with no single leaf, bark area, or fruit as the subject, so the part is other. The source name matches the tree.

A sharp spray of green leaves in front of a softer, patchy planetree trunk. The leaves overlap and the left frame edge cuts them, so the outline needs a search, whole is false, and the bark competes with the leaves.

One large lobed leaf held against a mottled trunk, with a hand and another leaf at the top. The right edge of the frame cuts the right lobe, so whole is false, and the patchy bark and the leaf above compete with it.
A dense crown of overlapping green leaves with a diagonal branch. The leaves blend into a mass, and no single leaf outline stands out.
A sharp view of a trunk with both edges in the frame. The flaking brown plates over cream and grey-green patches show the camouflage pattern clearly.
A sunlit trunk with both edges against the sky and a soft background. The peeling brown plates over cream and green patches, with some lichen, are clear.
One shallowly lobed leaf held in a hand, which looks like the paler underside, with a few small spots. The hand covers the leaf base, so whole is false.
A fallen brown leaf on grass, with other dead leaves overlapping its lower lobes. The subject is a dead leaf.
A view from below into a leafy branch with one small green seed ball hanging, and a parked car behind. The leaves are crowded and lit from behind against a bright sky, so the outlines need a search.
A street scene lined with planetrees, with cyclists. No leaf, bark, or fruit is the main subject.
A sharp, deeply lobed leaf against a dark, soft background. Its stalk joins the shoot, where smaller leaves sit below.

Several green seed balls hang one per long stalk among leaves, shot from below against blue sky. They are small in the frame and the leaves compete with them (shape search, alone false). The view from below is the angle cause, the green balls are unripe, and no stalk carries two heads.
A trunk with its right edge showing and fallen leaves behind it. Heavy green-grey lichen covers much of the patchy flaking pattern, so the pattern and the colour need close study.
A close-up of smooth bark with jigsaw-shaped peeling plates. It is texture only, with no trunk edge or scale. Warm low side light with deep shadow changes the colour (light).
The camera looks up a large forked trunk into a bare winter crown against the bright sky. The upward view and the backlight darken the bark, so the texture is hard to read (bark_up_or_dark reject).
A full trunk with both edges in the frame, showing a pale mottled bark of small jigsaw flakes. The pattern and colour read clearly, and the plants behind it are soft.

Overlapping backlit lobed leaves seen from below, beside a trunk with peeling bark. The crowded, overlapping leaves make the outline and margin a search (whole false, alone false). The view from below is the angle cause and the backlight is the light cause.
A trunk with both edges in the frame and smooth bark in white, green-grey, and tan exfoliating patches. The patchwork pattern is clear against the soft green woods.
A close-up of rough, scaly old bark with flaking plates. It is texture only, with no edge or scale. Warm sidelight and deep shade on the right change the colour (light).
A frame-filling close-up of camouflage-patch exfoliating bark in green, yellow, cream, and brown. The pattern is very clear, but the frame is texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.
A narrow trunk with both edges against a plain white building. The patchy brown, cream, and green flaking bark reads clearly, and the small file is sharp.

A crowded spray of green foliage with a few tiny fruit balls; the central leaf overlaps others and its lobes and margin must be searched for. Crowded leaves, so alone is false and the key features are at search; no single leaf outline is whole.
A single green spiky seed ball on its stalk, cradled in a hand under a leaf. Full shape but green and unripe, so usual_look is false; the hand support hides how it hangs, and only one ball shows.

A fallen brown seed ball breaking up on pavement, with loose hairy achenes around it, seen from above. The breaking ball is atypical and the top view is an unusual angle; the ball is still round and readable.

A small yellow-green seed ball hanging on a long stalk in an autumn scene with brown backlit leaves and a trunk behind. The ball is small in the frame and competes with the leaves; warm low sun changes the colours.
A single green spiky seed ball hanging from its stalk among green leaves. Full shape but green and unripe, so usual_look is false.
A single green spiky seed ball on a dangling stalk against a soft green background; small file but sharp. The twig attachment is out of frame, and the ball is unripe.
Two brown ripe seed balls in a chain on one stalk against a soft winter sky with bare twigs. The stalk to the twig shows only in part.

Several brown seed balls hanging on long stalks from bare twigs, seen from below against blue sky. The view from below is an unusual angle and the backlight darkens the balls; several balls and twigs compete, and no pair on one stalk shows clearly.
A single brown seed ball hanging from a twig among large green leaves, seen from below. Backlight darkens the ball and the view from below is an unusual angle; the big leaves compete with it.
Two green spiky seed balls in a chain on one stalk hanging below a leaf, with a third behind. Full shape but green and unripe, so usual_look is false.

One brown, ripe seed ball on a short stalk, held in a hand over soft fallen-leaf litter; the round outline and bristly seed-ball surface are easy to read. The hand means hang is not shown, and only one ball is in the frame, so two_heads is no. The ball is starting to look fuzzy but is still whole.

results.description: A single red maple leaf in autumn colour, red and yellow-green, on a thin twig in front of hemlock needles. A smaller part-coloured leaf sits below it and the forest floor is behind.
results.note: One whole three-lobed leaf with a toothed edge is easy to read. Its autumn colour makes it not the usual look. The stalk join is hidden, so arrangement is not shown.

results.description: Backlit autumn foliage: drooping orange-red and yellow leaves hang from thin twigs against a dark, soft background. Many leaves overlap and are folded or seen edge-on.
results.note: The leaves are crowded, drooping and tilted, so you have to search for the outline and edge of any one leaf. Strong backlight changes the colour.

results.description: Ground covered in fallen leaves: many red maple leaves lie among brown oak and other dead leaves. Each leaf is small in the frame, and the leaves overlap.
results.note: The subject is dead fallen leaf litter, and much of it is brown. The red maple leaves are small and overlapping, so you have to search for the outline and edge.

results.description: A sapling branch with several red maple leaves in autumn colour, mixed red and green, against a forest-floor background with a thin grey stem. Two central leaves show their full three-lobed outline.
results.note: The central leaves show the lobes and the toothed edge, but many leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false. The autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

results.description: A single red fallen maple leaf lies on brown leaf litter, next to a small mushroom and pine needles. A smaller red leaf fragment is at the lower right.
results.note: The leaf is a dead fallen leaf on the ground among brown litter, so it is a dead-leaf reject. Its outline and edge would otherwise be readable.

results.description: A leafy branch of green summer red maple leaves with red stalks, several overlapping, in front of more dark foliage. A few leaves at the top show their pale undersides.
results.note: The leaves are green and mature but crowded and overlapping, so you have to search for the outline and edge of any one leaf. The red stalks are visible, but their joins to the twig are hard to read.

results.description: A scene of a young red maple sapling with red, orange and yellow autumn leaves, with taller green trees, water and asters behind. The leaves are small in the frame and blend together.
results.note: It shows a sapling whose leaves blend into a coloured mass. The leaf edge cannot be seen and the outline is barely traceable.

results.description: A shoot of red maple leaves in autumn colour, yellow-green, orange and red, with opposite red stalks joining the stem. A background of more red leaves is slightly soft.
results.note: The top leaf shows a full three-lobed outline with toothed edges, and the opposite stalk joins are visible. Neighbouring leaves crowd the frame, and the autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

results.description: A single green red maple leaf hangs from a red stalk against a soft, dark green background. The three-lobed blade, toothed edge and main veins are plain.
results.note: A clean single mature leaf on a soft background with the full outline and edge shown. The stalk runs up to the twig at the top, but the join is near the frame edge.

results.description: A close view of one red maple leaf turning red and green in autumn. It fills most of the frame, and other coloured leaves surround it.
results.note: The lobes, the double-toothed edge and the veins are easy to read, but the frame edge cuts off the left lobe tip, so whole is false. Neighbouring leaves crowd it, and the autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

results.description: A sunlit branch of yellow autumn leaves fills the left and centre of the frame against a blue sky. A red-leaved tree and a white building stand in the background on the right.
results.note: Many overlapping yellow leaves blend into a mass, and no single leaf shows its lobes or margin clearly at this size, so the margin is no. Bright sun and backlight against the sky change the colour, and the autumn colour sets the growth stage to autumn.

results.description: A whole moss-covered trunk stands on a grassy slope, with bare branches overhead and woodland behind. The bark shows long, shaggy vertical strips, partly hidden under moss near the base.
results.note: The trunk is shown from a distance, and moss covers much of the lower bark, so the texture, pattern, and colour need close study.

results.description: Three trunks rise from one base on a lawn, with dark grey, ridged, scaly bark. Sunlight shines from behind, between the stems.
results.note: The ridges and scaly plates read well on the outer trunks. Backlight behind the stems washes out the middle trunk.

results.description: A close view of grey bark with scaly, flaking plates divided by dark vertical fissures. The edges of the frame are soft from shallow depth of field.
results.note: The centre is sharp and shows the scaly plates and fissures well. There is no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so it is too close.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame from edge to edge, with grey bark in long, narrow, shaggy vertical strips. Ferns and green forest stand behind it.
results.note: A clear view of mature bark, with the trunk edges in the frame and the strip pattern easy to read.

results.description: A trunk with smooth, light grey bark that is starting to break into narrow brown fissures and flaky strips. Both trunk edges are in the frame, against a dark green background.
results.note: The bark is in the smooth-to-fissured transition of a younger trunk, so it is not the usual mature look. The surface and fissures read clearly.

results.description: The camera looks up a trunk into a leafy crown, with a small white birdhouse fixed to the bark. A strong sun flare fills the upper right.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so the bark is foreshortened, and the sun flare washes it out. The birdhouse competes with the bark as a subject.

results.description: A close, frame-filling view of grey bark with long, narrow vertical ridges and flaking strips, spotted with pale lichen.
results.note: The ridges and strips are sharp and easy to read. There is no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close.

results.description: A slender trunk with smooth, dark grey bark and pale lichen patches stands in an autumn forest. Red and yellow leaves cover the ground and the trees behind.
results.note: The young, smooth bark is narrow in the frame and seen from a distance, so its features need close study. The busy autumn background competes with the trunk.

results.description: A small photo of a broad trunk with shaggy, loose, grey-brown plates and strips curling away from it. A hand at the left edge gives scale.
results.note: Old, shaggy bark with the plate pattern easy to read. The hand is a scale object and does not hide the bark.

results.description: Leafless red maple branches loaded with clusters of red samaras, seen from below against a blue sky and a pine crown. The fruit clusters are many and small in the frame.
results.note: Many red samara clusters crowd the frame, so each samara's outline and wing are small and need a search. The view is from below into the branches (angle).

results.description: A close cluster of pink-tan red maple samaras hanging on long red stalks from a twig. Young green leaves are soft in the background.
results.note: Sharp, full-size paired samaras hanging on long stalks against a soft background; nothing makes it harder.

results.description: The lower trunk and fork of a tree standing in a lawn, with grey bark in shallow ridges and some lichen. The trunk is seen from a few metres away.
results.note: The whole trunk base shows the shallow vertical ridge pattern, but from this distance the surface texture needs a closer look (texture at search).

results.description: Close view of overlapping green-and-pink samaras in sunlight against a dark background. Several pairs crowd and overlap each other.
results.note: Full-size but still green samaras (unripe) overlap so outlines need a search; strong sun on a dark background changes the colour (light).

results.description: A close-up of rough bark with scaly plates and dark furrows in warm sunlight. The frame shows only bark surface.
results.note: Plates and furrows read clearly, but the frame is texture only with no trunk edge or scale (too_close); warm low sun tints the colour (light).

results.description: A cluster of narrow red samaras on long red stalks hanging from a twig, seen against blue sky and blurred red-budded branches. The wings look still developing.
results.note: The samaras look young and not at full shape, so their outline needs a search; the view is upward against the sky (angle).

results.description: A branch with many pale tan samara clusters among young green leaves, seen from below against the sky, with a house in the background.
results.note: Samaras are small among competing leaves and branches, so shape, hang, and wing need a search; the upward, backlit view adds angle and light.

results.description: A close-up of grey-brown bark with shallow furrows and flaky, scaly plates. The frame shows only bark surface.
results.note: Sharp scaly plates and shallow furrows read clearly; the frame is texture only with no trunk edge or scale (too_close).

results.description: Clusters of pink-tan red maple samaras hanging on long red stalks from a twig, with a young green leaf and soft foliage behind.
results.note: Sharp, full-size samaras hang on long stalks against a soft background; nothing makes it harder.

results.description: Small young red samaras on upright green stalks, just after flowering, against a dark soft background. Only the top pairs are in sharp focus.
results.note: The samaras are tiny and young, not at full shape, so the fruit kind and outline need a search (young); proposing not_for fruit_kind because the form is far from the mature samara.

results.description: A single sugar maple leaf hangs from its long petiole against a near-black shaded background. The five-lobed outline with its few coarse, blunt teeth is complete and lit hard, so the green looks grey-blue.
results.note: One whole mature leaf, clear lobes and margin on a dark background. Strong flash-like light turns the green a grey-blue, so light is a cause.

results.description: Several clusters of red-pink paired samaras hang from a bare twig in bright spring sun. The background is a soft blur of more red fruit and blue sky.
results.note: Red maple samaras in full shape, hanging in clusters from the twig, with a soft background. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A sugar maple branch with several green leaves seen from below in a park, a lawn and trunks behind. The large front leaf shows its lobes, but other leaves overlap and crowd the frame, and some have brown spots.
results.note: Crowded leaves on a busy background, so alone is false and shape and margin need a search. The leaves are tilted and seen from below, so angle is a cause; the brown spots do not change the outline.

results.description: Two clusters of red-orange samaras hang from pale branches against a black night background. The flash lights the fruit and branches strongly.
results.note: Red maple samara clusters hanging from the twig, clear kind and wings. The flash on a black background changes the colour, so light is a cause.

results.description: A single sugar maple leaf, upper side, laid flat on a black background like a scan. The five lobes, smooth sinuses, few pointed teeth, and petiole are all sharp.
results.note: A textbook whole mature leaf on a plain background. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A bare red maple twig with many long drooping red stalks, each ending in a tiny pair of young fruit just after flowering. The background is a cloudy bright sky and blurred branches.
results.note: Very young samaras on long pedicels, the wings barely formed and small in the frame, so kind and shape need a search and young is a cause. The bright overcast sky backlights the fruit, so light is a cause.

results.description: A pile of fallen sugar maple leaves in autumn colours of red, orange, and yellow, many with dark spots. The central yellow-orange leaf shows its lobes, but other leaves overlap it.
results.note: Crowded overlapping leaves cover parts of the central leaf, so whole and alone are false and shape and margin need a search. Autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn and usual_look false; the leaves are coloured, not brown, and the spots do not change the outline.

results.description: Several clusters of red samaras hang from a pale twig against a clear blue sky. The paired wings and their stalks are sharp.
results.note: Red maple samaras in full shape, hanging from the twig on a plain sky. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A single green sugar maple leaf, upper side, lies flat on wood-chip mulch with its petiole. The five lobes and sparse pointed teeth are complete and sharp.
results.note: One whole mature leaf that stands out from the mulch. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A sugar maple crown in full orange and yellow autumn colour against a blue sky. The leaves are small and blend into one mass of colour among the branches.
results.note: A crown view where the leaves blend into a mass, so leaf_mass; no single leaf margin can be read, so feature_unclear. Autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn and usual_look false.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the middle of the frame, with both edges visible against a brick building and a sidewalk. The bark is grey-brown, with long, narrow plates that curl away from the trunk at their edges.
results.note: A sharp, evenly lit trunk with its edges in frame. The long, curling plates of mature sugar maple bark read clearly.

results.description: A single green palmate leaf lies flat on a white background, upper side up, with its petiole showing. It has five pointed lobes with a few large teeth, and the veins are clearly visible.
results.note: One whole, sharp leaf on a plain background. Arrangement and size cannot be read, because there is no twig and no scale object.

results.description: A sapling stands in a garden bed among hostas, with lawn and arborvitae behind it. Its many small leaves blend into one mass, and no single leaf can be read.
results.note: A whole sapling in a busy garden scene. The leaves blend into a mass, so the photo is a leaf_mass reject.

results.description: A large palmate leaf hangs from above and shows its pale underside, with prominent veins and shallow, sparsely toothed lobes. A second leaf overlaps below it, in front of a soft background of foliage.
results.note: The underside is seen from below, which is an unusual angle. The petiole runs to the top edge, so you have to search for its joint with the twig. There is no scale object.

results.description: A trunk covered in lichen, with both edges visible, stands among green undergrowth. The bark is grey with shaggy vertical ridges and plates, and a thin vine crosses it.
results.note: The ridge and plate pattern reads well. Patches of lichen hide the true bark colour, so colour is search.

results.description: An old, forked, multi-stemmed tree is shot from low down, with the camera tilted up into a crown of yellow autumn leaves against a blue sky. The bark of the trunk is seen from a distance, in dappled light.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so this is a bark_up_or_dark reject. The bark is far away and in dappled sun and shade, so its texture and pattern need a search.

results.description: A close-up of bark texture fills the frame, with no trunk edge and no scale object. The bark shows thick, flaky, vertical plates and fissures, with a strong reddish-orange cast.
results.note: The frame shows texture only, so too_close is true. Warm light or a tone gives the normally grey bark a reddish cast, so colour is search and light is a cause.

results.description: A leafy sapling grows in a garden bed among hostas, with a wooden fence, a conifer trunk, and a house behind it. Its leaves overlap into a mass, and no single leaf outline stands out.
results.note: A whole sapling in a busy garden scene. The leaves blend into a mass, so the photo is a leaf_mass reject.

results.description: Seen from below, a crown of bright orange and red autumn leaves fills the frame, with dark branches and small gaps of sky. No single leaf stands out from the mass.
results.note: A crown of autumn leaves seen from below and backlit, with the leaves blended into a mass, so the photo is a leaf_mass reject. Autumn colour is not the usual look.

results.description: Fallen autumn leaves lie in a pile on the ground, yellow, orange, red, and brown. A yellow leaf in the centre and an orange one above it show palmate lobes, but other leaves overlap them.
results.note: The subject is a pile of dead fallen leaves, so the photo is a dead_leaf reject. The leaves are crowded and overlap one another, and their autumn colour is not the usual look.

results.description: A sugar maple twig on a black background, lit by flash, with several lobed green leaves above and a large drooping cluster of paired samaras below. The samaras have green seeds and pale tan wings and hang on long slender stalks from the twig.
results.note: Unripe samara cluster hanging from the twig; the pairs overlap so the single-fruit outline takes study, and the leaves compete with the fruit. Flash on a black background brightens the colours.

results.description: A large grey sugar maple trunk forking into limbs, shot slightly upward against a blue sky with bare winter trees around. The bark shows irregular scaly plates with patches of moss.
results.note: Old trunk with plated bark; the upward camera angle and moss make the plate pattern take some study, but the lower trunk is readable.

results.description: A large trunk of a mature sugar maple in front of a brick building. The bark is broken into long vertical shaggy plates and furrows, grey-brown in colour.
results.note: Clear view of the long vertical plates of an old trunk; trunk edges and context visible.

results.description: A view from the base of a huge old sugar maple looking straight up the trunk into the crown, with burls, broken limbs, and green leaves overhead. The lower trunk shows ridged grey bark.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so the bark is foreshortened and the ridge pattern is only readable at the base with study.

results.description: A single dry sugar maple samara pair on a plain purple background with a 1 cm scale bar. The two wings spread in a U shape from the paired seeds, and the stalk is attached.
results.note: Clean specimen photo of a ripe double samara with a scale bar; detached, so hang is not shown.

results.description: A sugar maple trunk filling the frame from bottom to top, with trees, lawn, and a red building in the background. The bark has rough vertical ridges and plates lifting at their edges.
results.note: Plated, ridged bark readable along a whole trunk with its edges in view.

results.description: A close frame of sugar maple bark with no trunk edge visible. The surface shows irregular grey plates and furrows with green lichen patches in sunlight.
results.note: Texture-only frame with no trunk edge or scale object; the plates and furrows themselves are readable.

results.description: A close frame of grey sugar maple bark with no trunk edge. Long vertical plates curl away from the trunk at their edges, separated by darker furrows.
results.note: Texture-only frame, but the curling vertical plates are clearly shown.

results.description: A sugar maple trunk in front of a brick building, shot slightly upward. The bark shows dark grey scaly plates and shallow furrows.
results.note: Plated bark readable along the trunk with its edges and context in view.

results.description: The lower part of an old gnarled sugar maple standing in tall grass, with mossy limbs spreading above. The trunk bark is pale and fairly smooth with some shallow ridges, seen from a few metres away in dappled sun.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance, so the ridge pattern takes study; dappled sun warms and patches the bark colour.

results.description: A single half-samara of sugar maple lies on snow. The seed has germinated and a pale yellow-green root is growing out of it. Nothing else is in the frame.
results.note: One fallen, germinating samara on snow. This is atypical because it is a single half with a root, not the paired samara on the twig. It still reads as a samara, so not_for is empty. It has fallen, so hang is no, and the stage is after seed fall.

results.description: A cluster of paired sugar maple samaras hangs from long stalks. The seeds are green and the wings are tan. A large leaf sits at the right edge, against a soft green background.
results.note: The paired samaras hang clearly from their stalks, and the wings are easy to read. The seeds are still green, so the stage is unripe and usual_look is false.

results.description: White oak leaves are seen from below against the sky. A branch and trunk are behind them. Several deeply lobed leaves overlap, and the one in the centre shows in full.
results.note: The central leaf shows its lobes and smooth edge clearly. The leaves are crowded, so alone is false. The view from below adds angle, and the backlight from the sky adds light.

results.description: A whorl of deeply lobed white oak leaves radiates from the tip of a twig, seen from above. A dark mass of more leaves fills the background.
results.note: The lobed outlines and the clustered stalks at the twig tip are clear. The leaves overlap and more foliage fills the background, so alone is false.

results.description: A close view of one lobed white oak leaf. It has several holes and a row of yellow galls near one lobe. The frame cuts off its top and left side, and other leaves sit soft around it.
results.note: The rounded lobes and smooth margin read clearly. The frame cuts off part of the leaf, so whole is false. The holes and galls along a lobe change the outline, so it is damaged.

results.description: A dense cluster of sugar maple samaras hangs from a twig, with a few leaves at the left. The black background shows that a flash was used.
results.note: The samaras hang from the twig, and the outer pairs show their wing shape. The flash and black background change the colour, so light is a cause. The seeds are still green, so the stage is unripe.

results.description: A white oak branch with lobed leaves stands against a bright sky and a sunlit wood. A small cluster of green acorns sits near the centre. The leaves are the main subject.
results.note: Many overlapping leaves are each small in the frame, so the shape and margin need study and alone is false. Strong sun and backlight from the sky change the colour. The acorns are too small to be the subject.

results.description: A white oak branch with many wet, lobed green leaves hangs over a forest floor of pine needles. Each leaf is fairly small in the frame.
results.note: The lobed outlines of many leaves read clearly, but the leaves are crowded, so alone is false. Vein detail and the stalk joins are small and need study.

results.description: A cluster of dry brown sugar maple samaras hangs from its stalks. Bare branches and blue sky are blurred behind them, and warm low sun lights the wings.
results.note: Ripe paired samaras hang clearly against a soft background. The warm low sun tints the colour, so light is a cause.

results.description: One lobed white oak leaf is lit against a dark, shadowed background. Its base runs off the bottom of the frame, where another leaf overlaps it.
results.note: The rounded lobes and smooth margin are clear. The frame cuts off the leaf base, so whole is false. The flash-like light on a deep-shade background gives the leaf a cool grey-blue cast, so light is a cause.

results.description: A view from the base of a forked trunk looking straight up into a green, sunlit crown. The lower trunk shows grey, scaly bark, but most of the frame is limbs and backlit foliage.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so the bark recedes and the sky behind it backlights the trunk. You can make out the plate pattern only on the lower trunk, with close study.

results.description: Two clusters of green acorns with warty, knobby caps sit on a twig among rounded-lobed oak leaves. The front cluster is sharp and central, and the large leaves fill the rest of the frame.
results.note: The acorns are full-size but still green, so they are unripe. The large leaves around the clusters compete with them for attention.

results.description: A wide trunk fills most of the frame, with light grey bark in long, scaly, loose plates. The left edge of the trunk shows, and the background is a soft lawn and trees.
results.note: Mature bark in even light. The scaly, flaky plates read clearly, and the trunk edge shows.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame, with grey bark broken into small, blocky, scaly plates. Both trunk edges show against a soft background of lawn and foliage.
results.note: Clear, evenly lit mature bark. The pattern of small plates repeats across the frame.

results.description: A close view of one green acorn with a warty cap, resting behind the edge of a large lobed leaf. The leaf fills most of the frame, and the lower part of the cap is hidden behind it.
results.note: The leaf edge hides part of the cap and dominates the frame, so whole and alone are false. The acorn is green and unripe, and the photo does not show how it attaches to the twig.

results.description: A sunlit branch holds many deeply lobed oak leaves, set against a lawn and a dense tree behind. The leaves overlap and crowd together, though several single outlines can be traced.
results.note: The leaves are crowded and small in the frame, so the lobing and the edge need a search to read. This is a branch, not a crown, so it is not a leaf mass.

results.description: The trunk of a forest-grown tree, with grey bark broken into small, blocky, scaly plates. Both trunk edges show against a woodland background.
results.note: The bark plates read clearly, and the trunk edges show. The busy woodland behind is far enough back not to compete.

results.description: A large trunk fills the frame, with dark grey, ridged, scaly bark. Patchy sunlight streaks across it, and a brick building shows at the left edge.
results.note: Strong dappled sun and shadow over the trunk change the colour and the contrast, so light is a cause. The ridges and plates can still be read.

results.description: A trunk in a sunny lawn, with light grey bark in shallow, scaly, flaking plates. Both trunk edges show, with a soft background of a path and buildings.
results.note: Clear mature bark in even light. The flaky, scaly plates read well.

results.description: A studio photo of two ripe, tan, oblong acorns on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar. One nut is bare, and the other sits in its warty, bowl-shaped cup.
results.note: A clear specimen photo of ripe acorns, one with its cap, with a scale bar. The photo does not show how the fruit hangs on the twig, which is normal for a specimen shot.

results.description: A ground litter of dead, brown oak leaves in warm low sun with deep shadows. One large bristle-lobed leaf fills the centre, surrounded and overlapped by other dead leaves.
results.note: The subject is a dead brown leaf on the ground, so it is a reject. Other leaves crowd it, and low warm sun with hard shadows changes the colour.

results.description: A cluster of three green acorns with warty caps sits on a twig among lobed green leaves. The background is a soft, out-of-focus woodland.
results.note: Full-shaped acorns attached to the twig, but still green, so unripe and not the usual look.

results.description: A cluster of green acorns with knobby caps sits on a twig, framed by lobed green leaves. A hand is faintly visible at the upper left, holding the branch.
results.note: Full-shaped acorns attached to the twig but still green, so they are unripe. Part of a hand shows at the edge and does not cover the fruit.

results.description: A whole small tree with a crown of red autumn leaves stands among conifers on a forested hillside. No single leaf can be picked out.
results.note: A whole tree in a scene, so the part is other. The red leaves blend into a crown mass, and no leaf outline or margin can be read.

results.description: A branch of red autumn oak leaves stretches across a soft background of dark conifer foliage. The leaves are fairly small in the frame and overlap one another.
results.note: The leaves are small and crowded on the spray and slightly soft, so outline and margin need close study. Autumn colour gives growth_stage autumn and not the usual look.

results.description: A whorl of green, bristle-lobed oak leaves at a shoot tip, seen from above over a brown forest floor. More green leaves sit behind on the right.
results.note: The leaves are sharp, with readable lobes and bristle tips. Other leaves behind and around the cluster compete, so alone is false.

results.description: Four ripening acorns with knobby caps hang among dark green lobed leaves. The colours are saturated, and the dark background suggests flash.
results.note: The acorns are sharp and full-shaped, with a reddish-tan colour. Flash-like lighting and a dark background shift the colour, and where they attach to the twig is only partly visible.

results.description: A single large bristle-lobed oak leaf, seen from below against bright sky and woodland. Sun shines through it and lights up the pale midrib and veins.
results.note: The whole leaf outline and its bristle-tipped lobes are clear. Backlight changes the leaf colour, and the stalk does not show where it joins the twig.

results.description: A single green acorn with a warty cap sits on a twig among long green leaves. The background is soft and leafy.
results.note: A sharp, full-shaped acorn attached to the twig. It is still green, so unripe and not the usual look.

results.description: A rosette of bristle-lobed oak leaves at a shoot tip, turning yellow and orange, in bright sun against dark green foliage. The leaves overlap at the centre of the cluster.
results.note: The leaf outlines and bristle tips can be read on the outer leaves. Strong, saturated sunlight changes the colour, and the autumn colouring gives growth_stage autumn.

results.description: A view looking straight up a tall trunk into a green crown. The lower trunk fills the frame and shows grey furrowed bark with flat lighter stripes along the ridges, which narrow quickly toward the canopy.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, so the ridge pattern foreshortens above the base; this is the bark_up_or_dark reject. The lower bark texture is readable.

results.description: Low red oak leaves seen from above over a leaf-litter forest floor. One central leaf shows its full lobed outline with bristle-tipped lobes, and other leaves crowd around it.
results.note: The central leaf is whole and its lobes are readable, but the other leaves crowd it, so alone is false. There is no scale object.

results.description: A shaded branch of overlapping green red oak leaves in front of a soft background of a path and a fence. The leaves show pointed bristle-tipped lobes, but they overlap one another.
results.note: The leaves overlap, so you have to study the frame to trace one outline; shape and margin are at search and alone is false.

results.description: A backlit cluster of young, pale yellow-green oak leaves that hang from a twig tip, with a few catkins among them. The leaves are soft and drooping, and the background is a blurred woodland floor and trunk.
results.note: The new spring leaves have not reached full shape and hang limp at an angle. They are backlit, so the colour is paler than usual. A few catkins show, but the leaves stay the subject.

results.description: A small sprig of shallow-lobed green oak leaves set flat against a mossy, furrowed oak trunk. The leaves come out of one point on the bark, which suggests an epicormic shoot growing from the trunk.
results.note: The leaves grow straight out of the trunk as a sprout, so this is a sucker leaf. Their lobes are shallower than the typical mature red oak leaf.

results.description: A branch of green red oak leaves with pointed, bristle-tipped lobes, against a soft background of a slender trunk and woodland. Several leaves show their full outline, but they overlap.
results.note: The central leaves are whole and readable. Many leaves fill the frame, so alone is false.

results.description: A view from the base of a tall trunk looking up into a broad green crown. The dark trunk shows lighter flat stripes along its ridges, but the bark narrows into the canopy and is in shade.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown and the trunk is dark against a bright sky, so the bark_up_or_dark reject applies. The crown competes with the trunk for attention.

results.description: Sunlit spring twigs carry young, yellow-green oak leaves with many hanging catkins. The leaves are backlit and still soft, in front of dark conifers and a churchyard lawn.
results.note: The new leaves have not reached full shape and strong backlight turns them yellow. The leaves overlap and the catkins crowd them, but the leaf lobes are still visible.

results.description: A mass of red autumn foliage on dark branches fills the frame, in bright sunlight with some green behind. You cannot pick out one leaf from the others.
results.note: The crown leaves blend into one red mass, which is the leaf_mass reject. The autumn colour and bright sun change how the leaves look.

results.description: The full width of a large, old trunk in a park, from the ground up. The grey bark has long interlacing ridges and furrows, with a few lichen patches near the base and autumn trees in the background.
results.note: Both trunk edges and a wide area of the ridge pattern show clearly. A small dark tag on the trunk cannot be read at this size.

results.description: A tight close-up of furrowed oak bark: long, flat-topped grey ridges split by dark fissures, with yellow-green lichen flecks. Warm, low sunlight lights the surface from the side. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame.
results.note: The ridge and furrow pattern of mature red oak is easy to read. The frame shows texture only, so too_close is true, and the warm low sun shifts the bark colour (light).

results.description: A twig tip with newly unfolding tulip tree leaves on long stalks, the leaves still partly folded, and a large green stipule sheath in the middle. The background is blue sky and soft, leafless branches.
results.note: These are young spring leaves that are still folded, so the notched tulip outline takes close study (shape search, young). The stalks join the twig in view, so arrangement is clear.

results.description: One brown acorn hangs from its stalk against a soft green and pink background. The scaly cap covers the top of the nut, and the nut's whole outline shows.
results.note: A sharp, isolated, ripe acorn. Its cap, its nut outline, and how it hangs from the stalk all show clearly.

results.description: Five ripe brown acorns with their scaly caps, lying on a plain white surface. Each nut and cap shows in full, seen from the side.
results.note: These are clean, ripe acorns on a plain background. The acorns are detached, so hang is no.

results.description: A seed-plate photo on a blue background: one acorn with its shallow scaly cap and stalk, a capless nut seen from the cap scar, and a nut seen from the base. A 1 cm scale bar is in the frame.
results.note: These are sharp, ripe acorn views with a scale bar. The acorns are detached, so hang is no.

results.description: A leafy tulip tree branch with several yellow-orange tulip flowers among many overlapping lobed leaves. Some leaves show the notched, four-lobed outline, and others overlap or are cut off.
results.note: The leaves crowd and overlap, and the flowers draw the eye, so a learner must search for one clean leaf outline (alone false, shape search). The flowers mark the photo as spring.

results.description: A view up into tulip tree foliage: overlapping large leaves around a green flower bud, with gaps of bright sky. A few leaves show the notched, square-tipped outline.
results.note: The leaves are crowded, overlapping and seen from below, so the outline takes searching (alone false, shape search, angle). The flower bud is a spring sign.

results.description: Four acorn views on a black background: a scaly cap from above, a nut from the base, one acorn with its cap seen from the side, and a capless nut. All are pale tan and sharp.
results.note: These are clean seed-plate views of ripe acorns, and the side view shows the cap and nut outline. The acorns are detached, so hang is no.

results.description: Several green, unripe acorns with brown scaly caps sit on a twig among bristle-tipped lobed oak leaves. A green lawn is behind them.
results.note: The acorns are full-shape but green, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false. The leaves and twigs around them compete for attention (alone false), but how the acorns sit on the twig is clear.

results.description: A broad view of a grey oak trunk with both trunk edges in the frame. Long, flat-topped ridges are split by shallow, darker furrows. Green woodland is behind it.
results.note: This is a clear, well-lit mature red oak trunk. The ridge and furrow pattern repeats across a wide area, and the trunk edges show.

results.description: A view up into the crown of a tulip tree in autumn, with many yellow and green leaves against a white overcast sky. The leaves overlap in layers and no single leaf stands apart.
results.note: A crown seen from below in autumn colour; the leaves blend into a mass, so the outline and the margin need a search. The upward view is an angle cause and the bright sky behind backlights the leaves.

results.description: A crown of a tulip tree in leaf with several orange and yellow flowers among the leaves. Many leaves overlap and the trunk shows behind.
results.note: A crown view where the leaves blend into a mass, with flowers scattered through it; a learner must search for one leaf outline. Flowers mark spring.

results.description: A straight trunk of a tulip tree with grey bark of shallow interlacing ridges and patches of grey-green lichen. A street, a building, and a road sign are behind it.
results.note: The trunk fills the middle of the frame with both edges visible, and the ridge pattern reads clearly despite some lichen. The street background is busy but the trunk is the clear subject.

results.description: One whole tulip tree leaf on a dark background, showing the typical squared-off notched tip and side lobes. A few small spots mark the blade but do not change the outline.
results.note: A clean, whole, green mature leaf against a plain dark background; outline and margin read at a glance. Small spots do not alter the outline.

results.description: One whole green tulip tree leaf held up against a background of fallen yellow and brown leaves. The pale surface shows prominent whitish veins and the typical notched tip.
results.note: A whole green leaf with clear outline and margin; the background is soft and dark. The fallen yellow leaves behind suggest autumn, but the leaf itself is green and mature.

results.description: A leafy branch of tulip tree with several green leaves around a shoot with a flower bud in the centre. The leaves overlap, though the lower centre leaf shows its full outline.
results.note: Several leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false, but at least one leaf shows its whole outline. The flower bud is a spring sign and does not replace the leaf feature.

results.description: A twig of tulip tree with two open yellow-orange flowers and a bud, with green leaves around them against a dark green background. The flowers are the main subject.
results.note: The flowers are the main subject and take the place of a leaf, bark, or fruit feature. Leaves are present but at the frame edges.

results.description: The edge of a tulip tree crown against a blue sky, seen from below, with small leaves lit by warm low sun. Branches and leaves form a dark and bright mass.
results.note: A crown seen from below where the leaves are small and blend into a mass; the margin cannot be made out. Warm low sun and strong shadow change the leaf colour.

results.description: A close view of tulip tree bark filling the frame, with grey-brown interlacing vertical ridges and narrow furrows. No trunk edge or scale object shows.
