results.note: Sharp bark with a clear interlacing ridge pattern over several repeats. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale, so too_close is true.

results.description: A low tulip tree shoot seen from above among ground plants, with several irregular, deeply lobed leaves. The leaf forms differ from the typical four-lobed mature leaf.
results.note: The leaves come from a low sucker or seedling shoot and have irregular extra lobes, a form the source does not name for the mature tree. Other ground plants crowd the frame and the view is from above.

results.description: A straight trunk of a tulip tree fills the left and centre of a tall frame, with both trunk edges visible. The bark is grey with narrow interlacing ridges and furrows. Dark conifers and a bit of blue sky form the background.
results.note: A clear, well-lit section of mature bark that shows the interlacing ridge pattern with trunk edges in frame. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A close-up of bark with deep vertical furrows and interlacing ridges, heavily covered in yellow-green lichen. No trunk edge, branch, or scale object shows.
results.note: Texture-only frame with no trunk edge, so too_close is true. Lichen covers much of the surface, so the bark colour needs close study.

results.description: A view looking straight up a large trunk into a broad green crown. The lower trunk shows furrowed bark, but most of the frame is limbs and foliage seen from below.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so it is a bark_up_or_dark reject. The bark is foreshortened and dappled and competes with the crown.

results.description: A moderate trunk fills the frame with both edges visible, showing fairly smooth grey bark with shallow fissures and pale whitish patches. The background is green foliage in dappled light.
results.note: Younger bark with only shallow, faint fissures, so the ridge pattern takes close study. The pale blotches are typical of young tulip tree bark.

results.description: Two children stand in front of the base of a very large trunk, each holding up a small leaf. The furrowed bark of the trunk fills the background above and behind them.
results.note: The children compete with the bark and cover its lower part, so alone is false and the ridge pattern needs searching in the upper area. The people give a scale.

results.description: A straight trunk with both edges visible shows grey-brown bark with narrow interlacing ridges and pale furrows. Behind it are a railing, a path, lawn, and sky.
results.note: Clear, well-lit mature bark showing the interlacing ridge pattern, and the background is soft. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A tall trunk fills the frame with both edges visible against blue sky and green foliage. The grey bark has long interlacing ridges with pale furrows between them.
results.note: A sharp, well-lit view of the typical interlacing ridge pattern on a mature trunk. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A close-up of very rough bark with thick diagonal ridges crossing knobby, bubbly tissue, with patches of lichen. No trunk edge or scale object shows.
results.note: Texture-only frame, so too_close is true. The diagonal, twisted ridges over knobby tissue are not the typical vertical interlacing pattern, so it is atypical and should not test bark_pattern.

results.description: A huge old trunk stands in a shaded forest, seen from a distance with its flared base on a floor of fallen yellow leaves. Thin saplings and branches cross in front of it.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance in deep forest shade, so the furrows need searching and the colour is darkened. Saplings in front compete with the trunk.

results.description: Several pale trunks stand in a bare winter woodland, with shadows of branches falling across them and a dark trunk and a vine-covered trunk beside them. The central trunk shows fine interlacing ridges.
results.note: Several trunks and crossing branches compete, and the bark is seen from a distance, so the ridge pattern needs searching. The bare trees show winter.

results.description: A single ripe tulip-tree cone of samaras sitting upright at the tip of a twig, lit by sun against a soft green and blue blurred background. The lower samaras have begun to spread apart while the upper part of the cone is still intact.
results.note: Sharp, well-framed ripe cone of samaras standing upright on its twig, with the samara wings readable. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A top-down view of the persistent rosette of tulip-tree samaras left on a twig after most seeds have fallen, against snow. The bare central axis shows where the inner samaras dropped off.
results.note: Top view of a winter rosette after seed fall, so the cone outline and the kind can be read only with study (angle). The twig enters from the left, but the view from above hides how the fruit sits.

results.description: A green, unripe tulip-tree cone of samaras standing upright on its stalk among glossy green leaves. The fruit is spindle-shaped, with the overlapping samaras only faintly marked on its surface.
results.note: Full-size but green, unripe fruit, so it does not have the usual look. The samaras are still tight, so the kind and the wings need close study.

results.description: A ripe brown tulip-tree cone of samaras photographed with flash against a black background. The outer samaras flare out at the base and the tip is still intact; only a stub of the stalk shows below.
results.note: Clear, whole cone of samaras, but the flash and black background change the colour (light). There is no twig, so the photo does not show how the fruit hangs.

results.description: Two ripe, partly open tulip-tree cones of samaras sitting upright on a bare twig, in front of a busy background of orange and yellow autumn foliage. The cones are small in the frame.
results.note: The cones are small in the frame and compete with the bright autumn foliage, so the kind and the shape need a search. The twig shows clearly that they sit upright.

results.description: Frost-covered tulip-tree cones of samaras on bare twigs against a deep blue background. One intact cone is in focus at the center, with partly dispersed cones and blurred twigs around it.
results.note: The central cone is clear and sits upright on its twig, but other cones and frosted twigs compete in the frame. The frost coating hides the individual samara wings somewhat.

results.description: A fallen, weathered and bleached tulip-tree cone of samaras lying on the ground among dead leaves, twigs and a little green clover. The samaras are still in place along the axis, but they are pale and worn.
results.note: A weathered, bleached fallen cone is not the fruit's typical look (atypical), and the litter around it competes. Because it lies on the ground, the photo does not show how it sits on the twig.

results.description: A ripe tulip-tree cone of samaras opening at the top, held on its stalk in front of soft autumn foliage and a green lawn. A green tulip-tree leaf shows at the left and a second cone shows blurred at the lower right.
results.note: Sharp cone with spreading, clearly winged samaras against a soft background. The stalk shows, but the point where it joins the twig is hard to trace.

results.description: A single pale tulip-tree cone of samaras sitting upright at the end of a dark twig against a blue sky and blurred bare branches. The cone is intact, with the tips of its samaras splayed at the top.
results.note: The upright cone on its twig is clear against a soft background. The cone is small and pale, so the samara wings need a closer look.

results.description: An upward view into the crown of a tulip tree against a cloudy sky, with many small cones of samaras and a few yellow autumn leaves scattered across the branches. No single fruit or leaf is the subject.
results.note: A view from below of the crown, so the main subject is the tree and not one part (part other). The fruit is tiny and scattered across the whole frame.

results.description: A single tuliptree fruit aggregate after seed fall, standing upright on its stalk above snow. The persistent outer samaras form an open, tulip-like cup of tan woody wings. Dry weed stems are soft in the background.
results.note: Sharp, isolated winter fruit cone on its twig against plain snow; the cone of samaras and its upright set are easy to read. It is the post-seed-fall form, so not the usual ripe look.

results.description: Bare winter branches seen from below against a blue sky. Several small open tuliptree fruit aggregates, after seed fall, sit upright on the twig tips. The fruits are small in the frame among many twigs.
results.note: The fruits are tiny in a crown-like frame of twigs, so kind and shape need close study; the view is from below. Post-seed-fall cones, not the usual ripe look.

results.description: An upright leafy shoot with several sycamore leaves, some green and some reddish young leaves, photographed against bright sky and trees. The top green leaf shows its lobed outline clearly; the lower leaves crowd and overlap.
results.note: Reddish, not fully expanded leaves on a new shoot make it young and spring; the leaves are backlit against the sky and crowd each other.

results.description: A large, shallowly lobed sycamore leaf hanging from a twig, lit from behind so it glows bright green against a dark background. The coarse teeth and palmate veins are clear, and the twig shows leaf stalks joining it.
results.note: Clean whole leaf with clear outline and teeth; backlight changes its colour to a bright yellow-green.

results.description: A dense thicket of sycamore saplings or sprouts with many leaves under tall trees. No single leaf stands out; the leaves blend into a green mass.
results.note: A sapling thicket where the leaves form a mass; no leaf outline or margin can be read without close study.

results.description: A close view of a sycamore leaf with lobes and coarse teeth, speckled with small dark spots, among other leaves on a dark ground. A paler leaf with white veins sits at the lower left and a spotted leaf at the upper left.
results.note: Outline and teeth read well, but neighbouring leaves crowd the frame. Leaf spots do not change the outline.

results.description: Two sycamore leaves held in a hand over the base of a sycamore trunk with patchy white and brown peeling bark. The front leaf shows its lobed outline; the back leaf has a few small holes.
results.note: The two leaves overlap and the patchy bark behind competes for attention; the small teeth need a closer look. The hand gives scale.

results.description: A large, sunlit sycamore leaf with shallow lobes, coarse teeth and palmate veins, shown upper side against a lawn. Part of another leaf shows at the left edge.
results.note: A clean, whole, typical mature leaf against a soft lawn; the leaf stalk does not show where it joins the twig.

results.description: A sunlit sycamore branch with several lobed, toothed leaves against a dark woodland background with some autumn-coloured foliage. The upper leaves show their outlines well; the lower leaves crowd together.
results.note: The top leaves are clear and whole, but several leaves crowd the frame, so the subject is not alone.

results.description: Sycamore leaves seen from below, with a lower leaf lit from behind so it glows yellow-green over a street background. Darker leaves overlap above, and a small seed ball hangs at the left.
results.note: Seen from below and backlit, which changes the colour; other leaves overlap the main one, the frame edge clips its lobe, and the teeth are hard to read.

results.description: One large green leaf hangs from a twig against a black night background, lit by flash. The blade shows its lobes and coarse teeth well, with a few brown spots; other spotted leaves overlap its base at the top.
results.note: Main leaf outline and toothed margin are clear, but neighbouring leaves cover part of its base, so whole is false. Flash on a black background changes the colour (light); the brown spots do not change the outline.

results.description: The lower part of a large multi-stemmed tree with a hollow base, seen from a few metres away in dense summer undergrowth. The trunks show white and brown mottled, peeling bark.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance: the white-and-brown mottled pattern reads, but the surface texture needs close study. Green undergrowth and several stems compete, so alone is false.

results.description: A single pale green leaf seen from below against a soft gravel background, with its stalk running up to a twig at top right. The broad lobed outline and the coarse teeth show in full.
results.note: Whole leaf, underside, with lobes and teeth easy to read on a plain soft background. The stalk join to the twig is only partly in frame, so arrangement is search.

results.description: A view looking up into a leafless winter crown against blue sky. The trunk and limbs show mottled pale and brown bark, but a tangle of bare branches fills the frame.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, so the bark is small and distant among many branches (bark_up_or_dark). The mottling is visible only with close study.

results.description: A leafy shoot laid on grey decking, with about eight large lobed leaves on stalks along the stem. The upper leaves show full outlines and coarse teeth; the lowest leaves are cut off by the frame.
results.note: The top leaves show whole outlines and toothed margins, and the alternate stalk joins on the stem are visible. The leaves overlap each other (crowded), so alone is false.

results.description: The base of a street tree trunk on a grass verge beside a road with parked cars. The upper trunk has grey scaly bark and the root flare shows pale cream patches.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance with a street scene and cars competing, so the texture and pattern need close study. Old scaly lower trunk with pale patches at the flare.

results.description: A trunk with peeling bark that exposes cream and pale green-grey patches, with darker brown flakes along one side. Two pale branches cross in front near the top, and dry grass fills the background.
results.note: Exfoliating patchwork bark is clear, with the trunk edges in frame. The crossing branches do not hide the pattern.

results.description: A cluster of bright green lobed leaves on a twig, with a small pale flower head and new shoots in the middle. The central leaf shows its toothed lobes, but the leaves overlap and fill the frame.
results.note: The central leaf outline and teeth read well, but neighbouring leaves crowd it, so alone is false. The small flower head and new shoots mark spring; the small holes do not change the outline.

results.description: A view looking up at a large white trunk and limbs mottled with tan and grey patches, against a blue sky. Dark bare twigs and a brown branch cross in front of the trunk.
results.note: The upper trunk fills the frame and its white mottled bark reads clearly. The upward view is an unusual angle, but the bark is not lost in the crown.

results.description: A close view of a smooth trunk surface showing a camouflage patchwork of olive green, grey, cream, and small reddish flakes. No trunk edge or scale object is in the frame.
results.note: Sharp patchwork bark that shows the pattern repeat clearly. The frame is texture only with no trunk edge or scale, so too_close is true.

results.description: A green, spiky seed ball hangs on a long stalk in front of a large green leaf. The ball is full size but still green and unripe. Bright sun casts a dark shadow on the leaf behind it.
results.note: Clear, whole seed ball on its stalk against a plain leaf. It is full shape but green, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false.

results.description: The base of a large trunk at a street curb, with root flare spreading over the curb. The lower bark is dark and scaly with white patches near the roots. Grass, fallen leaves, and part of a red car are in the frame.
results.note: Old basal bark seen from a few metres away, so texture and pattern are search. The curb and car give some scale but do not cover the trunk.

results.description: A view from below up into a leafless crown against a blue sky. White, smooth upper branches and the upper trunk spread out among many dark twigs.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, a bark_up_or_dark reject. The white bark colour is clear, but the twigs crowd the frame and the surface is too far away to read.

results.description: A brown sycamore seed ball lies flattened and broken on a rotting log among dead leaves, seen from above. Its packed achenes show as a pattern of small cells, and a detached piece with tufts of achene hairs sits beside it.
results.note: A fallen seed ball that is squashed and breaking apart (atypical) and seen from the top (angle). The achene head is still readable as a seed ball, but its round outline is distorted.

results.description: A whole trunk rises through leafless winter woods. The bark peels in many thin brown plates and shows paler cream and grey patches beneath.
results.note: A clear trunk with the typical peeling plates and pale patches, framed with both edges in view. The background woods are busy but do not compete with the trunk.

results.description: Leafless twigs against a blue sky, seen from below, carry many small round seed balls on stalks. The balls are small dots in the frame.
results.note: Many ripe seed balls on bare twigs, but each one is small in the frame, so kind and shape are search. The view from below is an angle, and the many fruits and twigs compete.

results.description: A view up a tall trunk into the crown. The upper trunk and branches are white, and the lower trunk shows brown peeling patches. Green leaves frame the right side, and the image is a little soft.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, a bark_up_or_dark reject. The white bark and peeling patches are visible, but the surface texture is soft and distant.

results.description: One brown, spiky seed ball hangs on its stalk against bare winter branches and blue sky. The background is soft, and warm low sun lights the ball golden.
results.note: A sharp, whole, ripe seed ball hanging on its stalk. Warm low sun warms its colour (light).

results.description: A close view of a trunk surface with a mottled patchwork of grey, cream, olive, and blue-green flaking bark. A knot bulges near the centre.
results.note: The typical camouflage patchwork of exfoliating bark is clear, and the area is wide enough to show the repeat. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale, so too_close is true.

results.description: A trunk with smooth, mottled cream, grey, and olive bark and some brown flaking patches, with a branch scar near the top. Green leaves overlap the sides and foreground, and small yellow flowers from another plant are at the bottom.
results.note: The mottled patchy bark is clear on a trunk with both edges in view. Foreground leaves and flowers compete with the trunk, so alone is false.

results.description: A single sycamore seed ball hangs from a short pale stalk against a soft, out-of-focus sky and buildings. The ball is breaking apart, with the fluffy hairs of the achenes bursting out of one side.
results.note: The seed ball is coming apart, so its round outline is disrupted (atypical, shape at search). It still reads as a seed ball, and it hangs from its stalk.

results.description: Many brown sycamore seed balls hang on long thin stalks from bare twigs against a deep blue sky. The view looks up from below into the branches.
results.note: Ripe, round seed balls on bare winter twigs read clearly. The view from below is the only added difficulty.

results.description: A large green London planetree leaf is held flat by a hand, with its upper side toward the camera and other leaves crowded behind. The blade has brown blotches and a lesion near the right side, and the right and upper lobes run to the frame edge.
results.note: The lobes, teeth, and palmate veins read clearly. The frame edge cuts off the right lobe tip (whole false), and the crowded leaves behind compete (alone false). The brown disease spots do not change the outline.

results.description: A small, developing sycamore seed ball hangs on a green stalk below a twig, with a newly unfolding leaf and bud scales above it. The background is a soft, even green.
results.note: A young seed ball in spring, beside new leaves, that has not reached its full size (young). It still reads as a round ball on a stalk.

results.description: A single green, spiky sycamore seed ball hangs from a stalk. The background is a blurred mix of green and yellow autumn leaves.
results.note: The seed ball has its full shape but is still green, so it is unripe (usual_look false). The busy background is soft and does not compete.

results.description: A sycamore seed ball lies on a mossy log, broken open, with its hairy achenes splayed out in a ring around the dark central core and stalk. The photo is taken from above.
results.note: A broken, splayed seed ball (atypical) seen from above (angle). It is hard to read as a seed ball without close study, so it should not test fruit kind.

results.description: Five brown sycamore seed balls hang on thin stalks from a bare twig against a clear blue sky. Each ball is round and spiky.
results.note: A typical view of ripe seed balls hanging from a winter twig, with a plain sky behind them. Nothing adds difficulty.

results.description: A large yellow-green, bumpy sycamore seed ball hangs on a green stalk from a pale twig. Bare branches with more balls fill the sky and hillside behind it.
results.note: The ball is full size but still green, so it is unripe (usual_look false). It dominates the frame against the bare branches.

results.description: A single green, bristly sycamore seed ball hangs on a long green stalk from a slender twig with small buds. The background is soft and grey.
results.note: A clear, isolated seed ball on its stalk and twig. It is still green, so it is unripe (usual_look false).

results.description: An avenue of London planetrees forms a green leafy canopy over a paved path, with hedges and roads on both sides. No single leaf, fruit, or bark area is the subject.
results.note: A scene of whole trees and their crowns, so the part is other. The leaves blend into a canopy, and no key feature of a part can be read.

results.description: A smooth trunk with the mottled cream, grey and brown patchwork bark of a planetree fills most of the frame. A spray of green lobed leaves hangs across the upper left, in front of the trunk. The leaves overlap each other and are cut by the frame edge.
results.note: The bark area is wide, shows both trunk edges, and reads clearly as the patchy peeling pattern. The foreground leaves compete with the bark, so alone is false.

results.description: A large green palmately lobed leaf, upper side, is held up by a hand in front of a trunk with peeling cream and grey bark. Another leaf and the hand cover the top of the blade.
results.note: The lobes, the pointed lobe tips and the coarse teeth read clearly, but the hand and another leaf hide the top of the blade, so whole is false. The striking bark and the leaf above compete with the subject.

results.description: A dense mass of green lobed leaves in the crown, with a bare branch running diagonally across the frame. No single leaf stands out from the others.
results.note: The leaves blend into a crowded mass of the crown, so the outline and edge of one leaf are found only with a search. This is a leaf_mass reject.

results.description: A close view of a trunk with bark flaking off in thin brown plates, showing cream and grey-green patches beneath. Both trunk edges are in the frame against a soft green background.
results.note: Sharp view of the classic camouflage peeling bark, with the trunk edges visible. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A trunk against a blue sky and a river bank, with large brown and grey bark plates peeling away to show pale yellow-cream patches. Lichen grows on some plates. Both trunk edges show.
results.note: The peeling plate pattern and the pale patches read clearly on a well-lit trunk with both edges in the frame. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A hand holds a large green lobed leaf, seen from the paler side with raised veins, against other foliage. The hand covers the base of the blade and another leaf overlaps the upper right.
results.note: The lobes and coarse teeth read clearly; small spots on the blade do not change the outline. The hand hides the leaf base, so whole is false.

results.description: A brown, dead lobed leaf lies on grass among other fallen brown leaves. Its lower part overlaps other leaves and is slightly torn.
results.note: The subject is a dead brown fallen leaf, a dead_leaf reject. Other fallen leaves crowd it and its lower edge is torn.

results.description: A view up into a branch of green lobed leaves, with one spiky green seed ball hanging below. A parked car and a road show in the bright background behind the leaves.
results.note: The leaves overlap and crowd each other, so the outline and edge of one leaf need a search. The view from below and the bright backlight make it harder, and the car competes in the background.

results.description: A city street lined with rows of planetrees, with cyclists, cars and buses on the road. The trunks and crowns are small in the frame.
results.note: A street scene with whole trees and people; no leaf, bark or fruit is the main subject, so the part is other.

results.description: A bright green, sharply lobed leaf with coarse pointed teeth, upper side, stands out against a dark leafy background. Its stalk runs down to the twig, where other leaves sit below it.
results.note: One whole leaf shows its lobes, pointed tips and toothed edge clearly against a dark background. The stalk join to the twig is partly visible, so arrangement needs a search.

results.description: A view from below into a branch of the crown against blue sky. Green palmately lobed leaves fill the right side, and several small green seed balls hang on long stalks from the twigs in the middle of the frame.
results.note: Green seed balls hang on long stalks, but they are small in the frame among many leaves, so kind and shape need a search; two balls on one stalk are not plain. The view is from below and the leaves are backlit against the sky; the balls are green, so unripe.

results.description: A section of trunk with mottled bark in grey-green, olive, and pinkish-tan patches, much of it covered with lichen. The right trunk edge shows against a sidewalk with fallen leaves.
results.note: The flaking patchwork of the bark is readable, though lichen softens the patch edges. The trunk edge gives context.

results.description: A close-up of smooth bark with jigsaw-shaped peeling plates in cream, tan, and rust-brown. Warm low sunlight lights the right side, and the left side is in deep shadow.
results.note: The peeling plates show clearly, but warm low sun and deep shadow change the colours. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.

results.description: The camera looks up a large forked trunk into a leafless winter crown against a pale sky. The bark is dark and burly near the base, with faint mottled patches higher up.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, and the backlit trunk is dark, so the bark pattern is hard to read. Reject for an upward view.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the middle of the frame, with smooth bark broken into small puzzle-like plates of cream, grey, and tan. Both trunk edges show, with potted plants behind.
results.note: The flaking patchwork pattern is clear across a wide area of the trunk, and the trunk edges give context.

results.description: Large green lobed leaves on a branch fill the left side, seen from below against a bright overexposed sky. A trunk with peeling tan bark is on the right.
results.note: The leaves overlap and compete with the trunk, so the outline and edge need a search. They are seen from below and backlit by a washed-out sky.

results.description: A trunk with smooth bark in large patches of white, cream, olive-green, and grey-green, in dappled sun. Both trunk edges show against green woodland.
results.note: The smooth bark, with its large camouflage patches where it has flaked off, is clear over a wide area. The trunk edges give context.

results.description: A close-up of rough, scaly grey-brown bark with small raised plates and a few pale exposed patches on the left. The right part of the frame is in shade.
results.note: Old scaly bark from the lower trunk, where the typical patchwork shows only on the left, so the pattern needs study. Shade darkens the right part, and the frame has no trunk edge or scale.

results.description: A close-up of smooth bark in a camouflage patchwork of green, olive, yellow, cream, and rust-brown patches. The frame shows only the bark surface.
results.note: The flaking patchwork pattern is very clear. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.

results.description: A narrow vertical view of a trunk with bark flaking in patches of brown, cream, and pale green. Both trunk edges show against a white building, with a few leaves at the top left.
results.note: The flaking patchwork bark shows clearly, and the trunk edges give context. It is a small file but sharp.

results.description: A close view into dense green foliage of a plane tree, with many palmately lobed leaves overlapping. A pale central leaf is the clearest, and a few small green seed balls hang among the leaves. The image is slightly soft.
results.note: Crowded foliage: the leaves overlap and no single leaf stands apart, so alone is false and shape and margin need a search; the central leaf is tilted. Not a crown or whole tree, so not leaf_mass.

results.description: A hand cups a single green, spiky seed ball that hangs on its stalk from a leafy twig. Large lobed plane leaves are behind, with bright sky at the top.
results.note: One green, full-size but unripe seed ball resting in a hand, so hang is no and usual_look false. Only one ball shows, so two_heads is no.

results.description: A brown seed ball lies on a blue-grey paving stone, seen from above, with its achenes loosening and some hairy seeds scattered around it. The ball is starting to break apart.
results.note: A fallen ball that is breaking up and shedding seeds is not the typical intact form (atypical), and it is a top view on the ground (angle). The ball is still recognisable as a seed ball.

results.description: An autumn scene in low warm sun: brown, dried plane leaves on twigs, a trunk and grass behind, and the photographer's shadow. A small green seed ball hangs on its stalk in the middle of the frame.
results.note: The ball is small in a busy frame of brown leaves and trunk, so kind and shape need a search and alone is false; warm low sun changes the colours. The ball is still green, so unripe.

results.description: A single green, spiky seed ball hangs from a long stalk among large lobed plane leaves. The ball is sharp and centred in the frame.
results.note: A full-size green seed ball hanging on its stalk, clear and well framed. It is unripe, so usual_look is false; one ball only.

results.description: A single green, bristly seed ball hangs from a long pale stalk against a soft, dark green background. The ball is sharp and fills the lower centre of the frame.
results.note: A clear, isolated green seed ball hanging on its stalk. It is unripe, so usual_look is false.

results.description: Two brown, ripe seed balls hang one below the other on a single stalk against a soft blue winter sky and bare branches. Both balls are sharp and whole.
results.note: Two ripe seed balls in a chain on one stalk show clearly. The join to the twig is out of frame, so hang is search.

results.description: A view from below into bare twigs against a blue sky, with several dark brown seed balls hanging on separate stalks. The balls and twigs are dark against the bright sky, and one ball is cut by the bottom edge.
results.note: Seen from below against bright sky, so angle and backlight darken the balls; several balls and twigs compete. Each ball hangs on its own stalk, so two_heads is no.

results.description: A dark brown seed ball hangs on its stalk among large green lobed plane leaves, photographed from below against bright gaps in the canopy. A trunk shows at the right edge.
results.note: The ball is centred and whole but seen from below with backlight through the canopy, which darkens it. One ball only.

results.description: Two green, spiky seed balls hang one below the other on one long stalk, under a large lobed plane leaf. A third ball is partly hidden behind the upper one, and more leaves fill the soft background.
results.note: Two seed balls on one stalk show clearly, hanging from the twig. They are green and unripe, so usual_look is false.

results.description: A single brown, bristly seed ball held between the fingers of a hand, with a short bit of stalk running off to the left behind the fingers. Behind it is a ground of fallen autumn leaves and grass, out of focus.
results.note: An intact, ripe planetree seed ball shows clearly, so its kind and round shape are easy to read. It is held in the hand, so hang is no. Only one ball is in the frame, so two_heads is no. The hand serves as the scale object. The fallen leaves behind it are soft and do not compete with the ball.
One large red and green autumn maple leaf fills the centre, with the three lobes and toothed edge readable against conifer needles. Autumn colour makes it growth_stage autumn and not the usual look.
Backlit cluster of overlapping, translucent autumn leaves on a twig. No single leaf outline is whole, and lobes and teeth can be found only by close study. Backlight changes the colour.
Top-down view of a forest floor covered in overlapping fallen red and brown leaves that blend into a mass. Only a few red leaves are partly traceable, and no margin can be read.
Sapling with many overlapping red and green autumn leaves. Several lobed outlines read well, but leaves crowd each other and are cut by the frame, and the edge teeth need a close look.
A red autumn leaf lies on forest-floor litter among brown leaves and a mushroom. The outline is whole and readable, but the busy litter competes and the small file makes the teeth hard to read.
Green mature leaves on a leafy branch, several overlapping. Lobes read well but the crowding means no leaf is isolated, and the margin teeth and opposite stalks need a close look.
A small tree or shrub in mixed red, orange and green autumn colour, seen as a scene beside water with asters in front. The main subject is the whole plant, not a leaf, bark or fruit.
Crowded autumn leaves on a central stem, with opposite pairs of stalks visible. Individual outlines overlap and the lobes and teeth are found only with a close look. Autumn colour is not a cause.
One whole green mature leaf with a red stalk, sharp against a soft dark background. Lobes, teeth and veins read clearly.

Close view of one large leaf turning from green to red, with lobes and toothed edge readable. Its left lobe touches the frame edge so whole is false, and other leaves lie around it. Autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

A branch crowded with overlapping yellow autumn leaves, with a red tree behind. No single leaf outline is whole and the lobes and edge can only be traced with close study, so shape and margin are search and alone is false. Autumn colour makes it not the usual look.
A whole trunk seen from a distance in a park setting, covered with moss. The vertical furrows can be seen only with study, so texture and pattern are search, and the moss changes the colour.
The base of a multi-stem trunk with sun coming through the gap between the stems. The ridges can be read but only with study, and the backlight darkens the bark colour, so light is a cause.
A sharp close-up of grey ridged and plated bark that fills the frame. There is no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so too_close is true.
A full-width trunk with long ridges and flaking plates, in even light, with both trunk edges in the frame and a soft fern background.
A trunk with scaly plates that peel to show lighter patches, with the trunk edges in the frame. A thin twig lies across it but does not compete.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, with a bright sun flare behind it and a birdhouse that competes with the bark. The view from below is an angle cause and the backlight is a light cause.
A close-up of vertically ridged grey bark with lichen patches. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale object.

A narrow, dark trunk with lichen patches in a busy autumn forest. The trunk is small in the frame, in shade and with trees competing around it, so texture and pattern are search. The smooth, thin trunk reads as young bark.
Old shaggy bark with long peeling strips and plates across the full trunk, with a hand at the left edge for scale. The hand touches only a small part of the frame, so whole stays true.

Many small red samara clusters on bare twigs, seen from below against a pine and sky. The fruits are small in the frame and crowded with twigs and pine needles, so kind, shape and wing need a search. The upward angle makes it harder.
A pendant cluster of paired pink-red samaras hanging from a twig, large and sharp against a soft green background. Kind, shape, hang and wing all read easily.
The full base of a mature trunk on a lawn, with some lichen. It is taken from a distance, so the ridge and plate pattern is small and needs a search.

Green and pink samaras in a crowded overlapping bunch against a dark background. The front pair is whole and readable, but the neighbours compete and the stalks are hard to follow. The fruit is full-shaped but still green, so unripe.
Close-up of rugged, deeply ridged bark with plates and dark grooves. There is no trunk edge or scale, so it is too close. Warm sun shifts the colour.
Red and green samaras hanging in pairs from a twig against blue sky. The foreground cluster is sharp, and the background is soft and out of focus.
A leafy branch with pale samaras scattered among leaves and twigs. The fruits are small and crowded with leaves, so kind, shape and wing need a search. The fruits hang from the twig.
A close-up of grey-brown bark with small flaking plates and short ridges. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale. The ridge pattern is irregular and needs study.
Pendant samara clusters on red stalks from a twig, with a young maple leaf at upper left. Sharp, and the wings and hang are easy to read.

Tiny developing red-green winged fruits on upright green stalks against a soft dark background. They have not reached full shape, and the flower-like parts make kind and shape hard to read, so these need a search.

One whole green maple leaf, hanging on its stalk against a dark background, showing the paler underside. The flash-like lighting on the dark background gives the leaf a silvery tone, so light is a cause. The stalk does not show a twig join, and no scale object is in the frame.
Clusters of red samaras hang from a twig against a soft background in spring sun. The paired wings and the way they hang are easy to read.

Several green leaves on a branch overlap and tilt at different angles. The lower-left leaf is cut by the frame edge, so whole is false. A learner must study the crowded outlines and edges to read them, so the key features are search. The small brown spots do not change the outline.

Hanging clusters of samaras on a pale branch against a black background, lit by flash. The flash and darkness shift the colour, so light is a cause. The wings and the way the fruit hangs remain readable.
A single whole green leaf scanned against a plain black background, upper side, with the stalk showing. Outline, lobes, edge and veins are all easy to read. No twig and no scale object are shown.
Drooping clusters of small red flowers (or very early fruit) on long thin stalks against a soft sky. No leaf, bark or mature fruit is the subject, so the part is other.

A pile of fallen autumn leaves in red, orange and yellow. The central leaf is partly overlapped by others, so whole and alone are false and the outline and edge need close study. Autumn colour makes usual_look false. The leaves are coloured, not brown and dead.
Red paired samaras hang from a bare twig against a clear blue sky. The kind of fruit, the wings and the way it hangs are all easy to read.

One whole green leaf with its stalk lying on wood-chip mulch. The leaf is large and contrasts well with the busy background, so the outline and edge are easy to read. No twig and no scale object are shown.
A tree crown in full orange autumn colour that fills the frame. No single leaf, bark or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
A wide stretch of trunk with vertical ridges and flaking plates, trunk edges in frame, a brick building behind. Ridge pattern and colour read easily; nothing makes it harder.

One whole green leaf on a plain white background, upper side, with the petiole. Outline, lobe tips, edge and veins are all easy to read. No scale object and no twig, so size and arrangement are not shown.
A small sapling in a garden bed, seen whole from a distance. The leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf outline can be traced without close study, so it is a leaf_mass reject.

Underside of a hanging leaf with its petiole, tilted away and cut off by the top frame edge, with other leaves overlapping and busy foliage behind. The lobes need a careful look; the edge and veins are readable. The tilt counts as angle.
A large forked trunk and limbs with yellow autumn foliage and sky behind. The main subject is the whole tree, not a bark close-up, so the part is other.

Tight crop of deeply furrowed bark with flaking plates and ridges, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so it is texture only. The warm reddish tones look boosted by warm light, which shifts the colour.
A whole young shrub-sized sapling among garden plants. The leaves merge into one mass, and a learner cannot trace one leaf outline or edge without close study, so it is a leaf_mass reject.
Crown of orange autumn leaves seen from below, with the leaves blending into a mass and no single leaf outline or edge readable. Autumn colour is not a cause, but the view from below is angle.

A pile of fallen autumn leaves in yellow, orange and brown, with the central yellow-orange leaf overlapped by others. Its outline and edge can be traced only with close study, and the many leaves compete for attention. Autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

Twig with paired samaras hanging on thin stalks against a plain black background, with a few green leaves. The wings are pale and the seeds still green, so the fruit is full shape but not ripe (unripe, not the usual look).
Old trunk with a branch junction against blue sky; rough, furrowed grey bark with patches of moss. The ridge pattern is readable only with some study, so pattern is search.
Full-width trunk with deep vertical furrows and long scaly ridges, both edges in frame. A brick building and trees sit behind it but the trunk dominates.
Camera looks steeply up the trunk into the branching crown, so the bark is foreshortened and competes with limbs and leaves. Bark up into the crown is a reject; the angle makes it harder.
One dry, ripe tan-brown samara pair laid flat on a plain purple background with a 1 cm scale bar. Nothing shows how it hangs, so hang is no.
Trunk in a park with both edges in frame; deep dark grooves between long irregular plates and ridges are readable. Blurred lawn and building behind do not compete.
Close-up of rough, craggy bark with moss and lichen filling the frame, with no trunk edge or scale. The texture is clear but the ridge pattern needs study among the moss.
Close-up of grey bark with long, shaggy vertical ridges and curling plates; texture only, no trunk edge or scale. Sharp and well lit.
Trunk in front of a brick building, shot from slightly low, with rough vertical ridges and blocky plates and both edges visible. The view is only mildly upward and the bark is clear.

Gnarled old trunk and limbs in a meadow, with tall grass and trees behind and the crown cut off. The bark is small in the frame and shows as peeling strips with moss, so texture and pattern are search.

A single sugar maple samara lies on snow and is seen from above, with a green sprout coming from the seed. The fruit is a lone, germinating samara on the ground, so it is atypical and a top view (angle). It has fallen, so it is after seed fall and not the usual look.
Paired samaras with green seed bodies hang from a stalk in front of a soft green background. The fruit has its full shape but is still green, so it is unripe and not the usual look.

Several mature white oak leaves hang against bright sky and a branch, seen from below. The centre leaf shows its rounded lobes, but other leaves crowd it (alone false), the view is from below (angle) and the backlight darkens the colour (light).

A cluster of dull blue-green mature leaves meets at a twig tip, with lobes and veins readable on the front leaves. The leaves overlap and crowd each other (alone false), and the stalks meeting the twig can be found only by studying the cluster.

One sharp mature white oak leaf in front of a soft background, with several holes and small yellow galls on the edge. The galls and holes are damage. The tip of the leaf reaches the top edge of the frame, so whole is false.

Clusters of samaras with tan wings and green seed bodies hang from a twig in front of a black background that looks flash-lit. The flash and dark background change the colour (light). The seed bodies are still green, so the fruit is unripe.

A leafy white oak twig with two small acorns, seen from below against a bright backlit background. The leaves are the main subject but crowd each other (alone false). The upward view is an angle and the backlight is a light cause.

A wet branch spray of many overlapping white oak leaves is seen from above over bark mulch. The leaves crowd each other (alone false), so a learner has to study a single leaf to read its lobes and edge (search).
A bunch of dry, ripe brown samaras hangs on a twig against a soft, blurred background. The warm low sun tints the wings orange (light).

One grey-green white oak leaf, seen from the underside and tilted, against a dark soft background. The tilt is an angle cause and the dark shade with a cool cast is a light cause. The base and a lobe tip touch the frame edges, so whole is false.
View from the base of the trunk looking up into the forked trunk and leafy crown, so the main subject is the whole tree. Angle is from below and the sky behind the crown gives some backlight.
Green acorns with warty caps sit on a twig among lobed leaves, sharp and in full shape. They are unripe, so the usual look is false.
A wide trunk area with rough, broken scaly plates and ridges, trunk edges and background trees visible. Sharp and well lit.
Full-width trunk with narrow vertical ridges and flaky plates in grey. Both trunk edges show, and it is sharp and evenly lit.

A green unripe acorn with a warty cap sits behind the edge of a lobed leaf, which hides the base of the nut. The outline needs some study and the photo does not show how the acorn is attached to the twig.

A drooping branch with many deeply lobed leaves overlapping each other. The lobed outlines can be traced on a few central leaves, but the leaves are crowded and small in the frame, so the key features need a search.
A forest trunk with blocky, broken plates in grey and brown. The woodland background is busy but the trunk dominates the frame and its edges show.
A trunk with rough ridges, crossed by strong sun and shadow stripes. The shadows hide part of the ridge pattern and shift the colour, so pattern and colour need a search.
A grey trunk with shallow, scaly plates and fine furrows. Both trunk edges and the ground are in the frame, and the light is even.
Two ripe golden acorns on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar, one nut bare and one with its warty cap. Sharp and clear, but off the tree, so the hang is not shown.

A pile of fallen brown oak leaves overlapping on the ground, with hard sun and dark shadows between them. The subject is dead and brown, the leaves crowd each other, and the shadow pattern breaks up the outlines, so the lobes and edges can only be traced with close study.
Three full-size green acorns with warty caps sit in a cluster at the twig, with lobed leaves behind. The acorns have their full shape but are still green, so they are unripe and not the usual look.

A cluster of green full-size acorns with deep warty caps on the twig, with lobed leaves around them. The acorns overlap a little but each outline can be read; they are still green, so unripe. Blurred fingers at the top left are not used as a scale.
A whole tree crown in red autumn colour seen from a distance, beside conifers. The main subject is the tree as a whole, so the part is other.

A branch with many overlapping red autumn leaves against a soft dark background. The leaves are small in the frame and crowd each other, so the pointed lobes and edges need close study; the autumn colour is not a cause.

A green shoot with several lobed leaves seen from above against leaf litter on the ground. The outline and lobes read well; the edge details and where the stalks join the twig are small and need close study.
A single green acorn with a warty cap sitting on the twig, with leaves behind it. The acorn is full size but still green, so unripe and not the usual look.
The underside of a green mature leaf seen from below on a sunlit branch, with the lobes, bristle tips and veins visible. The leaf is tilted and seen from beneath, so angle is a cause.

A shoot of lobed leaves turning orange and yellow in full sun, seen from above against green plants. The outlines and lobes are readable; the edges and the leaf stalks are small and need close study. Autumn colour is not a cause.

A shoot of lobed leaves turning orange and yellow in full sun, seen from above against green plants. The outlines and lobes are readable; the edges and the leaf stalks are small and need close study. Autumn colour is not a cause.
Camera looks straight up the trunk into the crown, with strong foreshortening. Ridges and furrows are readable, but the view is from below.
Several green lobed leaves seen from above over leaf litter, with a clearly whole central leaf. Neighbouring leaves and the busy ground compete, and the bristle tips of the margin need close study.
Mature green leaves with pointed, bristle-tipped lobes on a leafy twig. Several leaves overlap and some are cut by the frame edge, so the subject is crowded. A few leaves are whole.
Light-green newly expanded leaves hanging from a twig, with small catkins, against a soft background. Sharp-toothed lobes are readable. The leaves are young and not yet at their full form.

Three lobed leaves spread against a mossy trunk, with the stalks meeting at one point. The lobes are broad and the bristle tips are small, so the margin takes close study. The bark behind is busy but the green leaves stand out.
Mature green leaves with bristle-tipped lobes on a leafy twig, with one clear central leaf. Many leaves overlap and crowd the frame, so the subject is not alone.
Camera looks up a trunk into a wide crown. The bark is small and dark in the frame, and the crown and sky compete. The ridge pattern takes close study.

Young yellow-green leaves with hanging catkins on a branch, lit strongly from behind against a soft dark background. The leaves are not fully expanded and overlap, and the backlight shifts the colour.
A mass of red autumn foliage and branches fills the frame. Individual leaf outlines blend together and no margin can be read. Autumn colour is not a cause.
Whole base of a large trunk with long vertical ridges and furrows, plus some lichen. The trunk edges and surroundings show, so it is not too close. The ridge pattern is readable.

Close frame of rough, vertically ridged and flaking bark with lichen spots. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object. Warm low sun tints the bark gold, so the true colour is hard to read.

New, still-unfolding tulip tree leaves on a twig against a blurred sky, with the folded leaf at the twig tip. The leaves have not reached full shape and are folded or curled, so the outline and edge only show with close study. The photo is taken from the side at an unusual angle.
One ripe brown acorn hanging from its twig, sharp against a soft green background. The nut, the scaly cap and the hanging habit are all easy to read.
Five ripe acorns with caps lying on a plain pale grey cloth, mostly in side view. Each acorn and its cap is sharp. The photo shows nothing of how the fruit hangs on the twig.

Seed-library style photo on a blue background: one acorn with its cap tilted, a cut nut face and an end-on view of a nut, with a 1 cm scale bar. The tilted and end-on views are unusual angles for a learner. The scale bar is not a fault.

Part of a flowering tulip tree crown: yellow-orange tulip flowers among many overlapping green leaves. The main subject is flowers and a leafy crown, not one leaf, bark or fruit, so the part is other.

Crowded branch of mature tulip tree leaves with overlapping blades and sky showing through. No single whole leaf outline is free of other leaves, and several leaves are tilted away from the camera. The lobes and smooth edge can be found only with a search.

Four pale, dry acorn views on a black background: a cap seen from above, the base of a nut, a whole acorn with cap, and a nut without its cap. The top and bottom views are unusual angles. The whole acorn in the middle is sharp and easy to read.
Three green, unripe acorns with caps sitting on a bare twig. Sharp leaves and twig branches cross the frame and compete with the acorns. The acorns have full shape but are not ripe.
Whole trunk face with both trunk edges in view, showing grey, vertically ridged and furrowed mature bark in even light. The ridge pattern and colour are easy to read.

A view up into a canopy of yellowing and green leaves against the sky; the leaves blend into a mass and only a few outlines can be traced. Angle is from below, and the yellow colour is autumn, not a cause.
A crown of green leaves with a few orange-green tulip flowers and a trunk piece in a woodland scene. The main subject is the whole crown, so the part is other. The flowers are the sign of spring.

A whole trunk on a street with shallow vertical furrows and flat ridges, with grey-green lichen patches over part of the surface. Trunk edges show, so it is not too close; the blurred street behind does not compete.

One whole green tulip-tree leaf with the lobe tips and smooth edge in view, held in front of dark bark. A few small spots on the blade do not change the outline. The twig junction and a scale object are not in the frame.
One whole green leaf with a notched apex and a clear edge, lying on a soft background of fallen autumn leaves. The leaf is still green and mature, so the autumn sign is only in the litter around it.
Many green leaves overlap on a twig with a bud near the centre; a learner can find a few lobed outlines only with a search, and some leaves are tilted or cut by the frame edge.
Two open cream and orange tulip flowers on a twig with lobed leaves, over a soft green background. Flowers are the main subject, so the part is other; flowers mark spring.
The top of a crown and a branch against a clear blue sky, lit by warm low sun. The leaves are small and blend into the crown, so no leaf, bark, or fruit feature is the subject.
A sharp close frame of deep vertical furrows and rough, flaking ridges in grey-brown. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so it is too close.

Low ground-level shoots with rounded, irregularly lobed leaves seen from above, among other plants. The form looks like a sucker or seedling shoot, not a mature tulip-tree leaf, and several leaves are cut by the frame or overlap.
A full trunk with both edges in frame shows vertical ridges and plates clearly against dark trees and sky. Nothing makes it harder.
Close frame of deep vertical ridges with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close. Yellow lichen covers much of the surface, so the true bark colour takes a search.
The camera looks up the trunk into the leafy crown, and the bark is small and foreshortened with the crown competing. This is the up-into-the-crown case.
A trunk with both edges and a blurred green background shows vertical furrows with pale patches. Shade dims it a little, but ridges and plates stay readable.
Two children stand in front of a very large trunk and compete for attention. The ridge pattern is soft at this distance, so it takes a search.
A full trunk with both edges, clear ridges and furrows. A lawn and railing sit behind it but do not compete.
A trunk against sky and leaves with sharp vertical ridges and pale furrows, and both edges in frame.
Texture-only close-up of crossing diagonal ridges with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close. Lichen patches hide the true colour, so colour takes a search.
A big dark trunk in a cluttered forest with leaf litter. Deep shade hides the fine furrows, so they can be found only with close study.
Several trunks and bare twigs share the frame, with a dark backlit trunk and a vine-covered one competing. The fine ridges on the main pale trunk are small and shadowed.

A dry tan tulip tree cone of samaras stands upright on a twig against a soft green background. The outer samaras have started to open, the cone outline is sharp, and the individual wings can be seen only on a closer look.

A top view of an opened cone on snow: the samaras splay out around the bare central axis like a flower. The unusual view (angle) and the opened, spent form (atypical) make the cone shape and kind hard to read, so kind and shape are search.

A green, unripe cone of full shape sits upright on its twig among green leaves with a soft background. The closed green cone looks like a bud, so the fruit kind needs close study, and no wings show yet.
One dry, whole cone of samaras fills the frame against a plain black background, with the overlapping wings easy to read. Only a short stub of stalk shows, so how it hangs on the twig is not visible.
Frosted dry cones on a bare twig against a soft blue background; the sharp one in front shows its outline and how it sits on the twig. The wings are covered by frost and need a closer look.

A pale, weathered cone lying on the ground in dead grass and leaf litter, seen from above. The litter crowds the subject (alone false), and the fallen weathered form with the top view makes kind and wings hard to find (atypical, angle).
A brown, partly open cone of samaras sits sharp on its twig in front of a soft background of autumn leaves, with a green tulip leaf at the edge. The outline, wings and attachment are all readable.

One dry cone on a bare twig against blue sky, with a soft branch background. The outline and the way it sits on the twig are clear. The cone is fairly small in the frame, so the individual wings need a closer look.
A view up into the crown of a tree with many small twigs, scattered cones and a few yellow leaves against a cloudy sky. The main subject is the crown, so the part is other.

A dry, opened cone of samaras sits upright on a curved twig against plain snow, with the long wings clearly readable. Most seeds have fallen, so the fruit is past ripe (after seed fall) and not the usual look.
Bare winter branches against blue sky, with a few tiny dry fruit cones that are too small to read. The main subject is the twig network, not a leaf, bark or fruit.

A shoot with several broad lobed leaves, the top ones green-yellow and the middle ones red-brown with early autumn colour. Leaves overlap and compete, and the margin teeth are small in the frame, so a learner needs to search.
One large bright green lobed leaf with toothed margin and pale veins fills the frame against a dark soft background. The twig and stalk are partly visible at top, so arrangement needs a search.
A leafy sapling or crown where the leaves blend into a green mass. No single leaf outline or margin can be traced.

A large dull green leaf with dark speckles fills the centre, underside with pale veins, overlapped by neighbouring leaves and ground clutter. The margin teeth are subtle, and brown leaves behind suggest late season.

Overlapping pale undersides of leaves held up by a hand in front of mottled trunk bark, shot from above. The leaves overlap, the hand covers an edge, and the bark and ground litter compete with the subject.
One large sharply toothed lobed leaf with strong veins against soft grass. The stalk runs off the bottom, so the join to the twig is not shown.
A crowded shoot of overlapping leaves at oblique angles against a dark background with autumn-coloured foliage. Individual outlines and margins can be found only with close study.

A translucent yellow-green leaf seen from below in backlit shade, its tip cut by the bottom frame edge, with overlapping shaded leaves above. The view from below and the strong shadow make the outline and margin harder.

One whole green leaf, upper side, on a dark background. The outline and coarse teeth read clearly; the twig and stalk join show only in part, and a few brown blotches sit on the neighbouring leaves but not on the outline.
A whole multi-stem tree with a hollow base in a leafy scene; the main subject is the tree, not the bark, so the part is other.
One whole pale green leaf seen from above against plain gravel. Outline, teeth and veins read clearly; the stalk is shown without the twig join, and there is no scale object.
A bare winter crown seen from below with many crossing twigs against the sky; no single part is the subject, so the part is other.

A leafy twig laid on a plain wooden deck, upper sides showing, with the alternate stalk joins visible. Several leaves overlap a little and two are cut by the frame edge, but whole leaves show clearly.
A shaded trunk at a street curb with cars, a second trunk and leaf litter around it. The mottled bark and the pale plates at the base need a search, and the shade dulls the colour.
A trunk with flaking tan and cream plates and a branch crossing in front, against soft reeds. The pattern reads clearly; the image has a warm film colour cast.

A bright yellow-green young leaf in the centre with overlapping leaves around it and a flower head at the twig, which marks spring. A few tiny holes do not change the outline; the stalk-to-twig join shows only in part.
The camera looks up a pale mottled trunk into the crown, with branches and twigs against the sky. The angle makes it harder and the branches compete with the bark.
A close, sharp view of flaking bark with olive, cream and rust-red patches filling the frame. It shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object.

A green, spiky seed ball of full round shape hangs by its stalk against a large leaf. It is not yet ripe (green, not brown), so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look false; the stalk shows it hangs but no twig is visible.

Base of a trunk beside a curb, with dark flaky bark and pale mottled patches. The pattern needs some study at this size, and the grass, curb, and a parked car compete with the trunk so alone is false.
A bare crown of pale white branches seen from below against blue sky. The main subject is the whole tree/crown, so the part is other; the upward view is an angle cause.

A seed ball that has shed its seeds, leaving the bare knobbly core, lying on a rotting log with leaf litter. It is atypical (spent core, seen from above), the busy log competes with it, and the fruit kind takes study to recognise.
A trunk in bare woodland with bark flaking off in brown and cream plates. The flaking pattern repeats over a wide area and is easy to read; the trunk is the dominant subject.
Many small round seed balls hang on bare twigs against plain blue sky, seen from below. They are small in the frame, so kind and shape need a close look, while the hang on the twigs is plain.
A tall trunk with pale limbs and some green leaves, photographed from low looking up into the tree. The subject is the whole tree, not a bark area, so the part is other.
A large, ripe brown seed ball hangs by a long stalk from a bare twig against a soft blurred background. The whole ball is in frame and sharp.
A close-up of mottled bark with grey-green, cream, and tan patches, a burl, and some lichen. The frame is texture only with no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so too_close is true.
A trunk with blotchy grey-green and tan bark, with leaves and a yellow-flowered plant in front. The foliage competes with the trunk so alone is false, and the fine texture takes some study.
A dry seed ball hangs from its stalk against a soft sky and is breaking up, with fluffy hairs flaring out from the core. It is atypical and past seed fall, so it is not the usual look.
Many ripe brown seed balls hang on long stalks from bare twigs against a plain blue sky. Each ball is small in the frame, so the outline needs a closer look.

A green mature leaf is held up by a hand, showing the underside with raised veins. The right lobe runs off the frame edge, so whole is false. A brown patch, a small hole and a notch at the margin change the outline a little. The hybrid source name matches the tree.
A small young seed ball with dried style hairs hangs on a stalk below a twig that has new spring leaves, against a soft green background. It has not reached full size, so the kind needs study.
A full-shape green spiky seed ball hangs from a stalk in front of soft yellowing autumn leaves. It is still green and unripe, so it is not the usual look.
A disintegrated seed ball lies on a log, seen from above. It is a flat fluffy disc of hairs around a brown core. It is atypical and a top view, and it does not hang on a twig.
Five ripe brown seed balls hang on stalks from one bare twig against a plain blue sky. Both the kind and the outline read easily.
A large yellow-green spiky seed ball hangs from a stalk among bare twigs against blue sky. The green colour means it is unripe, so it is not the usual look. Twigs cross the background but stay soft.
A small olive-brown seed ball hangs on a long thin stalk from a bare twig against a soft grey background. It is small in the frame but sharp enough to read.
A scene of an alley of planted trees in full summer leaf over a path. No leaf, bark or fruit is the main subject, so the part is other. The hybrid source name matches the tree.

Sharp green lobed leaves with coarse teeth in front of a soft, out-of-focus trunk of mottled bark. The main leaf overlaps others and is cut by the left frame edge, so whole is false and alone is false. Vein detail and the stalk joins are small, so those need a search.

One large maple-like leaf, upper side, held against a mottled trunk. The right lobe is cut off by the frame edge, so whole is false. A hand at the top holds another leaf and is not a fault. It gives no useful scale for this leaf, so size is search.
Dense branch foliage where the leaves blend into one mass. No single leaf outline can be traced without close study. Rejected as leaf_mass.
Whole trunk section with both trunk edges visible. Flaking plates show brown, cream, and grey-green patches. The file is small but sharp.
Sharp view of a trunk in bright light. Flaking brown plates sit over pale cream and green patches, and both trunk edges are in frame. The background is soft.
A hand holds one whole green leaf, upper side, against dark foliage. Outline, coarse-toothed edge, and veins read well. The hand gives scale. A few small spots do not change the outline.
A dead brown fallen leaf on grass among other dead leaves. The subject is a dead leaf, so it is rejected as dead_leaf. Autumn colour is not a cause.

A leafy branch with one small green, bumpy seed ball at the lower right edge. It is small in the frame and competes with leaves and a parked car, so kind, shape, and hang need a search. Only one ball shows, so two_heads is no. The ball is green and not ripe.
A street scene with a row of mature trees, cyclists, and vehicles. The main subject is none of leaf, bark, or fruit, so the part is other.
One whole green lobed leaf with coarse teeth against a dark, soft background. The stalk and twig show only at the lower edge, where smaller leaves sit, so arrangement needs a search.

Green-brown seed balls hang on thin stalks among maple-like leaves, seen from below against blue sky. The balls are small in the frame, so shape needs a close look, and the leaves compete (not alone). The view from below is an angle cause, and the balls look green and unripe. Two balls on one stalk do not show clearly.

Wide trunk area with flaking plates in olive, cream and pink, partly covered by grey lichen that hides the plate edges, so the pattern needs study. The trunk edge and a pavement with fallen leaves show at right.

Close view of flaking plates with a brown patch under warm low sun and a dark shadow on the left. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or branch. Warm light shifts the colours, so colour is a search.
The camera looks up a forked trunk into a bare crown against the sky. The bark is dark and burred, and the plate pattern is hard to read. Reject for the upward view and the darkness.
Pale trunk with a fine crazed pattern of small plates, both trunk edges in frame and soft palm fronds behind. The pattern and texture read well.

Several broad green leaves overlap in bright sun, with a trunk at right and wires behind. One leaf at upper left shows its outline, but the lobes and margin need close study. The scene is crowded (not alone), and the bright light washes some leaves.
Whole trunk width with a blotchy cream, grey and olive pattern of peeled plates, in forest surroundings. Clear and sharp, with the trunk edges in frame.

Close view of rough, broken plates, with the right half in deep shadow. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge. The shadow hides the colour and makes the pattern a search, but the texture can still be read.

Very close view of a camouflage-like patchwork of green, yellow, cream and brown plates. The frame shows surface patches only, with no trunk edge. The patch pattern is clear, and the surface texture shows less.
Trunk with brown and cream flaking plates, both edges in frame, against a plain white building wall with a few leaves at top left. The file is small but sharp.
A leafy branch with many overlapping leaves; one central green leaf shows its palmate lobes in full, but the edge is only readable with study. Crowded leaves around it make alone false.

A small green spiky seed ball hangs on its stalk in front of a hand, with a large leaf behind. Only one ball shows, and the hand and leaf compete with it. The fruit is green and unripe, so not the usual look.

A fallen seed ball on paving, partly disintegrated with loose fluffy seeds beside it, seen from above. Atypical because the ball is breaking up, and angle because it lies on the ground and is viewed from the top.
A scene of a trunk, brown autumn leaves and a tiny green ball in low warm sun; no part is the main subject. Warm low sun changes the colours.
A sharp green spiky seed ball hangs on a long stalk from the branch, among large lobed leaves. One ball only. It is green and unripe, so not the usual look.
A single green spiky ball hangs on a long thin stalk against a soft dark green background. The photo is small and slightly soft but the outline is clear. Green and unripe.
Two brown seed balls, one above the other, on a bare twig against a soft blue sky. The stalks are mostly hidden, so a learner must study the photo to see whether both balls share one stalk.
Three brown seed balls hang from bare twigs against bright blue sky, seen from below. Backlight darkens them and the low view is unusual; each ball hangs on its own stalk.
A small dark seed ball hangs under large green leaves, seen from below in backlight. The ball is small in the frame and the leaves compete, so the fruit kind needs close study.
Two green spiky seed balls hang one below the other on a single long stalk, with a third ball behind, among green leaves. Both balls show clearly on one stalk. Green and unripe.

A single brown, bristly seed ball is held in a hand against a soft background of fallen autumn leaves; the whole ball and its outline are clearly visible. Only one ball shows with a stub of stalk at the left edge, so two heads on one stalk are not shown, and the hand means the hang on the twig is not shown.

results.description: One large autumn red maple leaf, red and green, sharp, fills the middle of the frame. Conifer needles and twigs fill the background, and a second small leaf sits at lower left.
results.note: Whole sharp leaf with lobes and teeth readable. Autumn colour makes the growth stage autumn and not the usual look. The needle background is busy but the leaf stays the main subject.

results.description: A backlit cluster of autumn red maple leaves, yellow to dark red, hanging and overlapping on a branch. The background is soft green and blue.
results.note: Leaves overlap and no single outline is complete, so shape and margin need a search. Backlight changes the colour (light). Autumn colour, so not the usual look.

results.description: A ground view of fallen leaf litter, red, pink, grey and brown leaves covering the whole frame. A few red maple leaves can be picked out near the bottom centre.
results.note: Crowded litter with no single main leaf. A learner finds the lobed red leaves only by searching, so shape and margin are search. Autumn colour makes it not the usual look.

results.description: Several autumn red maple leaves, red, orange and green, on a sapling with a pale trunk at the left. The leaves overlap a little and the background is leafy.
results.note: Several leaves compete (alone false) but at least one whole leaf with lobes and teeth is readable. Opposite stalks can be found only with a search. Autumn colour, not the usual look.

results.description: A single red autumn leaf lies on forest-floor litter of brown leaves, pine needles and a small mushroom. The leaf is sharp and nearly whole.
results.note: Lobed outline is readable but the small file makes the teeth need close study. Litter, a mushroom and a red blob compete with the leaf. Autumn colour, not the usual look.

results.description: A branch of green mature leaves in summer, sharp and well lit, with red leaf stalks. Many leaves overlap, and a few lobed leaves at lower left show clearly.
results.note: Crowded leaves compete (alone false) but several outlines and teeth can be read. Where stalks meet the twig can be found only with a search.

results.description: A scene of a small shrub or sapling with red and orange autumn leaves, among green foliage and asters, with water and trees behind. The leaves are small in the frame.
results.note: The main subject is a whole small plant in a scene, not one leaf, so the part is other.

results.description: A shoot with autumn leaves, green, yellow, orange and red, on opposite red stalks. It is sharp and the background is dark and soft.
results.note: Whole leaves with readable lobes and teeth. The photo shows opposite stalks on the twig. Several leaves compete (alone false). Autumn colour, not the usual look.

results.description: One green mature leaf in summer hangs on a red stalk, sharp and lit, against a dark soft background. Three lobes and toothed edges show.
results.note: Clean single leaf with outline, lobe tips and teeth readable. The stalk joins the twig out of focus at the top, so arrangement needs a search.

results.description: A close view of one large red and green autumn leaf that fills the frame, sharp, with other leaves around its edges. The left lobe tip touches the frame edge.
results.note: The frame edge cuts the left lobe, so whole is false, but lobes, teeth and veins are clear. Autumn colour, not the usual look.

results.description: A branch crowded with broad yellow leaves seen against blue sky, with a red-leaved tree in the background. The leaves overlap heavily and many are cut by the frame edge. Individual lobes and edges are hard to trace.
results.note: Crowded overlapping yellow leaves with the outlines and margins findable only by close study, so shape and margin are search and alone is false. Autumn colour sets growth_stage autumn and usual_look false; the tilted, mixed view gives angle.

results.description: A tall, mossy trunk of a leafless tree stands on a grassy slope with other trees behind it. Fine vertical ridges run along the trunk under a green moss cover. The whole trunk is in frame from base to the first branches.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance, with moss covering much of the surface, so the ridge texture and pattern need close study (search) and the true bark colour is masked by moss. The trunk edges and base are visible, so the frame is not too close.

results.description: A multi-stemmed tree trunk forks into several stems, with deep vertical furrows and rough ridges on the bark. Green foliage and sunlit grass are behind it. The bark is readable across the frame.
results.note: Rough grey-brown furrowed bark on several fused stems, seen at medium distance, so the ridge pattern needs a closer look while texture and colour read well. Trunk edges and the fork are in frame.

results.description: A tight close-up of grey bark with rough, broken ridges and scaly plates, patched with lichen. The frame shows only bark surface, with some distortion at the edges. Texture and ridge pattern are sharp.
results.note: Texture-only frame with no trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so too_close is true; the ridges and plates are sharp and readable.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame, covered in narrow vertical furrows and shaggy ridges in grey-brown, with ferns and green forest at the sides. The trunk edges are visible. The image is small but sharp.
results.note: Good clear view of ridged mature bark with both trunk edges in frame; nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A trunk close-up with brown and grey flaking, scaly bark in vertical strips and a thin twig lying across the surface. The trunk edges are partly visible and a bit of green leaf shows at the lower left. Lighting is slightly dim but even.
results.note: Scaly, flaking bark readable in the frame with trunk edges visible, so not too close. The twig across the bark is minor.

results.description: A view looking up a trunk toward the crown, with a yellow birdhouse nailed on and strong sun flare at the upper right. Bark ridges and lichen patches are visible but small. Foliage fills the background.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown with the sun in frame, so the bark texture is backlit and foreshortened. The birdhouse competes for attention and works as a scale object, not a plant label.

results.description: A tight crop of grey bark with tall, narrow vertical ridges and furrows, with lichen specks. The frame holds only bark, no trunk edge or scale. Ridges are sharp and easy to read.
results.note: Texture-only frame without trunk edge, branch, or scale object, so too_close is true; the ridge pattern itself is clear.
