results.description: A slim grey trunk with smooth bark and pale lichen blotches stands in an autumn forest with red and yellow foliage and leaf litter. The trunk is dark and fairly narrow in the frame, and other trunks and leaves compete in the background.
results.note: Smooth young-looking trunk in a busy forest scene under shaded light, so surface texture is only findable with a close look; the smooth pattern is readable. Alone is false because of the competing background.

results.description: A large trunk with thick, shaggy, peeling bark plates in grey and brown runs across the frame. A hand with fingers at the left edge holds the bark. Sky and trees show at the edges.
results.note: Old, deeply plated bark with the ridges and plates easy to read. The fingers cover only a small edge area, and the hand is a scale object that never makes the photo harder.

results.description: A twig-laden crown seen from below against blue sky and pine foliage. Many small red samara clusters hang from bare, branching twigs. Individual samaras are small in the frame and overlap with twigs.
results.note: Samara clusters are small and tangled with twigs and pine in the background, so kind, shape and wing need a close look. Viewed from below, so angle.

results.description: Close view of hanging pairs of reddish-pink samaras on red stalks, with a soft green background. A young green leaf sits at the left. The two-winged form and the hanging clusters read well.
results.note: Sharp samaras with the wing shape and the hang from the twig both visible against a soft background. Spring leaves at the edge.

results.description: The base of a whole trunk that forks near the top, standing on a lawn. Vertical ridges and flaking plates run down the grey-brown bark, with some lichen and moss at the base. Trees and grass fill the background.
results.note: Trunk seen from a little distance, so the ridge pattern is visible but a learner must study it. The trunk edges and the fork are in frame.

results.description: A close, crowded cluster of green samaras with pink-purple wings, seen against a dark background. The wings overlap and the lighting is dim. The samaras are full-size but still green, so not yet ripe.
results.note: Full-shape samaras that are still green, so unripe. The overlapping cluster competes for attention, and the hang on the twig is hard to follow.

results.description: A close-up of rough bark with vertical ridges and flaking plates, lit by low warm sun with deep shadows in the grooves. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in the frame.
results.note: Texture only, so too close. Warm low sun and hard shadows shift the colour.

results.description: Hanging clusters of reddish samaras on long red stalks, close to a dark twig, against blue sky and a soft background of bare branches. The paired wings and the hang are easy to see.
results.note: Sharp samaras with a soft background. The wing shape and the hang are both readable.

results.description: A leafy branch of a tree in spring with pale tan samara clusters hanging in the middle. Leaves, branches and a building in the background crowd the frame. The samaras are small.
results.note: Samaras are small and mixed with leaves and branches, so the kind and shape need a close look. They hang clearly from the twig.

results.description: A close-up of grey-brown bark with narrow vertical ridges and small flaking plates, in flat even light. No trunk edge, branch or scale is in the frame.
results.note: Texture only, so too close. The ridge pattern is visible but spans no wide area.

results.description: Close view of hanging pairs of pink-brown samaras on red stalks, with a young green leaf at the left and a soft green background. The wings and hang show clearly.
results.note: Sharp samaras, soft background, hang and wing both readable.

results.description: A few small red young fruits with short wings, on green upright stalks, with flower remnants at their centres. The background is dark and out of focus. The fruits have not reached full shape.
results.note: Fruits are small and not yet full-size, with flower remnants still on them. It could pass as flowers, but the wings are visible, so the key features are at search.

results.description: A single sugar maple leaf hangs from a long stalk against a near-black background, lit as if by flash. The whole outline with its lobes is visible and the pale veins stand out. A second leaf is cut off at the top right corner.
results.note: One whole leaf on a dark ground, with outline, lobes and edge easy to read. The flash makes the leaf look silvery and pale, so the colour is off (light). No twig or scale, so arrangement and size are no.

results.description: Clusters of red, pink-tinged winged fruits hang from a bare twig with red buds, against a blurred blue sky and branches. The paired wings and the yellow-green seed bodies are visible. The fruits are in the sharp foreground.
results.note: Samara pairs of full shape on the twig, still reddish with green seed bodies and early in the season, so unripe and not the usual look. The background is busy but soft, so the subject stays the main thing.

results.description: A branch with several green lobed leaves, taken outdoors with a street and trees behind. The large leaf at lower left touches the frame edge and has a few brown spots. Other leaves on the right overlap each other and the twigs.
results.note: Crowded leaves on a branch with a busy background, so alone is false. The best leaf is cut by the frame edge (whole false), and the outline and edge need close study (search). The brown spots do not change the outline.

results.description: Hanging clusters of orange-red winged fruits on grey branches, photographed at night against a black background with a flash. The fruits overlap in dense bunches, and some small brown ones show in the background. Several branches cross the frame.
results.note: Samara clusters hang from the twigs and the wings are easy to see. The fruits overlap, so the outline of a single fruit needs close study (search). Flash on a dark ground shifts the colour (light).

results.description: One whole green maple leaf with its stalk, scanned or shot on a plain black background. The five lobes, the pointed tips and the toothed-looking edge are sharp. The veins are clearly visible.
results.note: A clean specimen leaf on black with nothing competing. Outline, lobe tips and edge are all readable. There is no twig and no scale, so arrangement and size are no.

results.description: Long-stalked red flower clusters hang from a bare twig against a pale sky, with more twigs blurred behind. There are no leaves or fruits in the frame. The main subject is the flowers.
results.note: Flowers only on a leafless twig, so the part is other. It shows no leaf, bark or fruit feature.

results.description: A heap of fallen leaves in yellow, orange and red. The centre leaf shows its upper side with brown spots, but it overlaps other leaves and runs near the frame edge. The pile fills the whole frame.
results.note: Crowded autumn leaves on the ground. The centre leaf is partly covered, so whole is false and alone is false, and its outline and edge need close study (search). Autumn colour makes growth_stage autumn and not the usual look.

results.description: Red winged fruits hang in three bunches from a bare twig against a clear blue sky. The wings and the thin stalks are sharp, with a few buds on the twig. The background is plain.
results.note: Full-size samaras with clear wings that hang on the twig, against a plain sky. The bare twig and buds mark spring.

results.description: A whole green maple leaf with its stalk lies flat on wood-chip mulch. The lobes and the edge are sharp and the veins are visible. The mulch pieces are busy but the leaf stands out in colour.
results.note: One whole leaf, upper side, with clear outline and edge. The mulch is busy but does not compete with the leaf. There is no twig or scale.

results.description: A close view of a tree crown full of orange, yellow and red autumn leaves, with branches and patches of blue sky showing. No single leaf stands out. The leaves blend into one mass.
results.note: A crown of autumn leaves with no single leaf to read, so the part is other.

results.description: A large straight trunk fills the middle of the frame, with deep vertical furrows and long, curling ridges and plates. A brick wall, a pavement and a building doorway sit behind it, with some green leaves at the top corners.
results.note: Both trunk edges show, and the ridge and plate pattern repeats clearly. The street background is plain enough that it does not compete.

results.description: A single green leaf lies flat on a white background and shows its upper side. It has five lobes with pointed tips and a few coarse teeth, with the veins radiating from the base. The stalk is visible, and shadows fall on the white paper.
results.note: A clean specimen photo of one whole green mature leaf. Outline, lobe tips and edge are all easy to read. No twig and no scale object show.

results.description: A small leafy sapling stands in a garden bed above hostas, with green lawn and tall evergreen shrubs behind. The leaves are small in the frame and spread through the whole plant, so no single leaf can be read.
results.note: The main subject is a whole young tree in a garden scene, so the part is other. No leaf, bark or fruit feature can be read from it.

results.description: A large green leaf hangs from the top of the frame and shows its underside, which is paler than the upper side. Three pointed lobes show, with veins running from the stalk. Other leaves overlap on the right and fill the shaded background.
results.note: The leaf is seen from below and tilted, so it is an unusual angle. Other leaves crowd it, and the edge teeth take close study to read. The outline and lobe tips are readable.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame, covered in vertical ridges and flat plates with patches of grey-green lichen. Both trunk edges show, with a little foliage and a thin vine at the sides.
results.note: Sharp view of mature bark with long ridges and plates. The lichen patches do not hide the pattern.

results.description: A thick old trunk splits into several limbs, shown from a distance against yellow autumn foliage and blue sky. Dappled sun and shade fall across the trunk. The furrows are only visible as fine lines at this distance.
results.note: The bark is seen from a distance, so texture and ridge pattern are at search. Patchy sun and shade change the colour, so light is a cause. The trunk is not shot from below.

results.description: A close-up of rough bark with long vertical ridges and flaking plates, in rusty red and grey-brown tones. The frame holds only bark, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
results.note: The frame shows texture only, so too_close is true and the overall ridge pattern is at search. The strong red cast looks like warm light, so light is a cause.

results.description: A young leafy plant stands in a garden bed in front of a spruce trunk and a wooden fence. The leaves are small, spread out and mixed with the surrounding plants. No single leaf is large enough to read.
results.note: The main subject is a whole sapling in a garden scene, so the part is other. No leaf, bark or fruit feature can be read from it.

results.description: A crown of dense orange and red autumn foliage fills the frame, with dark branches showing between the leaves and a little blue sky at the edges. The individual leaves are small and blend into a mass.
results.note: The main subject is a crown in autumn colour, so the part is other. No single leaf, bark or fruit can be read.

results.description: A heap of fallen leaves in yellow, orange, red and brown lies on the ground. Many leaves overlap, and several are brown and spotted. One yellow leaf in the centre is mostly whole, with lobed outline and thin stalk.
results.note: The leaves lie in a crowded pile, so the central leaf's outline and edge are found only with study. Autumn colour is not a cause. Some leaves have spots and tears.

results.description: A twig on a black background carries several maple leaves with sharp lobes at the top and a hanging cluster of paired samaras below. The nutlets are still green and the wings are pale tan and overlap each other. The fruit is the larger subject.
results.note: Samara cluster hangs from the twig, so kind, hang and wing read well. The pairs overlap, so the outline of a single fruit needs a close look (shape search). The nutlets are green, so the fruit is full shape but unripe.

results.description: A tall trunk with a large branch rising on the right, shot against a blue sky and bare trees. The bark is grey with vertical furrows and irregular scaly plates, with some moss and lichen patches. The trunk edge and branch are in the frame.
results.note: The view is wide enough to show the ridge and plate pattern repeat. Moss patches and bare background trees are present but do not hide the bark.

results.description: A large trunk fills the centre of the frame in front of a brick building and green trees. The bark has long vertical ridges and furrows with rough, peeling plates and some darker patches. Light is even and the photo is sharp.
results.note: Both trunk edges are in the frame and the ridge pattern repeats clearly. The building behind does not compete with the trunk.

results.description: The camera looks steeply upward at a thick old trunk that splits into heavy limbs under a green crown. The lower trunk shows furrowed bark and there is a large knotty wound on the right. Leaves and branches fill the upper half of the frame.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, which is the bark_up_or_dark reject. The crown, limbs and wound compete with the bark, and the ridge pattern foreshortens toward the top.

results.description: A single dry brown samara pair, joined at the stalk, on a plain purple-blue background. A scale bar marked 1 cm is below it. Both wings are fully shown, with visible veins, and the photo is sharp and evenly lit.
results.note: A ripe dry samara pair in a studio setting with a scale bar. Kind, shape and wing are easy to read. It is off the twig, so hang is not shown.

results.description: A close-up of dark grey bark that fills the whole frame, with moss and lichen in the furrows. The bark has irregular vertical ridges and rough plates. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is visible.
results.note: Texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close is true. The overall ridge pattern needs some study to read, so pattern is search. Lichen colours the surface green.

results.description: A close-up of grey bark filling the frame, with long vertical ridges, deep furrows and peeling plates and flakes. The photo is sharp and evenly lit. No trunk edge, branch or scale object shows.
results.note: The frame shows texture only, so too_close is true. The ridges and plates are sharp and read well.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the centre of the frame in front of a brick building and green foliage. The bark has vertical ridges and furrows, with a smoother bulge lower down. Light is even and the photo is sharp.
results.note: Trunk edges are in the frame and the ridge and furrow pattern repeats. The building behind is blurred and does not compete.

results.description: A wide view of a very old, gnarled trunk with large limbs in a sunny meadow, with tall grass in front and moss on the bark. The bark looks flaky and furrowed but is small and uneven in the frame. Green foliage is behind.
results.note: The bark is seen from a distance on a twisted old trunk with moss, so texture and pattern need close study (search). Grass and foliage surround the trunk but it stays the main subject.

results.description: A wide view of the old trunk of a tree with twisted limbs, with grass and moss in the frame. The bark has vertical flaking and furrows, but it is not shown at close range.
results.note: Bark from a distance, so the key features are search. The grass and moss do not hide the trunk.

results.description: A single sugar maple samara lies on snow, seen from above. The tan wing and the reddish seed body are in sharp focus on a plain white background. A thin green sprout (radicle) comes out of the seed end.
results.note: A fallen, germinating samara on snow, seen flat from above. Atypical because the seed has sprouted, and angle because it is a top view. The wing outline and the samara kind are easy to read.

results.description: A cluster of sugar maple samaras hangs from a twig. The seed bodies are green and the paired wings are tan and papery. A maple leaf fills the right edge and the background is soft green.
results.note: Full-size samaras that are still green and not ripe, so unripe and not the usual look. They hang from the twig in a clear pair shape and the background is soft.

results.description: A white oak branch is seen from below against the sky. Several lobed leaves overlap in the frame. One large leaf in the centre shows deep rounded lobes and a clear midrib, and the twig crosses the top.
results.note: Upward view of a leafy branch with crowded, overlapping leaves, so alone is false and the angle is unusual. The central leaf outline and rounded lobes can still be read. Veins and the stalk joins need a search.

results.description: Blue-grey green white oak leaves radiate from a twig tip. The pale veins stand out against the leaf blades, and the lobes are rounded with deep sinuses. More leaves fill the background.
results.note: Leaves overlap and crowd the frame, so alone is false. The outlines, rounded lobes and veins of the front leaves are easy to read. The stalk joins sit in a crowded spot, so arrangement needs a search.

results.description: One large white oak leaf fills the centre. It has rounded lobes, pale veins, several small holes, and a few small yellow-green galls at the lower right edge. Other leaves sit behind it in a soft background.
results.note: A whole mature leaf with holes and galls, so damaged. The lobes and the margin can still be traced and the main leaf stands out from the soft background.

results.description: A sugar maple twig with green seeds and tan samara wings hangs in front of a black background. A few green leaves sit at the left. The fruit is bright against the black.
results.note: Samaras with green seeds and drying wings, so unripe. The flash-like light against a black background changes the colour, so light. The kind and the way the fruit hangs are clear.

results.description: A white oak branch with lobed green leaves, seen against blurred trees. Two small acorns sit near the centre: one is green and one has a warty cap. The acorns are small compared with the leaves.
results.note: The acorns are small in the frame and the leaves compete, so the fruit features need a search and alone is false. The green acorns are not ripe. They sit on the twig, so hang is clear.

results.description: A white oak branch hangs over brown mulch. Wet, shiny lobed leaves spread across the frame. Many leaves overlap, though the outlines of several are plain.
results.note: Crowded leaves, so alone is false. Several leaves show their lobes and margin clearly. The veins and the stalk joins need a search.

results.description: A cluster of dry, brown sugar maple samaras hangs from a thin twig. Low warm sun lights the papery wings. The background is a soft blur of bare branches and sky.
results.note: Ripe, dry samaras that hang from the twig. Warm low sun shifts the colour, so light. The wings and the kind are clear and the background is soft.

results.description: A single white oak leaf in a dark setting, tilted toward the upper left. It has rounded lobes, a pale midrib, and clear side veins on a grey-green blade. The background is dark and out of focus.
results.note: The leaf is tilted, so angle, and the dark, flash-like lighting gives it a grey colour, so light. The lobes, margin and veins are still clear.

results.description: A view looking straight up a forked trunk into the crown. The trunk is rough and ridged, and the leaves overhead form a mass against bright sky. No leaf, fruit, or bark area fills the frame as the main subject.
results.note: Whole tree and crown seen from below, so the part is other. Nothing here to judge as a leaf, fruit, or bark feature.

results.description: Green acorns with warty cups sit on a twig among large lobed leaves. The top acorn shows its whole nut and cup, while a second is partly hidden behind it. Leaves crowd the frame and compete with the fruit.
results.note: Green, unripe acorns of full shape on the twig, with the cap and the way they sit on the stalk readable. Busy leaves around them make alone false.

results.description: A close view of a large trunk with deep, vertical, scaly ridges and furrows. Both edges of the trunk show, with a lawn and a brick building soft in the background. The light is even and the bark is grey-brown.
results.note: Sharp, well-lit mature bark with a clear ridge and plate pattern. Trunk edges are in frame, so it is not too close.

results.description: A trunk fills the frame, with narrow vertical ridges broken into small plates and shaggy scales. The trunk edges are visible against a soft green background. The photo is sharp and evenly lit.
results.note: Mature bark with a clear scaly ridge pattern and both trunk edges in frame.

results.description: A single green acorn with a warty cap rests behind the edge of a large lobed leaf, in side view and in focus. The background is soft green. The lower part of the cap is hidden by the leaf, and no twig shows.
results.note: Green unripe acorn of full shape, readable kind and cap, but the leaf covers part of the cap so whole is false. The twig is not shown, so hang is no.

results.description: A leafy branch hangs over a lawn, with many deeply lobed green leaves overlapping. Lobes show clearly on a few leaves at the lower right, but most blend together. The twig is only partly visible.
results.note: Crowded leaves on a branch: single outlines can be traced only with study, so shape and margin are search and alone is false. Green mature leaves with no scale object.

results.description: A large trunk with rough, ridged and plated bark, with patches of bright sun and dark shadow across it. A brick building shows at the left edge. Both edges of the trunk are in frame.
results.note: Dappled sun and shade hide the ridge pattern in places and change the colour, so pattern and colour are search and light is a cause.

results.description: A slim trunk in a forest, covered in small square blocks and plates of bark, with a darker top where it is mossy. Both trunk edges show. The background of leaf litter and other trees is busy but soft.
results.note: Sharp mature bark with a clear blocky plate pattern. The forest background is busy, but the trunk is the clear subject.

results.description: A pale grey trunk with shallow, scaly ridges stands on a lawn with sun and shade. Both trunk edges are in frame, and a brick building and trees are soft in the background. The photo is sharp.
results.note: Mature grey scaly bark with the ridges and plates readable and the trunk edges shown.

results.description: Two ripe golden-brown acorns lie on a plain blue studio background, one bare nut and one with its warty cap. A 1 cm scale bar sits below them. The photo is sharp and evenly lit.
results.note: Ripe acorns laid out on a plain background with a scale bar. Kind, shape, and cap are clear, and hang is no because they are not on a twig.

results.description: A flat pile of brown, dry fallen leaves on the ground, lit by low warm sun with deep black shadows between them. One large leaf sits in the centre, overlapped by many others. Lobed oak-type outlines show, but they run into each other.
results.note: The subject is a pile of dead brown leaves, so dead_leaf applies. Leaves overlap and the sun and shadow are harsh, so the outline and edge can be traced only with study.

results.description: Three green acorns with warty caps sit in a cluster on a twig, in front of several large lobed leaves. The background is soft green. The acorns fill the lower half of the frame.
results.note: Acorns of full shape that are still green, so unripe and not the usual look. The cluster sits on the twig and the caps are clear.

results.description: A cluster of green acorns with bumpy caps on a twig, surrounded by large lobed leaves. A blurred hand and arm show at the top left. The acorns are in the centre and the leaves around them are sharp too.
results.note: Green acorns of full shape, not yet ripe. The hand is blurred in the background and gives no usable scale. Some acorns overlap, but each can be read.

results.description: A whole small tree with bright red autumn foliage stands in front of a conifer forest. The tree crown fills the centre of the frame. The photo shows the tree as a whole, not one leaf, fruit or bark area.
results.note: A crown or whole tree in autumn colour, so the part is other and no feature checklist applies.

results.description: A branch with a cluster of bright red autumn leaves, sharp against a soft dark conifer background. The leaves are small in the frame and many overlap. Pointed lobes show on some of them.
results.note: Autumn colour, so growth_stage autumn and not the usual look. The leaves are small and crowded, so outline and edge need close study but can be traced. The soft background keeps the cluster the main subject.

results.description: A small plant seen from above with several green lobed leaves on thin stems, over brown leaf litter. The lobes are pointed and the vein lines are pale. Leaves overlap in places. The photo is small.
results.note: The lower-centre leaf shows its full outline and lobes. The edge teeth are small at this size, and several leaves sit close together, so margin is search and alone is false.

results.description: Four acorns with warty caps hang in a cluster in dark shade, among leaves. The nuts are pink-brown with green tips. The background is very dark and the colours are strong, like flash or slide film.
results.note: Acorns of full shape that are still ripening, with green tips and a pink cast. The dark background and the strong colour from flash or film change how the colour reads. How they sit on the twig is only partly shown.

results.description: The underside of a large lobed green leaf against sunlit foliage and ground. The pale veins and the deep lobes with pointed tips are sharp. The leaf is tilted toward the camera.
results.note: A mature green leaf seen from below at a tilt, so angle. Lobes and bristle tips can be read. The soft background keeps the leaf the main subject.

results.description: A single green acorn with a warty cap on a twig, with large leaves around it. The acorn is in sharp focus in the centre. The background is soft.
results.note: One whole green acorn on its twig, with its cap clear. It is full shape but not ripe, so unripe and not the usual look.

results.description: The tip of a shoot with yellow and orange lobed leaves spread out in strong sun, in front of dark green foliage. The leaves show pointed lobes and pale veins. Some leaves overlap.
results.note: Autumn colour, so growth_stage autumn and not the usual look. The top-centre leaf shows its full outline. The edge teeth are small at this size.

results.description: A red oak trunk photographed from the base looking straight up toward the crown. The furrowed, vertically ridged bark fills the frame and narrows with perspective, with green leaves and sky at the top.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, so the ridges are foreshortened and the pattern is hard to read. Rejected as bark_up_or_dark, with the angle cause.

results.description: Several lobed oak leaves on a branch in the understory, seen from above against a ground of dry leaf litter. The leaves overlap and the busy background competes with them. One large leaf at the lower centre shows its full outline.
results.note: Green mature leaves with pointed lobes, shown on the upper side. The leaves are crowded and the leaf litter behind is busy, so alone is false and the bristle-tipped margin needs a search.

results.description: A branch of dark green leaves with pointed, bristle-tipped lobes, seen from the upper side. The background is a soft blur of a garden path and greenery, so the leaves stand out. Some leaves are cut by the frame edge.
results.note: Mature green leaves with clear lobes and bristle tips against a soft background. Venation and leaf-stalk joins are small in the frame, so they need a search.

results.description: A twig with young, light green leaves that are just unfolding, with small catkins hanging among them. Strong sun shines through the thin leaves against a soft green background. The lobes are sharply pointed and the central leaf shows its outline.
results.note: Spring leaves that have not reached full size, with catkins as a sign of spring, so young. The sun behind the leaves changes their colour, so light. The lobes and edge are still readable.

results.description: Four broad, shallowly lobed pale green leaves radiate from one point in front of a mossy trunk. Their stalks meet at a single spot on the bark rather than on a twig. The leaves look thin and fresh.
results.note: The leaves sprout directly from the trunk, so this looks like a sucker or epicormic shoot, with broader and shallower lobes than the mature leaf. Rejected as sucker_leaf. This is a judgement call.

results.description: A leafy branch of lobed oak leaves with a large leaf at the centre, seen from the upper side. Other leaves overlap it and fill the frame, with a thin trunk behind. Some leaves are cut off at the frame edge.
results.note: The central leaf shows its pointed lobes and bristle tips well. Leaves crowd around it, so alone is false.

results.description: A trunk seen from the ground looking steeply up into the crown. The dark bark is small in the frame and the crown with sky fills much of the picture.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, and the bark is dark and far away, so ridges are hard to read. Rejected as bark_up_or_dark, with the angle cause.

results.description: A sunlit twig with small, yellow-green young leaves and long hanging catkins, against dark trees and a gravestone in the background. The leaves are clustered, translucent, and backlit. Catkins take much of the attention.
results.note: Spring leaves that are small and unfolding, with catkins. The outline and lobes can be found only with close study. The backlight changes the colour, so light.

results.description: A dense mass of bright red autumn foliage on many branches. The leaves overlap and blend together, and no single leaf outline can be traced. Dark branches cross the frame.
results.note: The red leaves blend into a mass with no readable edge. Rejected as leaf_mass and feature_unclear. Autumn colour is the growth stage and not a cause.

results.description: A broad mature trunk filling the frame, photographed straight on from the base. The grey-brown bark has long, narrow ridges and furrows, with some lichen near the base. A small tag is on the left edge and a park with sky is behind.
results.note: Sharp, wide view of the trunk with trunk edges visible. The ridges and furrows are easy to read. The small tag has no readable name.

results.description: A close-up of a trunk's bark in warm low sun. Vertical, flat-topped ridges with dark cracks between them fill the frame, with patches of grey and yellow lichen. There is no trunk edge, branch, or scale object.
results.note: Texture only, with no trunk edge or scale, so too_close is true. Warm low sun and lichen shift the bark colour, so colour is search and light is a cause.

results.description: Newly opening leaves on a twig against blue sky. The leaves are still partly folded and curled, with unfolded blades on stalks above a bud at the twig end. A tulip-tree-like lobed outline shows on the right-hand leaf.
results.note: Spring flush of young leaves, still folded and not at full shape, so young is a cause. The full outline is not shown and the stalks bunch at the twig tip, so shape and arrangement are search.

results.description: A single large brown acorn hangs from a short twig stalk against a soft green blur. The scaly, shallow cap sits over a pale-streaked brown nut with a small tip. The whole fruit is in frame and sharp.
results.note: A ripe acorn, whole and sharp on a plain soft background, hanging from its twig stalk, so kind, shape, hang and cap are all readable.

results.description: Five brown acorns lie on a pale grey background, some with their caps on and some tilted on their sides. The cap scales and the nut shape are visible. The twig stalks are cut short, so they do not show how the fruit sits on a branch.
results.note: Ripe acorns on a plain background. Nothing shows how they hang, so hang is no.

results.description: A seed-bank style photo on a blue background. It shows an acorn with its cap, a cut acorn showing a pale cross-section, and the base of another nut. A 1 cm scale bar sits under the acorns.
results.note: Several views of ripe acorns with a scale bar on a plain background. The main acorn with its cap is whole and clear. Nothing shows how it hangs.

results.description: A leafy branch of a tulip tree, with several yellow-orange tulip-shaped flowers among many green lobed leaves. The flowers and the leaf mass compete for attention. No single leaf, bark area, or fruit is the main subject.
results.note: The subject is flowers among a crowd of leaves, so the part is other. The flowers are the sign of spring.

results.description: A dense cluster of broad green leaves on a branch, lit from behind and seen partly from below. A pale green bud or young cone sits near the middle. One large lobed leaf in the lower centre is the clearest, but others overlap it and the frame edge cuts some off.
results.note: Crowded, overlapping leaves seen from below in backlight, so alone is false and angle and light are causes. No leaf shows its full outline, so shape is search.

results.description: Four views of pale, dry acorns on a black background. One is an upright acorn with its scaly cap, one is a nut without a cap, and two are top and base views. All are sharp and well separated.
results.note: Ripe acorns shown in several views on a plain black background. Kind, shape and cap are clear. The nuts are not on a twig, so hang is no.

results.description: Three green, unripe acorns with scaly caps sit on a woody twig among pointed, lobed leaves, with soft green grass behind. The nuts are full-sized and green. The branch and leaves are close around them.
results.note: Green, unripe acorns of full shape, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false. They sit on a twig with leaves and branches around them, so alone is false.

results.description: A wide view of a grey trunk filling the frame, with both trunk edges visible. Vertical, rough, flat-topped ridges with shallow furrows run the full height. The light is even and the focus is sharp.
results.note: Mature bark with the ridge pattern repeating across the full trunk width and both trunk edges in frame. Sharp, even light.

results.description: A view up into a tree crown filled with many overlapping leaves, mostly yellow and brown autumn colour with some green ones, against a patch of grey sky. No single leaf stands out and the outlines run together.
results.note: Crown seen from below with leaves blending into a mass in autumn colour, so no single leaf outline or edge can be read. Angle is from below.

results.description: A leafy branch scene seen from below with a trunk and several branches. A few orange and green tulip-shaped flowers sit among the green leaves. The leaves are small in the frame and the flowers are minor.
results.note: Whole crown scene with flowers, no single leaf, fruit or bark as the main subject, so the part is other.

results.description: A street tree trunk fills the frame from top to bottom, with grey-brown vertical furrows and ridges. Patches of grey-green lichen sit on the bark. A street, a sign and a building are soft in the background.
results.note: Mature trunk with the trunk edges in frame and a clear furrow and ridge pattern. Lichen patches and a street background do not hide the pattern.

results.description: One whole green tulip tree leaf lies flat against a dark, bark-like background. The leaf has the typical four-pointed lobed outline with a notched tip and the stalk at the bottom. The veins are visible and a few small spots mark the blade.
results.note: Sharp, whole mature leaf on a plain dark background. Small spots do not change the outline.

results.description: One whole green leaf with a broad notched top and shallow side lobes lies on a ground covered with yellow and brown fallen leaves. The pale veins are visible. The frame shows the leaf outline and the stalk.
results.note: Whole green mature leaf, probably the underside, shown against fallen autumn leaves. The litter is a sign of autumn but the leaf itself is green and full size.

results.description: A cluster of green lobed leaves on a leafy twig, overlapping each other, seen against a dark green background. One or two leaves in the lower centre are mostly whole, but others are cut off or overlap. A bud or flower remnant sits near the middle of the twig.
results.note: Crowded leaves that overlap, so the shape and margin of one leaf must be found with a search. Some of the leaf stalks join the twig, but it is hard to trace.

results.description: A twig with two open tulip-shaped yellow and orange flowers and several large green lobed leaves. A green bud sits at the lower left. The flowers are the clear main subject.
results.note: Flowers are the main subject, so the part is other. The leaves around them are not the focus.

results.description: The tip of a branch with many small green leaves, seen from below against a clear blue sky. Warm low sun lights part of the leaves. The leaves are small and blend together.
results.note: Upward view of a crown where the leaves blend into a mass and no single outline can be read. Warm sun and a low angle make it harder.

results.description: A close view of rough, grey-brown bark with deep vertical furrows and narrow ridges that fill the whole frame. There is no trunk edge, branch or scale object in the frame.
results.note: Texture-only crop with no trunk edge or scale, so it is too close. The ridge and furrow pattern is still readable and sharp.

results.description: A group of low, bluish-green leaves with irregular, rounded lobes lies on the ground among grass and small compound-leaved plants. The leaves overlap each other and their shapes differ from the typical tulip tree leaf.
results.note: Low juvenile or sucker-type leaves with irregular lobes, seen from above among ground plants. This form is not the named mature leaf, so it is a sucker leaf reject.

results.description: A full trunk fills the centre of the frame with both edges visible. Long, narrow, interlacing grey ridges with shallow furrows run up the trunk. Dark foliage and a patch of blue sky sit behind it.
results.note: Sharp trunk with readable ridges, both trunk edges in frame, plain dark background. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A tight close-up of deeply furrowed bark with long vertical ridges. Yellow-green lichen covers many of the ridges and strong sun casts hard shadows in the furrows. No trunk edge or scale object is in the frame.
results.note: Texture-only frame with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close. The lichen hides the true bark colour, so colour needs a search.

results.description: A view from the foot of the tree looking straight up the trunk into the crown. The lower trunk shows foreshortened ridged bark, and the branches and leaves fill the upper half of the frame against the sky.
results.note: The camera looks up into the crown, and the bark is foreshortened and small in the frame. The crown competes with the trunk.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame, shaded, with green foliage and ground behind it. The bark has vertical ridges with pale grey-white patches along the furrows. The file is small but sharp.
results.note: Clear ridged bark with both trunk edges in frame and a soft, plain background. The photo is small but sharp.

results.description: Two children stand in front of a very large trunk in a forest, each holding a leaf up in front of their face. The trunk behind them shows coarse, deeply furrowed bark with moss at its base. The children take up most of the lower half of the frame.
results.note: The children compete with the trunk, and the bark is soft and in shade, so the pattern needs close study. The people give a scale cue. The leaves they hold are not the subject.

results.description: A straight trunk fills the frame, with a lawn, a rail and a path behind it. The bark has sharp vertical ridges with pale furrows and a warm brown-grey tone. A few leaves show at the top left.
results.note: Sharp, readable bark with the trunk edges in frame and a soft background. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A wide trunk fills the frame against blue sky, with a few leaves at the right edge. The bark has tall ridges with pale furrows between them. The trunk edges are visible.
results.note: Crisp trunk with a plain sky and foliage background. Ridges and colour read easily.

results.description: A close-up of bark with thick ridges that cross in a diagonal diamond pattern. Grey-green lichen patches cover some of the ridges. The frame has no trunk edge, branch or scale object.
results.note: Texture-only frame with no trunk edge, branch or scale, so too_close. The ridges are sharp and the pattern is easy to read.

results.description: A large dark trunk rises from a forest floor covered in yellow fallen leaves. Thin saplings and branches stand around it and the canopy above is turning yellow. The trunk base is in deep shade and the ridges show only faintly.
results.note: The trunk is dark and seen from a distance in a busy forest scene, so its features need a search. The lower trunk is in deep shade. The ridges are still faintly readable, so this is not a dark reject.

results.description: Several bare winter trunks stand together against a pale sky. The main trunk has fine grey ridges. A dark shaded trunk is next to it, and one on the right is covered in a hairy vine. Shadows of twigs fall across the trunks.
results.note: Several trunks, vines and twigs compete, and the fine ridges are small in the frame, so features need a search. The bare twigs show winter.

results.description: A dry tan-brown tulip tree fruit stands upright on a short twig, seen from the side. The scales at the base flare open and the tip is still closed. The background is soft green and yellow.
results.note: Whole ripe cone of samaras on its twig against a soft background, sharp and easy to read. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A tan tulip tree fruit seen from directly above, with the samaras spread out flat like a rosette. It lies against snow with a bit of twig at the left. Each samara wing is visible around a central spike.
results.note: Top view of a splayed fruit, so the usual cone outline is not visible: angle and atypical. The individual samaras read well and the background is plain snow.

results.description: A green, closed tulip tree fruit stands upright at the end of a twig, among green leaves. The fruit is long and narrow with a pointed tip and a rough surface. The leaves behind are soft and out of focus.
results.note: Unripe green fruit of full shape, so unripe and not the usual look. The samaras are packed tight and no wings show, so a learner has to study it to see that it is a cone of samaras.

results.description: A dry tan tulip tree fruit with orange-brown stains stands upright on a short stalk. The tip is closed and the outer samaras flare out. The background is black.
results.note: Sharp, whole ripe fruit on a plain black background. Flash lighting against black changes the colour: light. No twig shows, so how it sits is not visible.

results.description: Two small dry tulip tree fruits sit on a thin bare twig that crosses a large autumn crown. The background is blurred orange, yellow and green. The fruits fill only a small part of the frame.
results.note: The fruits are small in the frame and the twigs and colourful background compete, so kind and shape need a search. The fruits themselves are sharp enough to trace.

results.description: Several frost-covered dry tulip tree fruits sit on bare twigs against a deep blue background. One fruit is sharp in the centre and the others are partly out of focus. The tips and scales are covered in white frost.
results.note: The central fruit is sharp and sits on its twig. Frost covers the surface so the individual wings need a closer look. The blue background is strongly saturated but the fruit colour looks natural.

results.description: A pale, weathered tulip tree fruit lies on the ground among dead grass, bits of litter and clover leaves. The fruit is upright in the frame and some outer samaras are loose around its base. The picture is small and the litter is busy.
results.note: A fallen, weathered fruit with loose samaras, so it is not the usual form: atypical. The litter around it competes, so kind and wing need a search.

results.description: A brown, dry tulip tree fruit with flared scale tips fills the centre of the frame. Yellow and green autumn leaves and a thin twig are soft in the background. A stalk joins it to the branch behind.
results.note: Sharp ripe fruit against a soft autumn background. The stalk shows, but how it joins the twig is only partly visible, so hang is a search.

results.description: A pale tan dry tulip tree fruit sits on a thin twig, seen from the side against a blue sky. Bare dark branches cross the background. The fruit is small but sharp.
results.note: Whole ripe fruit on its twig against a plain sky, with bare twigs showing winter. The individual wings are small and need a close look.

results.description: A view up into a bare-looking crown with many small brown fruits on thin twigs and a few yellow autumn leaves. Cloudy sky shows between the branches. No single fruit or leaf is the subject.
results.note: Crown scene seen from below. The fruits are tiny dots, so the main subject is the whole crown and the part is other.

results.description: A dried tulip tree fruit stands upright on a bare twig against snow. The cone of samaras has opened like a flower, with most of the winged seeds still attached and a few already shed. The twig is visible below it.
results.note: A sharp, whole winter cone of samaras on its twig with plain snow behind. The opened, part-shed cone looks like a flower, so it is atypical and not the usual ripe look.

results.description: A mass of bare twigs and branches against a clear blue sky. A few small dark dried fruit cones are scattered along the twigs. No leaf, bark area, or single fruit is the main subject.
results.note: A bare winter crown seen against the sky. The fruits are tiny and not the main subject, so the part is other.

results.description: A cluster of plane tree leaves on a shoot against blurred trees and sky. Several leaves are still green and others have turned red-brown. The top-left leaf shows its lobes clearly, and the others overlap.
results.note: Leaves crowd and overlap, and the edges are small in the frame, so the margin is a search. The red and brown colour is autumn colour, so the stage is autumn and it is not the usual look.

results.description: A large green plane tree leaf fills the lower centre, held on a twig above a sunlit lawn. A second leaf with its stalk and twig joint is at the upper left. The lobes, toothed edge, and veins can be read.
results.note: A sharp, whole mature leaf on a plain lawn background, with a leaf stalk joining the twig at the top left. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A leafy shoot or sapling fills the frame, with a dark tree behind it. The many green leaves overlap and blend into a mass. Only a few leaves in the middle show lobes, and none shows its edge clearly.
results.note: A sapling's foliage where the leaves blend into a mass. No single leaf outline is whole, and the lobes and edges are small in the frame.

results.description: A large plane tree leaf seen from below, with pale raised veins and fine dark speckles, lies over other leaves on the forest floor. Brown leaf litter is behind it. Neighbouring leaves overlap its edges, and the bottom of the frame cuts the base.
results.note: Overlapping leaves and a frame edge that cuts the leaf make the outline hard to trace, so shape and margin are searches. The speckles do not change the outline.

results.description: Three plane tree leaves are held up in front of a trunk with peeling cream and brown bark. A hand shows at the right edge and holds one leaf. The leaves are seen from below, with veins visible, and they overlap each other and the bark.
results.note: The leaves are the main subject, held in front of the bark. The hand covers part of one leaf and the leaves overlap on a busy background. The hand is only partly in the frame, so size is a search.

results.description: A large plane tree leaf with the underside showing sits in the centre over a green lawn. Its pointed lobes, toothed edge, and net of pale veins are sharp. Parts of other leaves show at the left and bottom edges.
results.note: A sharp, whole mature leaf on a plain lawn. The stalk does not join a twig, so arrangement is no.

results.description: A green shoot with several plane tree leaves rises against a dark, mixed background with some red and brown autumn leaves. Two lobed leaves overlap at the top, and the leaf stalks join the central stem below them. More leaves crowd the lower part and the frame edges cut some off.
results.note: Crowded, overlapping leaves with some tilted away from the camera, so the edges are small and need a search. The autumn-coloured leaves in the background set the season.

results.description: A plane tree leaf is seen from below, lit by the sun with a pale yellow-green colour and raised veins. Shaded leaves overlap it in the upper part. A street is blurred behind it, and the base of the leaf runs out of the bottom of the frame.
results.note: Viewed from below with strong sun and shadow that change the leaf colour. The leaf is cut by the frame edge and overlapped by others, so the outline and edge need a search.

results.description: One large green sycamore leaf photographed against a black background, upper side facing the camera, with a twig and petiole at the top. Three broad pointed lobes with coarse teeth and palmate veins are visible. A few brown blotches mark the leaf and a neighbouring leaf, and the lighting looks like flash at night.
results.note: Whole mature leaf on plain black with a clear outline and toothed margin. The flash lighting against black shifts the colour a little, so I listed light as a cause. Brown blotches do not change the outline.

results.description: A very old, multi-stemmed hollow sycamore seen from a distance in a wooded area. Several pale trunks with mottled peeling bark rise from a gnarled base with a dark cavity, and green undergrowth and foliage fill the frame around them.
results.note: The mottled cream, grey and brown patches are readable on the trunks, but the bark is seen from a distance, so texture is search. Dense foliage around the tree competes with the subject.

results.description: A single large sycamore leaf, upper side up, held against bare gravel ground, with other leaves cut off at the top edge. The leaf has pointed lobes with toothed edges and clear palmate veins, and a pale mottled yellow-green surface.
results.note: Whole leaf on a plain gravel background with a readable outline and teeth. The leaf stalk runs up to the top edge but its join with the twig is not clearly shown, so arrangement is search.

results.description: A bare winter sycamore crown seen from below against a blue sky. A fork of pale, mottled limbs and many thin twigs fill the frame. No leaves, fruit or readable bark detail show.
results.note: The main subject is the leafless crown, so the part is other. The view from below is an unusual angle.

results.description: A leafy sycamore branch laid on grey weathered deck boards. Five or six large green leaves with pointed lobes and toothed edges overlap each other, and the petioles meet the twig at its nodes. The lower leaves are cut off by the frame.
results.note: Several overlapping leaves with the frame cutting off the lower ones, so whole and alone are false. The upper leaves still show their outline and teeth, and the twig shows where the stalks join.

results.description: The base of a large sycamore trunk beside a street, with parked cars, a kerb and grass in the frame. The lower trunk shows pale cream and grey peeling patches. The upper trunk is dark and greyish in shade with some lichen.
results.note: The trunk is shown in a street scene with cars competing for attention. The mottled pattern shows mostly at the base, and the upper trunk is shaded and dull, so texture and pattern are search.

results.description: A close view of a sycamore trunk in warm golden light, with peeling cream, olive and brown patches. A smooth grey-green branch crosses in front of the trunk, and dry reeds are soft in the background.
results.note: The peeling patch pattern shows clearly over a wide trunk area, with a branch and the trunk edge in frame. The warm golden light shifts the bark colour, so I listed light as a cause.

results.description: A close view of sunlit bright green sycamore leaves, with one large leaf at the centre. It has pointed lobes, a toothed margin and palmate veins. A small spiky flower head sits on a reddish twig at the top right, and the leaf has a few tiny holes.
results.note: The central leaf outline and teeth are readable, but neighbouring leaves crowd and overlap it. The flower head is a sign of spring and does not replace the leaf. The twig shows where the leaf stalks join it. The tiny holes do not change the outline.

results.description: A pale, smooth-looking sycamore trunk in bright sun, photographed from slightly below against a blue sky. Large cream, olive and grey patches make a mottled pattern, and the trunk splits into limbs with bare twigs crossing the frame.
results.note: The patch pattern is clear over a wide trunk area. The camera looks up at the trunk from below, which is an unusual angle, but the bark stays easy to read.

results.description: A tight close-up of sycamore bark that fills the whole frame. Olive-green, cream-white and orange-brown patches make a camouflage-like mosaic with clear patch edges. No trunk edge, branch or scale object is in frame.
results.note: Texture only, with no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so too_close is true. The patch pattern and colours are sharp and easy to read.

results.description: A single green, spiny seed ball hangs on a stalk from the top of the frame. It fills the middle of the photo and sits in front of a large green leaf with a soft shadow. The ball is full-sized but still green.
results.note: Full-shaped green seed ball on its stalk, sharp and centred. Unripe, so not the usual look. The stalk shows but the twig does not, so hang needs a search.

results.description: The base of a large trunk with a flared root collar sits against a kerb. Grass and fallen leaves surround it, and part of a red car shows at the right edge. The lower bark is dark and furrowed, with pale peeling patches near the roots.
results.note: Whole trunk base in a street scene. The kerb, car and grass compete with the trunk. The plates are small in the frame and the lower bark is darker than the mottled upper bark, so texture and pattern need a search.

results.description: A bare, leafless tree is seen from below against a blue sky. White, peeling upper limbs and branches fan out across the frame. The photo shows the whole tree form, not a close view of the bark.
results.note: Winter crown and limbs seen from below. The main subject is the tree form, so the part is other. The upward view is the angle cause.

results.description: A round, orange-brown ball lies on a rotting log among dead leaves. Its surface is a honeycomb of small cavities where the seeds were. A second dark chunk and some pale fluff lie at its upper right.
results.note: A spent seed ball on the ground with the seed fluff gone and the bare cavity surface showing. It is not the typical hanging ball, and the view is from above. The log and leaf litter compete with it, and the learner must study the surface to read the fruit kind.

results.description: Bare twigs and branches reach across a blue sky. Many small round seed balls hang from them. The balls are tiny in the frame.
results.note: Winter seed balls hanging on bare twigs, seen from below against plain sky. The balls are small and the twigs crowd them, so kind and shape need a search. How they hang is easy to see.

results.description: A pale trunk rises through the frame and splits into spreading limbs, with green leaves around it. The upper trunk is smooth and creamy white. The lower trunk is darker with brown peeling patches. The camera looks slightly upward.
results.note: Trunk and limbs with leaves behind, shot from a low angle. The bark is small in the frame and branches and leaves compete with it, so texture and pattern need a search. The trunk is still the main subject, so I did not reject for the upward view.

results.description: A ripe brown seed ball hangs from a thin stalk against a blue sky. Bare branches show in the soft background. The ball fills the middle of the frame and its spiky surface is sharp.
results.note: A clear, whole, ripe seed ball hanging on its stalk against a plain background. Nothing makes it harder.

results.description: A close view of trunk bark fills the frame. It is mottled with grey-green, cream, yellow and brown plates of different sizes. A rounded bulge sits at the left of the middle, and some lichen marks the right side.
results.note: Sharp texture-only close-up of mottled flaking bark. The frame has no trunk edge, branch or scale object, so it is too close.

results.description: A trunk with pale grey-green mottled bark stands in the middle of the frame. Green leaves hang in front of it and around it. A small cluster of yellow flowers and more leaves sit in the lower foreground.
results.note: Mottled, flaking trunk bark that is readable. Leaves and the yellow flowers in front and below compete with the trunk, so it is not alone.

results.description: A pale trunk with smooth creamy bark is seen in full-width view. A broken branch scar and brown peeling patches show on it. Green leaves hang in front and behind, and a small cluster of yellow flowers sits in the lower foreground.
results.note: Readable trunk with mottled and peeling bark. Leaves in front and the small yellow flower cluster at the bottom compete with it.

results.description: A single seed ball hangs from a short pale stalk against a blurred sky and utility poles. The ball is breaking up: pale fluffy hairs have burst out of the centre and the dark seed-bearing surface is only a rim around it. It is a whole fruit, centred and sharp.
results.note: The seed ball has come apart after seed fall, so the outline is ragged and the fruit kind is harder to read than on an intact ball. The stalk shows, so the hang is clear.

results.description: Many small brown seed balls dangle on thin stalks from bare twigs against a deep blue sky. One dead leaf shows at the far left edge. The balls are intact and hang clearly, but each is small in the frame.
results.note: Round seed balls hang on stalks from a bare twig, a clear typical look. Each ball is small in the frame, so the outline needs a closer look (shape at search).

results.description: A large lobed leaf is held up by a hand at the lower left, with its stalk joining at the top centre. The surface shows raised pale veins, with a brown lesion near the bottom lobe, a small hole on the left, and a lesion on the right edge. Other leaves crowd the top right, and the frame cuts off the right lobe.
results.note: The frame edge cuts off the right lobe, so the whole outline is not shown, and the blade has holes and a brown patch. The source name is the London planetree, which passes under Identity. The depth feature two_heads is for fruit and does not apply to this leaf.

results.description: A small green seed ball hangs from a long green stalk below a brown twig, with a young pale leaf at the top. The background is soft green. The ball is still small, green and fresh.
results.note: The ball is young and green with new leaf growth beside it, so it has not reached its mature look. The stalk and ball outline are plain against the soft background.

results.description: A round green-yellow spiky seed ball hangs from a stalk in front of blurred autumn foliage. The ball is sharp and centred, with yellowing leaves behind it. It has reached full size but is still green.
results.note: Full-shape ball that is still green, so it is unripe and not the usual brown look. The stalk shows and the busy background is soft.

results.description: A burst seed ball lies on a rough bark-covered log. It is seen from the top as a flat disc: a dark knobby core ringed by pale fluffy hairs, with a short stalk to the right. The ball shape is gone.
results.note: The ball has fallen apart after seed fall and is seen from above lying on a log, so it is atypical and an unusual angle. The kind and outline need close study, and it does not show how the fruit hangs.

results.description: Six dark brown seed balls hang on thin stalks from a bare twig against a clear blue sky. They are sharp, intact and well spaced.
results.note: A clear, typical view of ripe seed balls hanging on stalks from a bare twig. The sky is plain, so nothing competes.

results.description: A large yellow-green spiky seed ball hangs from a long stalk on a bare twig, against blue sky and a blurred hillside. A few small brown balls show far behind it. The ball is full sized, sharp and centred.
results.note: Full-shape ball that is still yellow-green, so it is unripe and not the usual brown look. The stalk and the way it hangs are clear.

results.description: A small olive-green spiky seed ball hangs from a long thin stalk below bare twigs with red-tipped buds. The background is soft grey. The ball is centred but small in the frame.
results.note: An intact seed ball hangs from a long stalk on a bare twig. Its olive-green coat may be a weathered surface, so I counted it as ripe.

results.description: A paved path runs between two rows of planetrees in full leaf, with hedges at the sides and a road at the left. The trees and their crowns are the main subject. No single leaf, fruit or bark area is shown.
results.note: A scene of a tree-lined path with no single part as the subject, so the part is other. The depth feature two_heads is for fruit and is not answered.

results.description: A wide view of a sycamore-type trunk with a mottled pattern of pale cream patches and brown-grey peeling plates. A branch with several green leaves hangs across the upper left. The background is dark and out of focus.
results.note: The trunk shows the patchy plates and the colour repeat over a wide area, with the trunk edge visible. Leaves in the foreground take some attention from the bark, so alone is false.

results.description: One large dark green lobed leaf is held up against a mottled trunk with pale and grey patches. A hand shows at the top edge, and the leaf's right lobe runs to the frame edge. Soft green background on the right.
results.note: The leaf outline and edge read well, but the right lobe is cut off by the frame, so whole is false. The hand at the top does not hold the leaf and gives no scale.

results.description: A dense mass of green and yellow-green leaves on many twigs, filling the whole frame. One bare twig crosses diagonally. No single leaf stands out from the others.
results.note: The leaves overlap and blend into a mass seen from below, with bright sky showing through some of them. No one leaf outline can be traced without close study.

results.description: A close view of a trunk with a camouflage pattern of cream, olive, and brown-grey plates, where the bark flakes off. Bark fills the frame from top to bottom and the trunk edges show on both sides. Soft green background.
results.note: Clear sharp view of the flaking plates and the patchy colour on a mature trunk. The trunk edges show, so the frame is not texture only.

results.description: A large grey-green maple-like leaf held up in one hand, with strong veins and a few small spots and flecks. Another leaf overlaps the upper right corner. The background is soft green foliage.
results.note: The blade and the lobe tips show well and the hand gives a scale. The visible face looks like the underside, with raised veins and a dull colour. Small spots do not change the outline.

results.description: A large brown-orange fallen leaf lies on grass among other dead leaves. Its lobes and teeth are visible and the leaf stalk runs up from it. Other leaves overlap its lower edge.
results.note: The subject is a dry brown leaf on the ground, so it is a dead leaf. Other leaves overlap the lower lobes and compete for attention.

results.description: A view up into a branch of green leaves over a street, with a car and a post at the bottom. A single spiky seed ball hangs at the right of the frame. Bright sky shows behind the upper leaves.
results.note: Leaves overlap and the street scene competes. A learner can find one lobed leaf only with close study. The view is from below with backlight on the upper leaves.

results.description: A tree-lined city street with trunks that have peeling bark and green crowns over the road. Cyclists ride on the road. No single leaf, fruit, or area of bark is the subject.
results.note: A street scene with whole trees, so the part is other. People are in the frame but no key feature is the subject.

results.description: One green lobed leaf with pointed lobes and a toothed edge, seen from above against a dark soft background. A leaf stalk runs down, and parts of two more leaves show at the lower left edge. The leaf is sharp and well lit.
results.note: A clean photo of one whole leaf with a clear outline, edge, and veins. The stalk is shown but not where it joins the twig.

results.description: Placeholder
results.note: placeholder

results.description: A leafy twig seen from below against blue sky. Several round seed balls hang on thin stalks among sharply lobed green leaves. The balls are small in the frame and the leaves crowd around them.
results.note: Small green-brown seed balls hang singly from the twig, seen from below with leaves crowding them, so the outline needs a search. The balls look not yet ripe, and the view from below is an angle cause. No two balls share one stalk.

results.description: A close view of a plane trunk with patchy bark in cream, olive and pink-brown, partly covered in grey-green lichen. The trunk edge shows on the right, with a pavement and fallen leaves beyond. The light is flat and even.
results.note: Mottled flaking bark with lichen over much of it, so the patch pattern needs close study. The trunk edge is in frame, so it is not too close.

results.description: A tight view of bark in warm low sun with strong shadow. Cream and tan plates peel to show orange-brown patches beneath. No trunk edge or scale object shows.
results.note: Peeling plates with a clear outline show the flaking pattern. Warm low sun shifts the colour, so the colour is hard to read. The frame is texture only.

results.description: A thick trunk that forks, seen from below, with bare branches and pale sky behind. The bark is dark, warty and rough, with a few pale flaking patches low down. The camera looks up along the trunk.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk toward the crown, and the bark is dark and burred, so the pattern is hard to read. Bare branches show the winter season.

results.description: A branch with several large green lobed leaves, lit from behind against a bright sky. Part of a flaking trunk shows at the right, and power cables cross the lower left. The leaves overlap one another.
results.note: Overlapping broad leaves with backlight, cables and trunk competing in the frame. No single outline is clear of the others, so shape and margin need a search.

results.description: A trunk close-up with smooth bark that has peeled into large cream, grey-green and brown patches. Green leafy woodland shows at the sides, and both trunk edges are in frame. The light is soft and even.
results.note: Sharp, wide view of the typical camouflage flaking pattern with the trunk edges in frame.

results.description: A close view of rough, thick, ridged bark with small flaking plates in olive-brown. The right half is in deep shadow and the left half is lit warm. There is no trunk edge or scale object.
results.note: The rough texture reads well. The shadow over half the frame and the warm light shift the colour and make the pattern hard to trace. The frame is texture only.

results.description: A very close, sharp view of bark with blotchy patches of yellow, green, olive and rust-brown. The patches have soft edges. No trunk edge, branch or scale object shows.
results.note: Close-up of the typical mottled bark. The frame is texture only with no trunk edge. The colours are vivid but not toned.

results.description: A narrow upright trunk against a white wall with a window, with a few dark leaves at the top left. The bark is patchy, with cream, tan and brown flaking plates. The trunk fills the frame and both edges show.
results.note: A clear view of the patchy flaking bark with the trunk edges in frame. The wall behind the trunk is plain.

results.description: A narrow upright trunk against a white wall with a window, with a few dark leaves at the top left. The bark is patchy, with cream, tan and brown flaking plates. The trunk fills the frame and both edges show.
results.note: A clear view of the patchy flaking bark with the trunk edges in frame. The wall behind the trunk is plain.

results.description: A mass of green plane-tree leaves fills the frame, seen from below and at an angle through overcast light. One leaf near the centre shows its lobes, but the rest overlap and blend together. A few small dark seed balls hang tiny in the background.
results.note: The frame is a leaf mass from the crown, with many overlapping leaves and no single leaf set apart. The lobes and edge of the centre leaf can be traced only with close study.

results.description: A hand holds a thin stalk. A small, round, spiky green seed ball hangs at the end of it, below the fingers. A large lobed leaf and a blurred leafy background fill the rest of the frame.
results.note: A single green, full-shape seed ball held by the stalk in a hand, so hang is not shown. The big hand and leaf compete with the small ball, and the fruit is unripe, not the usual brown ball.

results.description: A brown seed ball that has partly come apart lies on a blue-grey paving stone, seen from above. Loose fluffy seeds and bits of fluff are scattered on the stone and in the crack next to it. The background is plain.
results.note: The ball is broken open and has lost many seeds, so it is not the typical form, and it is seen from straight above on the ground. The outline is still readable on the plain stone.

results.description: A sunlit scene of a plane tree in late season. Large brown dry leaves hang in the foreground and a trunk stands in the grass behind. A small green seed ball hangs near the centre, tiny in the frame. A person's shadow falls on the grass.
results.note: The main subject is the whole scene (trunk, brown leaves, branches), and no one of leaf, bark or fruit leads. Warm low sun colours the whole frame.

results.description: A round, spiky, green seed ball hangs from a long green stalk in the centre of the frame. It is sharp and large, with dark green lobed leaves around it and a twig at the right. The light is even.
results.note: A full-shape green seed ball hanging on a long stalk, with the whole ball in view. It is unripe, not the usual brown ball. Only one ball shows on the stalk.

results.description: A single green-yellow spiky seed ball hangs at the end of a thin green stalk against a soft, blurred green background. The ball is small and the file is narrow, but its outline and spines can be read.
results.note: One full-shape green ball on a stalk, set apart by a soft background. The twig is not in the frame, so how it hangs shows only by the stalk. It is unripe, not the usual brown ball.

results.description: Two round, brown, spiky seed balls hang one above the other on one stalk against a pale blue sky. The tree is bare, with soft branches behind. Both balls are sharp and fully in the frame.
results.note: Two ripe seed balls on a single stalk show clearly on the plain sky, with the twig in view. This is the usual look of the fruit.

results.description: Dark brown spiky seed balls hang from bare branches against a deep blue sky, seen from below. One ball at the bottom is cut off by the frame edge. Other balls at the top are blurred, and buds show on the twigs.
results.note: The camera looks up at the balls, which is an unusual angle, and the lowest ball is cut by the frame. Several balls hang on separate stalks, not two on one stalk.

results.description: A small dark brown seed ball hangs from a twig in the centre of the frame, seen from below. Green plane-tree leaves around it are lit from behind. The ball is dark and its surface is hard to read.
results.note: The ball is small and dark against bright backlit leaves, so the spines show only on close study. It is seen from below, which is an unusual angle.

results.description: Two round, spiky, yellow-green seed balls hang one above the other on one long stalk, with a smaller third ball behind at the top. Large green leaves with dark spots fill the background. The balls are in focus and fully in the frame.
results.note: Two green balls on one stalk show clearly, and the stalk hangs from the leaves above. They are unripe, not the usual brown balls.

results.description: A brown, spiky seed ball is held in a hand against a background of fallen autumn leaves and grass. The ball is round and fills the middle of the frame. A short piece of stalk shows at its left edge, and only one ball is visible.
results.note: A single ripe, dry seed ball is held in a hand and seen from the side, with its outline and spiky surface fully visible. Hang is no because the hand holds it, and the second head of the two-heads feature is not shown.

One red, orange and green autumn maple leaf with its outline and lobes clear against a busy but secondary background. The margin and veins need a close look, and autumn colour makes it not the usual look; it is not a cause.

A cluster of orange and red autumn leaves backlit by warm low sun and shot with shallow focus, so the leaves overlap and the outlines are soft. Shape and margin are readable only with close study, and the backlight changes the colour.
A pile of fallen leaves on leaf litter, many of them red or pink maple leaves that are dead and not on the tree. The subject is dead leaf material, so it is a reject.

A shrub with many lobed leaves in mixed red, orange and green autumn colour, with the central leaves showing whole outlines. The leaves crowd each other, and the serrated margin is small in the frame; the colour is autumn, not a cause.
A single red maple leaf lying on the forest floor among litter and a mushroom cap. The leaf has fallen and is dead, so the subject is a dead leaf and it is a reject.

Full-size green mature maple leaves in sharp focus with the lobes and toothed margin readable on the central leaf, and red petioles at the twig. Several leaves crowd the frame, so the photo is not alone, but nothing else is unclear.
