results.description: A cluster of samaras hangs from a branch against a dark backdrop, with green leaves at the left. The samaras have green bodies and tan wings. The fruit is evenly lit and sharp.
results.note: The samaras have full shape but green bodies, so unripe and not the usual look. The hang from a common stalk and the wing shape are clear. The dark backdrop does not change the colour of the fruit, so light is not a cause.

results.description: A green, unripe white oak acorn sits in its cup on a branch, among lobed leaves in bright summer sun. The acorn is small in a wide frame, and a second cup shows below it. The leaves crowd the frame.
results.note: The acorn is small in the frame, so its outline, how it sits on the twig, and its cup are search. The kind is clear as an acorn. Leaves crowd the acorn, so alone is false. The fruit is green, so unripe.

results.description: Pale blue-grey lobed white oak leaves lie over wood mulch, wet with rain drops. They overlap in places, but each lobed leaf stays legible. The central leaf is whole.
results.note: Crowded leaves, so alone is false. The lobes and margin are clear. Veins show only faintly when wet, and no stalks are visible, so venation is search and arrangement is no. No stems show, so there is no sign of a sucker shoot.

results.description: Dry, brown samaras hang in clusters from bare twigs. The warm low sun lights them from behind and gives them a golden tone. The blue sky and out-of-focus branches form the background.
results.note: The warm low sun backlights the samaras and shifts their colour, so light is yes. The wings, outline, and hang on the twig are clear. Dried ripe samaras on bare twigs are the usual look for this stage.

results.description: A single lobed white oak leaf fills the centre of a dark background, with pale blue-grey colour and clear veins. The leaf base runs off the bottom edge of the frame. The leaf is tilted toward the camera.
results.note: The lobes, margin, and veins are clear. The leaf is tilted toward the camera, so angle is yes. The base runs off the bottom edge, so whole is false. Nothing else competes with the leaf against the dark background.

results.description: A whole white oak seen from below: a tall trunk forking into a broad crown, with bright sky and light showing through the leaves. The top of the crown runs out of the frame.
results.note: The main subject is the whole tree seen from below, so the part is other and the part features do not apply. The view from below and the backlit sky under the crown make it harder. No reject check is about a part of other, so reject is empty. The reviewer should decide whether a whole-tree photo is kept.

results.description: Several green acorns with scaly cups sit on a stalk from a white oak twig, among lobed leaves. The acorns are in focus; the leaves around them are partly soft.
results.note: The acorns are full-sized but still green, so they are unripe and usual_look is false. The leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false. The kind, shape, cup and stalk to the twig all read at once.

results.description: The trunk of a mature oak fills the frame, with deep vertical ridges and grey-brown scaly plates. Trees and lawn sit soft in the background, with a brick building at the right edge.
results.note: The ridge and plate pattern repeats across the full trunk width, and both trunk edges are in frame. Even daylight, and no reject check is yes.

results.description: A trunk with dense, ridged grey-brown plates in even daylight. Trees and the edge of a brick building sit in the soft background. Both trunk edges show.
results.note: The ridged plates are clear across the whole trunk, and the light is even. No reject check is yes.

results.description: A green, unripe acorn with its scaly cup, sitting at the edge of a lobed oak leaf. The acorn is in focus; the leaf and background are soft.
results.note: The acorn is full-sized but still green, so it is unripe. The stalk runs out of the frame, so hang is at search. The nut and cup are sharp.

results.description: A sprig of lobed oak leaves in full green, showing mainly the upper surface, against a lawn. The leaves overlap, and few outlines are complete.
results.note: The leaves overlap, so alone is false, and the outlines and edges need a search. The veins show only faintly and no leaf outline is complete, so whole is false. No scale object is in the frame, so size is no. The leaves do not blend into a mass, so no reject check is yes.

results.description: The trunk of a slender tree in a woodland, with blocky grey-brown plates and fissures. Thin trees and leaf litter fill the soft background. Both trunk edges are in frame.
results.note: The blocky plates read clearly, and the woodland light is even enough. The trunk width is slender and the age of the bark is a judgement from the plate pattern. No reject check is yes.

results.description: A dark, shaggy trunk with large loose plates and some peeling strips, in mixed sun and shade. A brick building sits at the left edge of the frame.
results.note: The loose plates and peeling strips read clearly across the trunk. The left half is in shade, but the texture is readable, so bark_up_or_dark is not yes. The age is judged from the plates and could be old.

results.description: A grey trunk with deep vertical furrows and scaly plates, in even daylight. A brick building and pine straw sit in the soft background.
results.note: The furrows and plates are clear across the full trunk, and both edges are in frame. No reject check is yes.

results.description: Two acorns on a plain blue backdrop, one whole and one with its scaly cup, beside a 1 cm scale bar. The nuts are golden-tan with brown cups.
results.note: Ripe acorns with clear nut shape and cup, in even studio light on a plain backdrop. The scale bar is a ruler and is not a fault. The blue backdrop is not a filter, so escalate is none. The photo does not show how the acorns sit on a twig, so hang is no.

results.description: Fallen, dry, brown oak leaves lie in a heap on leaf litter. Several lobed outlines show, but they overlap each other and the surface is dull brown, so no single leaf reads whole.
results.note: These are dead brown leaves on the ground, so dead_leaf is yes. The lobes and margins are partly visible but overlapped, and arrangement and size cannot be seen.

results.description: Several green acorns sit on a twig among green oak leaves, with their scaly cups in view. The acorns are full in shape and the background is soft green woodland.
results.note: Green acorns of full shape that are not yet ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false. Kind, shape, cup and how they sit on the twig are all clear, and nothing hides the acorns.

results.description: A cluster of four green acorns with scaly cups hangs among dark green oak leaves. A large leaf in the foreground and other leaves overlap the cluster, and the acorn stalks are partly hidden.
results.note: Green acorns of full shape that are not ripe, so unripe and usual_look are set that way. Leaves overlap the cluster, so alone is false, and the stalks are only partly visible, so hang is search.

results.description: A crown of a tree shows bright red autumn foliage against dark conifers behind. The crown fills the frame and is cut off at the edges, and no single leaf or trunk reads clearly.
results.note: The part is other, a crown, so no leaf feature applies and leaf_mass is not set; the code decides from these answers. Red autumn colour and the conifers behind compete, so alone is false.

results.description: A branch of red oak-type leaves in bright autumn colour, with a few lobed leaves clear of each other. Dark conifers fill the background behind them.
results.note: Autumn red leaves, so growth_stage is autumn and usual_look is false; the colour itself is not a cause. The leaves are small in the frame, so shape and margin are search, and the stalks join the branch only partly in view.

results.description: A cluster of mid-green lobed oak leaves on a small plant, with leaf litter on the ground below. The centre leaf is whole and shows its lobes, veins and the start of the stalk.
results.note: Green mature leaves with no sign of another season, so summer. Several leaves compete for attention, so alone is false, but the lobes read well and the leaves do not blend into a mass.

results.description: Three ripe acorns with brown and reddish nuts and scaly cups sit together on a twig, against soft green leaves. The central acorn is fully in view and its cup is clear.
results.note: Brown and reddish acorns, so growth_stage is ripe and usual_look is true. The nuts and cups are clear, and only the angle of the twig keeps hang at search.

results.description: A single lobed oak leaf with bristle-tipped lobes lies against a soft dark background. The upper surface and midrib are in full view, and the whole blade shows.
results.note: A whole green mature leaf in summer, with lobes, margin and veins clear against a soft background. The join of the stalk to the twig is only partly seen, so arrangement is search.

results.description: A single green acorn with a scaly cup hangs from a stalk on a twig, with green oak leaves around and behind it. The acorn is fully in frame and in focus.
results.note: Green acorn of full shape that is not yet ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false. Kind, shape, cup and hang are clear, and the soft leaves around it do not compete.

results.description: A small branch of lobed oak leaves in yellow, orange and red autumn colour, with green leaves behind them. The orange leaf at right is whole and its lobes show clearly.
results.note: Autumn colour, so growth_stage is autumn and usual_look is false; the colour is not a cause. Green leaves behind compete, so alone is false, the edges need close study, and the stalks do not show.

results.description: A tall grey trunk photographed from the base, looking straight up toward the crown, with green canopy and sky around it. The bark shows deep vertical ridges and plates across the whole frame.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, so bark_up_or_dark is yes and the view from below is an unusual angle. The ridges and plates read clearly.

results.description: Several green lobed oak leaves on a branch, with brown leaf litter on the ground behind. The leaves overlap, and the central leaf shows its full outline and lobes.
results.note: Several leaves overlap on the branch, so alone is false. The central leaf's outline is clear, and the margin and lobe tips need a closer look. Full-size green summer leaves.

results.description: A cluster of green lobed oak leaves on a branch, with a blurred path behind in dappled light. The leaves overlap, and the lobed outline is visible on several of them.
results.note: Crowded leaves: several overlap, so alone is false. The lobed outline is clear, and the margin needs a closer look. Mature green summer leaves.

results.description: A spring sprig of pale yellow-green lobed oak leaves, with yellow catkins hanging among them from a thin twig. A blurred tree trunk and grass are behind, and the sun lights the leaves from behind.
results.note: Fresh spring leaves that have not reached full colour, so young is yes. Sunlight from behind warms the colour, so light is yes. The catkins hang in front of the leaves but do not replace the leaf features.

results.description: Four lobed oak leaves radiate from one short stalk against a mossy tree trunk. The leaves look pale and fresh, and the stalk seems to rise from the bark itself.
results.note: The stalk appears to rise from the trunk, so these may be leaves of a sucker shoot. This reject is a judgement from one photo, and a reviewer should check it. The outline, lobes and veins are otherwise clear.

results.description: Several dark green lobed oak leaves hang from branches, with a tree trunk and other foliage behind. The central leaf shows its outline and lobes.
results.note: Several leaves overlap, so alone is false, but the central leaf's lobes and margin are readable. Full-size green summer leaves with no sign of another season.

results.description: A tall grey-brown trunk seen from below, looking up into a green canopy. The trunk is in deep shade, and its ridges are dark but visible.
results.note: The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, so bark_up_or_dark is yes. The trunk is in deep shade, so light is yes and the ridges need close study.

results.description: Yellow-green oak leaves and yellow catkins hang on a sunlit branch, with a graveyard and dark conifers behind. The leaves are soft and pale under strong sun.
results.note: A spring flush with catkins, so the leaves are young and have not reached full colour. Strong sun changes the colour, so light is yes. The catkins hang among the leaves but do not hide the leaf features.

results.description: A dense mass of red autumn leaves on a tangle of branches fills the frame. Individual leaves are hard to separate, and no single leaf is whole.
results.note: Autumn colour is not a cause. The crown of red leaves blends into a mass, so leaf_mass is yes and no single leaf outline can be traced.

results.description: The base of a large tree trunk, shown straight on, with deep interlaced ridges and grey-brown plates across the frame. Autumn trees and grass are behind the trunk.

results.description: A close view of a grey-brown trunk with deep vertical furrows and flattened ridges, with pale and yellow-green lichen patches on the plates. The frame is filled with bark and shows no trunk edge, branch, or scale object.
results.note: The ridged plates and furrows read clearly over a bark area that shows the pattern repeat, and the colour looks natural. The frame has no trunk edge, so too_close is true, which does not reject.

results.description: Pale green unfolding leaves and a green tulip-shaped flower bud, held up against a blue sky with blurred bare branches behind. The bud fills the centre of the frame and is the main subject.

results.description: A single whole acorn hanging from a short twig, with a scaly brown cap over a glossy brown nut and a small tip. The background is soft green and pink, and nothing competes with the acorn.
results.note: Kind, shape, hang, and cap all read clearly on the whole, sharp acorn, and it hangs from the twig. Nothing makes the photo harder.

results.description: Five whole brown acorns lie on a plain grey surface, with caps and tips visible on most of them. They lie at different angles, so the group does not stand out as one subject.
results.note: Several acorns share the frame, so alone is false. Kind, shape, and cap read clearly on each acorn, and none is damaged or unripe. The acorns are not on a twig, so hang is no.

results.description: Three acorns on a plain blue background with a 1 cm scale bar. The left acorn is whole with a scaly cup and a short stalk, the centre one shows a pale flat base, and the right one is a nut seen from above with a small dimple.

results.description: Yellow-orange tulip-tree flowers in a leafy crown, with several open flowers at different heights and green leaves behind them. The flowers are the main subject, not the leaves or the fruit.

results.description: Dense tulip-tree foliage on a branch, with a green cone-like bud on a stalk near the centre and a large lobed leaf in the lower middle. Many leaves overlap, and the bottom leaf runs past the bottom of the frame.

results.description: Four loose acorn parts on a black background: a scaly cup seen from above at top left, a whole acorn with a cap and tip in the centre, a nut without a cup at right, and a nut seen from above at bottom left. The parts are separate and not on a twig.
results.note: The centre acorn is whole and shows kind, shape, and cap clearly, so the loose cup does not make the main fruit missing. The top views of two parts are an unusual angle.

results.description: A branch of oak with lobed leaves and three green acorns on short stalks, with the cups visible on the twig. Leaves overlap behind the acorns, and the green background is soft.
results.note: The acorns are full-size but still green, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look is false, which is not a cause. Leaves and twigs crowd the frame, so alone is false.

results.description: A broad, close trunk fills the frame, with vertical ridges, furrows, and grey bark plates. Green foliage shows at both edges, and the trunk edges are visible.
results.note: The ridges and the grey colour read clearly over a bark area that shows the pattern repeat. The trunk edges show, so too_close is false.

results.description: A view up into a tulip-tree crown against a pale sky. The leaves are yellow and yellow-green with some still green, and they fill most of the frame in a dense tangle of branches.
results.note: The photo shows a crown seen from below, so the part is other and no leaf feature applies. The upward view is the angle cause; the autumn yellow is not a cause.

results.description: A crown of tulip-tree leaves in sun, with several open orange and yellow tulip-shaped flowers among them. The flowers are the main subject and the leaves crowd the frame.
results.note: The flowers are the subject and take the place of the leaf features, so buds_or_flowers is yes. The open flowers mark spring, and the crowded frame makes alone false.

results.description: A full view of a grey-brown tree trunk with patches of grey-green lichen, shot from a few metres away on a street with a building and a yellow sign behind. Vertical ridges and furrows run across the trunk.
results.note: Bark seen from a distance, so texture and pattern are search, and the lichen partly covers the ridges. The trunk edges show, so too_close is false, and the busy street behind makes alone false.

results.description: A single tulip-tree leaf lying flat on a dark bark background, seen from the upper side. Its four-lobed blade with a notched tip and its veins show clearly.
results.note: The whole mature green leaf is in frame, and its outline, edge, and veins are clear. No scale object is in frame, so size is no.

results.description: A single green tulip-tree leaf on a dark background with a notched top and lobes, and a stalk running to the bottom edge of the frame. The leaf has small reddish spots but no holes or tears.
results.note: Shape, margin, and venation are clear and the whole leaf is in frame. The small spots do not change the outline, so damaged is not set.

results.description: A sprig of several green tulip-tree leaves with a small green bud at the stalk joints. A large central leaf is in front and sharp, and the others overlap around it and run to the frame edges.
results.note: The leaves are crowded, so shape and margin are search, and the stalk joins are only partly shown, so arrangement is search. The small bud does not take the place of the leaf features, and the central leaf veins read clearly.

results.description: Two open tulip-tree flowers, orange and yellow, on a branch among green leaves, with soft green foliage behind. The flowers are the subject and both show in full.
results.note: The flowers take the place of the leaf and bark features, so buds_or_flowers is yes. The open flowers mark spring, and the soft background keeps the subject alone.

results.description: A crown of green tulip-tree leaves on a branch against a plain blue sky, photographed from below. The leaves are small in frame and the branch enters from the lower left.
results.note: The view up into the crown from below is the angle cause. The crown is cut at the top and right of the frame, so whole is false, and the plain sky keeps it alone.

results.description: A close view of grey-brown bark with tight vertical ridges and furrows that fills the whole frame. No trunk edge, branch, or scale object shows.
results.note: The ridges and furrows read clearly across a repeating area. The frame shows texture only with no trunk edge, so too_close is true.

results.description: A low plant in ground cover of grasses and ferns, with several light-green, irregularly lobed leaves on a shoot. The leaves are larger and more irregularly lobed than the typical mature form.

results.description: A tall, straight trunk fills the centre of the frame, with deep vertical ridges and furrows that interlace. Dark shade, a fence, and blue sky sit behind it, and both trunk edges are in view.
results.note: The deep, interlacing ridges read clearly across a full-width trunk section. The lower trunk is in partial shade, but not deep enough to change the colour or hide the texture.

results.description: A close-up of trunk bark fills the frame, with vertical ridges and fissures in grey-brown bark. Yellow-green lichen covers much of the surface. No trunk edge, branch, or scale is in view.
results.note: The ridges and fissures read well in sharp focus, but the frame shows texture only, so too_close is true. The lichen cover is not one of the listed causes.

results.description: A tall trunk rises from the bottom of the frame into a spreading crown of green leaves, seen from below. The main subject is the whole tree, and sky shows through the leaves at the top.
results.note: The main subject is a whole tree and crown seen from below, so the part is other and the bark is not the key subject. The upward view is an unusual angle, and the crown is cut off by the top edge. No part check applies to other, so no reject code is set.

results.description: A close view of a trunk with grey bark, vertical ridges, and pale lichen patches, set against soft green foliage. Both trunk edges are visible, and the file is about 250 px wide.
results.note: The ridges read clearly across the full trunk width in even light. The small file is sharp, which is not a fault.

results.description: Two children stand in front of a large trunk in a green forest, each with a small yellow item near the mouth. The children fill most of the frame, and the bark is only a background element.

results.description: A trunk with vertical ridges and small plates fills the frame, with grass, a path, and a railing visible behind it. Both trunk edges are in view, and the light is even daylight.
results.note: The ridges and plates read clearly across the trunk width. The path and railing are background only and do not compete with the bark.

results.description: A tall trunk fills most of the frame, with vertical ridges, fissures, and some fine cross-breaks in grey-brown bark. Blue sky and tree crowns sit at the upper right, and both trunk edges are in view.
results.note: The ridges read clearly over most of the trunk, and the light is even. Nothing in the frame makes the photo harder.

results.description: A very close view of bark with diagonal ridges and interlocking plates, in grey-brown colour with patches of pale lichen. No trunk edge, branch, or scale is visible.
results.note: The frame shows texture only, so too_close is true. The ridges and plates are sharp and read clearly, which is not a fault.

results.description: A large dark trunk stands in a forest, with a flared base on leaf litter and thin trees around it. The trunk runs off the top edge of the frame, and autumn leaves cover the ground.

results.description: Several pale grey trunks stand in a leafless winter wood, with bare branches crossing the frame. The trunks are seen at a distance against a bright sky, and the right-hand trunk has orange lichen patches.
results.note: The ridges show only at a distance, so texture and pattern are search, and several trunks compete for attention. The bright sky backlights the trunks, which changes their colour. The stems look thin and smooth, so growth stage is young.

results.description: A tall, dry, brown seed head on a short stalk, with a piece of twig at the base. Its pointed papery scales overlap in a closed cone. The green background is soft and out of focus.
results.note: An intact, dried, closed cone with a clear outline. The samaras are not visible, so kind is search. The upright stalk shows how it sits, so hang is clear.

results.description: A dry brown fruit seen from straight above on a plain snow background, with a twig entering from the left. Its papery segments spread like petals around a central axis.
results.note: A top view of a dried, opened cone, so angle is a cause. The view from above does not show how the fruit hangs, so hang is no. Kind is search because the segments read as petals at first glance.

results.description: A green, elongated, cone-shaped fruit with a short stalk at its base, among green leaves with a soft background. Its surface shows small scales and a pointed tip. It is still green, not brown.

results.description: A brown, dried cone of pointed papery scales on a short stalk, against a plain black background. The stalk runs down to the bottom edge of the frame. The lighting is even and the cone is sharp.

results.description: Two pale cream, papery fruits, each on a short twig, against a soft autumn tree background. They look dried and bleached.
results.note: Two small dried fruits, both whole, so the subject shows in full. Shape and kind are search because the fruits are small in the frame. The pale colour comes from age, not from the light, so light is not a cause.

results.description: Brown, frost-covered fruit cones on a thin twig, with a blue background out of focus. The frost whitens the scaly tips. One central cone is the clearest subject and stands on a short stalk.

results.description: A pale tan, papery cone lying on bare soil and leaf litter, with green clover beside it. Its upper end is intact with pointed bracts, and its lower end is torn and splayed. Leaf debris lies in the same plane.
results.note: The fruit is torn and splayed at its base, so it is damaged and atypical, and the full fruit does not show, so whole is false. Leaf litter and clover compete with it, so alone is false. It lies on the ground, so hang is not shown.

results.description: A dried brown fruit with spread, pointed tips, standing on a thin stalk in front of a lawn and autumn trees. A large green leaf sits out of focus at the left edge. The background is soft and warm.
results.note: A dried fruit with spread tips, past seed fall, so it is not in its usual look. The outline is clear and the stalk shows how it sits, so hang is clear. The out-of-focus leaf at the edge does not compete.

results.description: A pale, dried fruit on the end of a thin bare branch, against a blue sky with twigs out of focus. Its tips are pointed and papery. The fruit sits near the centre of the frame and is sharp.
results.note: A dried, pale fruit on a bare winter branch with a clear outline, so shape is clear. Kind is search because the scales read as a cone, not as samaras. The blue sky is plain and soft, so alone is true.

results.description: A tree crown seen from below against a grey-white sky, with many small brown dried items on thin branches. The crown fills the frame and is cut off by the edges. No single fruit is the clear subject.

results.description: A view up into a bare winter crown of thin dark branches against a clear blue sky. Several small dark dried fruit clusters hang on the twigs.

results.description: A shoot of several lobed, maple-like leaves at mid-height. Most are bright green, and a few near the centre are reddish-brown and look like new growth. The background is soft green foliage in sunlight.

results.description: One green lobed leaf lies in the middle of the frame, seen from its upper side on grass. The coarse teeth and the main veins are clear, and a few small brown spots show on the blade.

results.description: A hand holds a lobed leaf at the right, with a second leaf behind it on the left. The background shows pale mottled bark and grass.

results.description: A single large lobed leaf, bright green, seen from above against soft grass. The coarse teeth and the veins are clear, and a second leaf shows at the left edge.

results.description: A shoot of several lobed green leaves. The front leaf is lit from behind, so it looks yellow-green and translucent. The leaves overlap, and the dark background at the top holds out-of-focus reddish leaves.

results.description: One green lobed leaf lies on the grass near the centre, with several other leaves overlapping it at the edges. A leaf at the top left has yellow and brown spots.
